text: I deducted one star because the service was not great. Our waiter wasn't friendly at all. The first question was "soup or salad ". I wanted to order appetizer and lunch special, but he assumed we were having lunch. Seaweed salad was really good. Shiomay was small but good. The sashimi was fresh. Banzai roll was great and unique. Raw salmon and white fish with avocado and fish egg wrapped in cucumber with some sweet sauce. Perfect for those who is looking for no-rice roll. Salad dressing was more like carrot purée.

Great community vibe... i've run into friends and struck up conversation with new ones each time i've been in.  Its nice to have new hang within walking distance of my house.  I've stuck to the classic burger and love it... everything from the buns to the ketchup is made in-house and has unique taste. The bar had pretty much whatever i wanted... last night the bartenders made some homespun watermelon concoction.

To touch on some other reviews... i understand everyone has a different experience, but to say the place is 'too hipster' seems like someones still jaded from feeling left out in high school...  and personally attacking the owner is tasteless and has no place in a review.  We should be glad we don't all have someone looking over our shoulder attacking our motives. I like what Burger Up is trying to do and i like that they hired a bunch of folks representative of our Nashville community... if you need a non-musician wait staff who dresses just like you and takes you to prom, you're probably in the wrong town.

Worth a try.

Two of us went there for dinner after 3 hours of driving.  It is across the street from the Westin. 

McLeod is well appointed and inviting.  The staff were friendly, albeit a touch slow.  Not a deal breaker, but still....

We shared beef sliders as an appetizer.  They were fresh and delicious, and well presented.   We ordered the linguine as a main.  Now, most pub pasta is an adventure, at best.   This was perfectly cooked with a nice taste.  Well done Chef.   

Add to this both the World Series game and hockey game on big screens, and some adult beverages and it was a good evening.  

I will go back...maybe tomorrow.
Ask for a Fresh Margarita, they are fantastic. Seafood enchiladas are the bomb too. Lots of different tequila at the bar to try out. Great authentic Mexican food.

Met the owner, a very nice gentleman, the place was spotlessly clean and nicely appointed. Ordered Thai rolls, Spring rolls, and the Garlic/Black Pepper vegetables with beef for take out. Food prep was about 15 minutes, and everything was very good and freshly prepared. Both the spring and Thai rolls appeared to have been made fresh, not the frozen variety so many places use these days. I thought the prices were fair considering the freshness and the quality of the food. I definitely plan on returning to enjoy eating there at the restaurant.

I'd been to Sage once before, more than a year and a half ago.  I shouldn't have waited to come back.  I was with a party of 6 and had a reso that I made earlier in the day.  We were seated quickly; the hostess knew our reservation.  We ordered the calamari per the waiter's suggestion, and we were all impressed: this stuff is where it's at, no where else have I seen breaded and fried calamari that is tossed in the sauce (a sweet creamy sauce that complemented the squid well).  The wine list isn't extensive, but it's got everything you might want - and all bottles were approachable.  
I ended up having the ribeye with candied yams and green beans.  Everything had tremendous flavor.  My one complaint would be that the yams were legitimately covered in caramel, which seemed like a little much.  It didn't stop me from eating them, though.  
The portions are pretty big, regardless of what you get.  I tried a bit of the steak and shrimp penne which had a peppery heat that wasn't shy.  Everyone at the table was very pleased with their dishes.  Including the cedar plank salmon, the Seafood Cipellini and the crab cake sandwiches.  
They have some great dessert selections, too.  All for $2!  I had an apple cranberry crumble and tried the creme brule - both very good.

Our server was very friendly and attentive, though he also was good at knowing when to hang back.  He needs to be trained on bottle service (didn't present the bottle and vintage, first pour didn't go to the person who ordered the wine and he finished that pour before serving the rest of the table).  I appreciated his suggestions, his patience and helpfulness.  

Some guests from either the AB visitor center or upstairs came by the bar drunk and caused some distractions (falling off bar stools) and increased the volume of the place considerably.

Always on the looko for manager's special at dessert section at front andc the back. I found Cheesecake Factory Brown baguette. You bake it at home for five minutes and you will get amazing two loaves of soft, light, and moist, warm bread. You can eat it the whole thing.
Best pizza around, the wings are also a must try. It's always crowded but the wait is usually only 5-10 min.

The healthy section is very organized and great addition to the store. The nutrition bar is well organized and displayed. There are sections for Bob Red Mills product, Wasa, Kashi,and gluten allergy produc
Fast service,  great drinks and attentive staff. And good fajitas. Friendly staff on a Saturday night, close to the Nugget....

Very friendly fish monger, great service. 

You can buy the famous Junior cheesecake at the freezer section near the bakery

I loved spending time at Cat Therapy. I mean, I got to play with cute cats for an hour, so that's enough to make me a satisfied customer, but Cat Therapy was run very well. It seemed like the space was organized to keep the cats comfortable. The color coded collars made it easy to identify how to approach all of their cats and tere were plenty of spaces for the cats to get privacy. The employees knew each cat well and were able to tell you more about any of them. 

Since the cats were up for adoption and getting socialized, this place seems like everyone wins. My only problem is that I didn't know about this place earlier, but I'm glad I saw their sign on State Street. I hope they stay for a long time.
Friendlier than Emerils, lobster Tacos and short rib poutine to boost your cytokines and insulin levels!  Walking distance from the hotels.  Enjoyed the experience!

A very poor example of a local Philadelphia bar. We thought there was hope then the owner said they were closed at 9:05PM for a celebration eagles Super Bowl beer. No respect!!!!!! Fly Eagles fly!!! We will find "that"Brewerytown spot!

Overpriced diner food!!!! Was excited to go here for months and was EXTREMELY disappointed. Cant believe Starr associates it's name with this place. I am a frequent Continental diner but Will never be recommending this place to anyone. One "starr" for The service

Funky cafe.  The sandwiches were good.  I had a chicken sandwich with sundries tomatoes and cheese, which was excellent.  My companion had a ham and pineapple which was good but small.  The mocha I got was super bitter but the barista kindly added some vanilla syrup and said they were getting a new chocolate soon. And a yummy molasses cookie for dessert.  I would go back.
Came in on National donut day and sampled red velvet and churros. As usual, very fluffy and soft with perfect sweetness

Incredibly responsive and helpful customer service.  My sales rep Jasmine was super positive and quickly helped me through a process that previously took hours online and on the phone.  Highly recommend stopping in for all comcast/xfinity needs.
Very busy store. I was looking for Chobani plain yogurt but they don't have it. I had to ask for yogurt because they don't have any at the section. One of the staff had to take them out from storage

Very busy on a Saturday morning so the wait was around 15 minutes. The BEST sandwich was very good. The side of potatoes were very bland and dry but good overall. This review is a little late but I found it in my drafts and decided to post it.
Quick, easy, and accessible. The gentleman who worked there quickly suggested the cheapest pair of wire strippers they had. $7.99.

Food is good to excellent, prices Fair considering you're at a somewhat tourist kind of beach bar, the staff have always been excellent in my experience. Great local go to place to enjoy Sunset some music some good food and drink

4.5 stars.  Now I'm not a regular who has encountered ups and downs of this property, but on a short stay this June '12, I really enjoyed this hotel and stay.  It was immaculate clean, friendly, accountable and polite staff, nice rooms, comfortable bed, well stocked coffee/tea area all day, clean room coffee maker with wolfgang punk coffee and a pleasant courtyard area.  Even the breakfast attendant and maintenance staff were friendly and helpful.  From my experience a very solid and well delivered 3 star hotel.  I've stayed at hundreds of hotels and three stars hotels of the same ranking often fall short something spotty.  I noticed across the board consistent here.  The front desk even checked in to make sure everything was okay with my stay and seemed genuinely concerned with delivering excellence when I took a business card at check out.  Don't set your expectations for fancy or resort style, but when you want consistency, I'd highly recommend.

I notice the reviewers who give this a 3 star, all say they would stay again.  So I'm surprised on the star level, but it sounds like the construction was upsetting when guests paid up for this consistency.  Seemed like only construction was in the courtyard, but I didn't experience an intrusion.  So I'd suggest in the short-term calling the hotel first, to check on the status, if you are here for a business stay.

Probably my favorite food to eat for lunch in Philly is the Udon salad at HipCityVeg.  The service and staff are speedy and friendly. I'm not vegetarian or vegan yet I'm drawn to this place because the options are unique and flavorful.

Went to Doc Magrogan's for the first time the other night and really enjoyed the experience.  My wife really wanted some seafood as she is from New England but has not found quality seafood down here yet.  I had also lived in New England for a while and believe this to be the best seafood since being in New England.  Service was great as well.  The only reason for the 4 out of 5 was due to the smaller portion sizes.
Word to the wise, don't come here... We reserved a reservation for 15 3 weeks ahead of time and got there and there was, first off, No air conditioning, it was 99 degrees out...

We heard about this place yesterday from a member of the Weeki Wachee kayaking crew and decided to give it a try - OMG! Our waitress was Danielle, and she was excellent! Got everything perfect and kept an eye on refills and made sure we had everything we needed.  Tried the burgers and my friend and I agreed they may have been the best hamburgers we've ever eaten - stunning! The hand cut french fries were also superb. Recently opened, the entire interior has been remodeled - very light and airy feeling, with a beautiful  outside patio dining area on the water. Prices were entirely reasonable considering the excellent food quality and service. Everything is made to order fresh, so plan to relax and enjoy - this ain't no fast food joint lol. I am sure I'll be going there again soon - I've heard their fish and chips are great too!

Home style dominican food at its finest! Their Mangu with Salami and queso frito (Smashed green plantain, salami chunks, and fried cheese) is one of a a kind! Makes me feel like I'm back home in D.R. The perfect spot for wether on the go or to sit and dine!

I guess I'm not picky when it comes to hotels, and since I've been sleeping on friends' sofas for the past 3 months, I was just glad to have a bed. 

With that said, I think our room was recently renovated and smelled like brand new paint, carpet, etc. When we got here our tv and phone didn't work and they sent someone up right away. I got this as a Hotwire rate and for what I payed, everything was amazing!! Would definitely stay again.

I went to this restaurant twice, but only ended up eating the second time. 

The first run with Meun Fan was a complete disaster. My party was lazily motioned over to an empty table, where we sat at and went unattended to for the next 10 minutes. My party wasn't given a waiter and even when we tried to initiate some kind of reaction from the staff ourselves, we remained ignored. This was perplexing to us, especially since the place was not very busy, so we simply got up and left the restaurant. 

My second time with the same group of people was a far better experience. This time we prepared a little more by calling in a reservation. Upon arrival we were seated in an already set up table and promptly received a waitress. The waitress was just fine and from the last experience it was almost just a relief to be talked to at all by the staff. The food turned out to be excellent. All of my party was happy with a mixture of dishes ordered; curries, noodle plates, chow mien. The Thai iced tea was also refreshing and slightly above average portion sizes of the food were provided. The prices were competitive, if not some of the cheaper Thai food you'll find in the area. 

I would be happy to give this restaurant higher than 3 stars had it not been for the very poor service that we received on our first trip to Meun Fan.

I recently moved to WC from Media and was very excited to see that Pica's was opening a new location! 

I have only ever had the pizza, because honestly, why would you order anything else...it is so good. Some of the best pizza I have had. I was worried that the quality would not translate to the new store, but it tasted the same as it always did. 

Do yourself a favor and get the pizza. White or red sauce. Equally delicious!
Absolutely perfect, even got a recipe for the delicious shahi paneer.

Absolutely horrible. Went with a friend who ordered ribs and they overcooked them twice and she said she didn't want them anymore and asked the waitress to take it off the bill. Waitress refused to because they made it twice, and she asked if she wanted something else instead. She decided to say forget it, I'll just pay for it and I'm never coming back. If my other friend was there, this is what he would have said to the waitress: "I know how to win the hard way! ... You don't know what hard feelings are until I come out publicly against your product, and you'll see how much you sell." - from the movie Mommie Dearest, good movie from the early 80's. Long story short, will never return again.

Really good eggs florentine, and the option for it was listed on the menu which I usually have to inquire about that. The hashbrowns were mediocre, but the service was fast and the meals were decently priced. They also have outdoor seating and I was told they are "dog friendly" so bring your dogs I guess. There's also evident smoking allowed on the patio, which may be a turn off for some so it's vital to mention that.
Service was excellent from both the server and the host. She was a gem.  Perfect end to our vacation. Food was wonderful. Definitely check this place out!

Good bang for the buck.

I have played Del Lago quite a number of times over the past few years.  The clubhouse is quite nice, and has a full bar and dining room.  The pro shop is small but well done.

The course itself is a nice track, with some terrific holes.  It will provide challenges but is not intended to crush your soul.  Usually, a beverage cart on course as well.  I find that the rates are good, and the course has excellent practice facilities.  If you are looking for a nice round of golf and drinks/dinner you should have a look.

Basically a Chipotle but with Indian food. Which I like because I can get everything just how I like it. I've been about 5 times now and have pretty much tried all of the varieties of curry and meat combinations. All of it is very good and they will let you sample if you aren't sure what everything is. I do wish they had white Jasmine rice and vindaloo but outside of that it is a great place for lunch.
The best Italian water ice in south Philadelphia. Super friendly lady. You can freeze your water ice.

Ichiban is a quality Japanese restaurant. The pricing is average and the food is good. The service here was just okay, because the staff wasn't very personal, but they got the job done adequately. My party especially liked the appetizers that we ordered (Beef Maki Maki & Fried Scallops). Their sushi boats are a bit more expensive than at other restaurants in town, but it was an impressive array of food. The atmosphere is quite nice and there is a tatami seating section which gives you the option of sitting cross legged or regularly (helping  out the tall folks).

Fast and friendly service. You can have the seasoning of the crab fries on the side.

I ordered tossed salad with crab meat. Delicious.

Lobster roll is good too.

All of the seafood is fresh.

This review is for the zeppole aka St Joseph cake. The shell is dry and the filling is basically the same as cannolis. Frangelli's is much better because the shell is more moist and overflows with amazing filling. However other pastries are great including the ricotta cannoli.

The ricotta cannoli is not watery, perfect sweetness with mini chocolate chip filled for your order so that you can taste the crunchiness of the shell. Best eaten right away to avoid sogginess.

The chocolate covered banana is their specialty too. It's banana on an almond pastry with some cream and banana fillings.

Their shoe horn is great too. It's basically an almond pastry with some almond paste. Its a must for almond lovers.

The fig bar is filled with fig covered in a thin pastry.

Another Italian pastry to try is sfogiatelle. The shell i a crunchy and layered pastry filled with ricotta andd a hint of citrus flavor that brings a fresh taste.

For cookies, my favorite is the amaretti and pignoli. The cookie is very moist with almond paste.

Went for my first time in early October 2014. Wow - I loved everything about the place! The service was excellent - Eric was our server. Food was stunning, and the prices reasonable for the quality and service we received. We ate outdoors, and then stayed for another drink at the outdoor bar. I highly recommend giving this place a try if you haven't been here before - they'll make a believer out of you!

We've had almost everything on the menu.... and EVERYTHING is amazing. The most delicious food ever. You can't go wrong! The croquettes are really good, as well as the Tabbouleh for appetizers. Definitely get the Lamb Ribs or Chicken Kabab for a meal. Amazing!!
They were very fast and helpful with my SUV upgrade. They pulled the car right up to the door and I was in and out in 15 minutes.

Hummus comes with tabouleh, pickled carrots, beets, and cauliflower, also grilled flat bread. The pickled veggies is great and so was the tabouleh. Not heavy on seasoning. Hummus is smooth but the taste of the chick peas wasn't present. The flat bread was warm but doughy.

Curry cauliflower has pea pure and is perfectly cooked and seasoned. The taco shell I believe is not freshly made aka it's store bought. Each taco has two tortilla which I think is too much because each tortilla is pretty thick. Very filling.

My husband had fish tacos and he said it's really delicious.

Nachos with carnitas: I think it's more like tortilla chips with cheese dips because the chips and the sauce are separate. So don't expect a pile of tortilla chips with all of the goodness on top. The tortilla is so stale. The carnitas is salty, the cheese sauce lacks flavor. It's a disappointment.

Salad: fresh but not big.

However service was great. Our waitress knows the menu well and gave a nice recommendations. 

Food came out super fast.

Overall the food is pretty decent for a brewery.

Nice store where you can buy Philadelphia themed merchandise. There's slushy station near checkout.

You can find very affordable gift bags and cards upstairs.

I ordered fried plantains and it's ok. Some are a little bit burnt. It's a little bit pricey for around $5 for 6 slices.

The empanadas are small.

Customer service needs improvement. The person who took my order is not too friendly.

The almond croissant is the best. I usually not lucky enough to get it late on Saturday even around 11 am. You can call ahead to reserve it. 

Clichy and marjoline are my other favorites. Very light and crispy layers of nut pastries.

The cake looks amazing.

You can get cookies sold by pound.

15% discount if you made reviews on Yelp. 

Filled choquette: really disappointed. There's no flavor at all only whipped cream. It's super to be hazelnut flavor. However the pastry is very fresh and moist.

Flourless chocolate cake: really good and not overly sweet. It has a brownie texture.

Orange olive oil cake: really moist and it's sweet. You can't taste the olive oil. The poppy seed gives a crunchy texture. The outer part of the cake is addictive from the caramelization of the sugar.

Service was horrible! I can't get a refill on my coffee. I asked 3 difference times. They got our order wrong. Took forever to even ask about a drink order. And then forgot someone's food. As for the food, it's "ok". The people are nice, that's the only reason I gave them 2 stars. Also, I would NOT call this place child friendly! I will Never come back!!!

I decided to post this review when I saw that most of the other reviews were from clients who already had some experience in aerial arts and fitness - and also due to my true surprise and honestly *shock* about the one bad review here. I have not had any experience whatsoever in circus arts or trapeze or even gymnastics or dance -  and yet Lorelei has not only trained me with patience, humor, and much kindness - but has genuinely celebrated my own little progress. (And that progress, may I add, has been thrilling for me. It is SO MUCH FUN to get better at this stuff!) I can't say enough good things about this workout or Lorelei as a trainer / coach. I'm totally hooked and recommend it highly.

The host was not very nice. He was very rude about the bar seating when we arrived and acted like he was above me.

They squished us at a bar seat (that we had to wait for on the waitlist) and it was very uncomfortable.

It took about 20 minutes for the bartender to ask for our drink order and then The beer I ordered was out of stock.... 

The apps were good but the lamb was too dry.

After $115 for 2 people, we were very dissatisfied. Not worth the hype whatsoever.

Will not be going back.

During Easter week they make traditional Easter pies and Easter bread. The Easter cookie in the form of Easter basket has interesting flavor of mixed sweet and salty. It's okay.

The square cheesecake is delicious. Pineapple or cherry. It's not too heavy.

Great cake from Food Network cupcake Winner. I taste some of their creations at a wedding shower.

Apple Kouign Aman: very good flaky pastry with fresh apples. Very delicious.

Various fruit tarts: filled with not to sweet cream fillings topped with fresh fruits.

Honey tart: you can really taste the honey.

Dulce de leche: very rich chocolate. It's really good. 

Red velvet cake is okay.

Boston cream cake and cappuccino : very delicious with perfect sweetness.

Pistachio cake has some sweet pistachio cream filling. It's the guests ' favorite and the most unique one.

This is our go-to pizza place for St Louis style pizza. Ordering take-out is a breeze and is usually ready in only 10-15 minutes. The staff is always super friendly. We love the sweet tasting pizza sauce and the abundance of topping choices. Definitely recommend for any occasion!

The pork mofongo is really good. Highly recommend. The chicken pastelitos is Ok, not too much flavor. The seafood stuffed filer is very salty, lack of flavor. Also I saw a couple of fruit flies flying around

Super friendly staff who explained the baked goods clearly and patiently.

The almond croissant is the best. It's huge and loaded with almond paste.

Arrived there at noon on Saturday and almost everything was sold out. I was lucky to get smoked kielbasa, cheeseteak pierogies, and potato cheddar pierogies. The owner was really kind to give me free slim jim. The pierogies are amazing. Not frozen, ready to be fried. Cash only. Make sure to arrive early or call ahead

Big improvements this season at the concourse level.

Shake Shack: the cheeseburger is awesome . The sauce really elevates the flavor. The burger isn't greasy. The bun is soft and the lettuce and tomato are fresh.  The mushroom burger is super crunchy with oozing cheese in it. Delicious.

Ribs at Diamond club is delicious, nice size, and very tender. 

Build your own salad: the greens are fresh.

Warm pretzels are awesome. Soft and fresh.

Veggie burger is super greasy. That's why I took a star down.


Crab cake sandwich at Hall of Fame is a little bit greasy and salty.
Don't forget to get the Chickie's and Pete 's crab fries

The review is for the canele. It's chewy with thick outer crust. It's not too sweet but it's missing the citrus and rum flavor.

As always service is great

This place is really small. Arrived after 6 pm Saturday night and the waiting time was 20 minuets for 2 people. You can order drinks while standing to be seated. Service is really fast. Orders came out right away. We had dumplings and broccoli for appetizer. Pork dumplings filling is a piece of sausage and the chili oil wasn't spicy at all. You can skip it. The broccoli is pretty good with peanut topping that gives some crunch to it. My entree is the yakisoba with shrimp and tofu instead of chorizo with bok choy added. It's a stir fried noodle so no broth at all. It's pretty good but the shrimp is on my the salty side. My husband had the curry ramen which is great. The ramen is really smooth and buttery, and the curry is well balanced, not too strong and spicy, has some kick at the end.
Sooooo good!!!! In town for work and ordered delivery at my hotel. I got the beef flautas and carne asada tacos and both were .

Clean place, friendly service. The Paris Philadelphia is amazing. It's a must at this place. The coffee eclair is really good too. The Napolean has very thin and crispy layer. Very good. The sourdough baguette is ok. I wish the wrapping paper covers the whole bread. The croissants are very airy and light. I had the chocolate and the almond.  The chocolate brioche has a lot of chocolate chips. It's a place to treat yourself with good French pastries.

Poorly run office and unprofessional.  Don't expect any depth of expertise.  For anything beyond basic well child visit, you're better off going directly to urgent care physician or directly to specialist.

After Yelp Elite event here, I know I need to come back. 

Service is outstanding. I was able to customize my order. I substituted sweet mashed potatoes with a bowl of brussel sprouts with sauce on the side. My sea bass was perfectly cooked and so was my brussel sprouts.

Pickled octopus with frisée is amazing. The best octopus I've ever had. It's so tender and not hard or chewy at all. The crispy sliced potato gave a crunchy texture to the salad.

The piranha ribs is their specialty. It's flaky with super crispy skin like potato chips. I can eat it all night. You can have it as an entre. When you go to the website and don't see it on the menu, it doesn't mean they don't have it . They have it as special. 

You can make reservations through open table.

Get the warm pan sobao. There are plenty boxes of dates.

Reasonable price of produce. I bought banana one pound for 50 cents
This franchise has dramatically changed under new ownership. Response time and customer service are terrible. It is only about making a new sale to this group.

Roti canai is a must for appetizer. Beef chow fun is good. Seafood noodle soup is good although the squids are chewy. Buddhist delight is on the salty side. Steamed tofu stuffed with shrimp is good although the sauce is salty. Service is great. Portion is big.

So far it's the only place to get tostones de pana. It's in the frozen section near the meat counter. I dip it in a mix of mayonnaise, ketchup, and garlic powder.

During Ramadan there are boxes of dates, Turkish bread and Egyptian cookies.

Great service. Super friendly staff. Hummus and baba ganoush are fresh because they make it themselves. Baba ganoush has smoky flavor and hummus is creamy.

They have several kinds of baklava and other Mediterranean desserts. Baklava is pretty food but my favorite is the sesame sweets. It's hard and crunchy.

Check in with Yelp to get discount

Really friendly lady who helped me. I always get the delicious almond croissant, which is fully stuffed with almond paste. The almond log has that sweet almond paste also.

Cookies are pretty good to. Oatmeal isn't overly sweet although mine was broken during transport.

If you like hazelnut or Nutella, try the marjolailne

Being a CWE resident, Kampai is our go-to sushi joint.  Consistently well done.  Friendly staff.  We usually sit at the sushi bar for dinner, but the times we've sat at a table the service was good.

We don't typically order rolls, but focus more on a tempura appetizer and the freshness of our simple sushi.  Theirs is always extremely fresh, well presented, and the rice underneath is just right.  Occasionally the sushi chef will slip us something interesting on a small plate for us to try.  

We highly recommend Kampai. (Then why only 4 stars and not 5?  Five is reserved for the "absolutely blown away" dining experience.)

My favorite food to order here is sticky rice with mango. It's served warm. The rice isn't too sweet, the mango is fresh, juicy, and sweet.

My coworker ordered the chocolate banana spring rolls and she said it's not too salty, not too sweet, and not too flaky. Now I am curious to try it next time I order. My other coworker who ordered the pad Thai said it's delicious too.

On my first visit here today, I was super impressed with everything there, and can't wait to return. Piping hot, fresh, delicious food: as a lunch special, I got soup, entrée and rice for $6.95, and it was unexpectedly awesome. I began with hot green tea , then egg drop soup that was the perfect size, nice and hot, fresh crisp scallions on good soup. Then I had the best sweet & sour chicken I've ever tasted. Straight from the fryer (that was obviously using clean oil), crispy, with a tasty and steaming-hot (if lurid red) dipping sauce *on the side* (this is key), and a generous helping of pork fried rice.

That's the way to do it. DIP the crispy, light, pillowy, perfectly cooked chicken pieces into the sauce, so they stay crispy the whole time. I also put some crispy chicken into my soup spoon, to scoop the last of the soup into the same bite with it. 

My table, the whole place, including the restroom, were spotlessly clean with pleasant decor. I liked the tied-aside beaded curtains to the restroom area. 

I also liked the server (owner, too?) -- friendly with everyone who came in, and on point in every way, cool, quick, and made it look effortless. I told him how great the food was and how I liked that it was served so hot. Really good food made and served with attention to quality. Can't wait to try everything on the menu, starting with the fried oysters. Or maybe the asparagus with beef. Or any of the Japanese or Thai menus...

Maybe this review was long, but I'm in this area a few times a month, and I can see myself becoming a regular at this place. It's crave-worthy.

Came in on first day of opening because of buy one get one free.

The girl at the register was friendly and explained that milk swirl wasn't available and the free tea is the ruby milk tea.

I ordered king of oolong tea with mango boba. Service wasn't as fast as I expected. The cup is made of unsturdy  for the hot tea. I asked for a carrier and it's only a plastic bag for each cup. As a result both tea lids were dislocated at Whole Foods Market when I went food shopping sine it's only a block away and made a big mess in the store.

I was able to salvage the one with mango boba. The boba isn't dense it's like a tiny balloon filled with mango juice that burst in your mouth. It's not too sweet and the mango flavor is weak.

The menu has Hong Kong egg waffle but to my disappointment it's not available.

I will not go back again. So far Moge tea is the best with sturdy paper cups and carrier.

My honest opinion is this: it's incredible. At least what I've tried is. The chicken tenders were mentioned by another reviewer, as well as the Buffalo garlic sauce... Both are incredible. Tenders are homemade not frozen. That buffalo garlic sauce... Awesome. You have to try. I also got some French fries and fried mushrooms. Both also seem to be homemade. The fries are delicious, it reminds me of the Checkers style of French fries. The fried mushrooms were good, not great. They were just a little over fried, but still good, definitely not bad. If it wasn't for that I'd have a 5 star all around. 

Also worth mentioning, the customer service guy on the phone and delivery guy were both great. I manage a Verizon Store so customer service to me is extremely important, and they were cheery and eccentric about their food. Definitely will be recommending to my employees and customers. Cheers!

My food was dirty, and with bone chips. I see Solly is a long-standing neighborhood fave, but sorry, my first time ever eating their food could've broken my teeth, maybe choked me; the more concerning thought now is wondering about what I could've already eaten without knowing it. Swallowing things like this could be dangerous and damaging, especially to those with certain health/digestive tract conditions. There are 9 inedible objects on the side of that plate, 8 are bone fragments, some of them really sharp, some attached to gristle, and one is a 3/4" or so piece of green plastic thread. 
Not pictured was also a rock-hard, tiny, black ball, maybe only 1-2 mm diameter, size of a mustard seed but not a mustard seed, not food, more like floor sweepings (forgot to mention I bit on some grit, too), but I lost it when it fell out of my napkin. 

This was from only 1/4 piece of the cheesesteak! 

It made me rethink ever getting a cheesesteak from anywhere again, but what's more likely is that it'll be a long time before the thought of a cheesesteak, from anywhere, will sound any good to me.  I feel like we need the guy in Fight Club who discreetly specifies when ordering, "Clean food, please."
Great and affordable food. Service is fast. Very friendly. Roti canai is a must here. Beef chow fun is delicious. Achat is very good too.

This ShopRite is an improvement from the old location on Front and Snyder. It's much brighter, cleaner, and organized with wider isles. There's a section for express checkout. Don't miss the manager special section at the back of the produce. They have special section for gluten free and healthy lifestyle . They have prepared food section near the entrance including a salad bar, Chinese food, and sushi with small eating area. They also carry  frozen Junior's cheesecake at the bakery section. The muffins looks very yummy, makes you want to grab some.

It's pretty good poke with build your own options. I wish there are more topping options. I got there around noon and was told that they didn't have brown rice. Fortunately I wasn't interested in getting it with brown rice. But I felt. bad for those who wanted it.

The cheesesteak pierogies are absolutely delicious with the caramelized onion on top. The staff is super friendly and welcoming. The apple sauce is great too.

Stuffed cabbage has creamy tomato sauce and well seasoned.

Pretty big supermarket with a lot of Hispanic food. The price is on the cheap side. Example: banana is 2 lb for $2

I feel I am in Goya heaven. The first aisle is all Goya.

Pan sobao is so good when it's warm. The guava pastry is a nice dessert. The store made flan is pretty good.

There are a lot of huge boxes of dates . It's so good and melts in your mouth.

There are a lot of halal meat too.

It's a small supermarket but carries local products such as Isgro's, High Street, Sarcobakery, Claudio's cheese. It carries wine too.?Very helpful staff. Several self checkouts with paper bags. The small shopping carts are cute .

Amazing hotel. 

My check in experience with Lisa was outstanding. She acknowledged my platinum membership and unlike many other Marriotts upgraded me without having to ask. 

The room was very nice and clean. 

The hotel itself is an adventure. It's huge with beautiful indoor gardens, rivers and waterfalls.

Great food and great service.

Cobb salad: huge bowl with shredded chicken, very fresh veggies.

Roasted salmon; it's spicy which isn't my liking and not described in the menu. I told the waitress about it and she gladly changed it to be not spicy. It comes with perfectly cooked grilled asparagus. I subbed the potato salad with mixed green salad with $2 extra which I discovered after the bill , and that's why I took one star down

I have been going to the same woman for eyebrow threading for three years now (my longest relationship). To my dismay, about four months ago, she up and left. She quit, changed her number and headed to the west coast - a tale as old as time. Since then, I have been grieving the loss of this relationship while looking for a rebound. I've made it to International Mall on four separate occasions, with the intentions of Heely-ing in to one of the eyebrow threading salons. I never made it out of my car, not even once. 

Present day: my eyebrows have been untouched for fourth months. While I was getting by, earlier this week I overheard someone say "is that big foot?" and knew it was time. I had to make a decision. I had to move on. That's when I found Ruby's Yelp reviews.

I figured that if anything, I can trust the squad of Yelpers to lead me in the right direction. What's the worst that could happen? She would remove my one and only redeeming quality from my face? I had to take a risk.

Ruby's studio is clean and serene, you know what I mean? I walked in and sat in the comfortable waiting area until it was my turn. When I met Ruby, I knew I made the right choice. She had a very calming presence and was very soft spoken. She gently asked me what I wanted, and told me to have a seat. This was it. I couldn't turn back now. I've had my eyebrows threaded for three years, and the process was painful each time. Ruby must have the hands of an angel, because I felt no pain. Nothing. She was very thorough and took more time on me and my eyebrows than my other lady ever had! When it was done, I gently grabbed the mirror and glanced at myself. I went from a solid 4 to a negotiable 6, just like that. Ruby is AMAZING. My eyebrows look better than ever before. Trust the reviews. I am now loyal to Ruby. I will never go anywhere else. Ruby, please don't leave me.

I had the banana Nutella crepe. The crepe is perfect, soft with Nutella but unfortunately there are not much banana in it.

I saw the eclairs but they were so much skinnier than the last time. Thus I decided not to get it.

I got 15 percent off by showing my yelp reviews.

loved the chefs tasting menu! if you opt for that, remember that you CAN get take out containers for the first course of apps- we stuffed ourselves on dips and pita and barely had room for kebabs and dessert. Overall lovely dining experience and atmosphere, even in the midst of a pandemic!

Last year the phillies had a great discount offer for seats towards the end of the season. This year they ran the same promotion but made a slight chance in seating. You no long seat to sit in any of the open seats but you are made to stand. They said it's standing room only which is really dumb seeing that there are thousands of seats available to sit.  It has turned my wife and son off of going to the game since they have to stand up during the whole game while there are empty seats available.  Hopefully they will go back to the former position seeing that it does give those that have large families an opportunity for attend.

LOVED this food. At there St. Patrick's Day (who knew you could get good Irish food at a Greek Restaurant). Good service. I had Pete's Favorite Greek Salad and it was so huge. A bit pricey at $10.99 but it really was great.

I would definitely go there again.

Very friendly fish monger, great service. 

The organic products are pretty extensive and affordable,
It's a nice and clean store but it's not big. The main area is on second floor.  During holiday they open at 7 am so it is nice to grab last minute gift before work

Roti canai is good as usual. It's definitely a great start. Chicken satay is very tender and not over charred.

My entree of sizzling seafood combination was a disappointment. The shrimps were hard as if they're from previous day.

My husband had his usual of beef chow fun. The noodles were broken into small pieces. He's very disappointed.

The hard drive to my desktop that I had for five years crapped out one day. Usually I am very diligent with backing the important stuff up, but after having my second baby, I slowly started slacking and I was DEVASTATED when I realized I didn't back up the photos from my daughter's 1st birthday or a Mediterranean cruise we had taken the previous summer. 

I contacted someone local who specialized in computer repair who was able to replace my hard drive, but he told me that my old hard drive would need to be sent to a data recovery business. A quick Google brought up a number of companies and even though some advertise data recovery for cheap (YouTube showed some poor handling of equipment). I did find Tri-State Data Recovery and since I was 30 minute drive away, I decided to drop off my hard drive and wait. 

Don was very quick and professional! He gave a quick tour of the premises which included a clean room so I felt like I was in good hands. I had a phone call that afternoon after he had ran diagnostics with a very reasonable quote. Once I gave the OK, I had an external hard drive with EVERYTHING recovered from my hard drive saved onto an external hard drive within a week! I was sooo thrilled that he was able to recover more than just my photos. 

I'd definitely recommend Don to anyone who needs data recovery. He knows his stuff!

The lovely owner squeezed me in last minute! They did a wonderful, slightly rushed, job and I will definitely be going back! Super friendly and the staff spoke english well enough to small talk while I got my nails done- which was a nice plus!

The review is for waffle, shiumay and takoyaki.

Waffle isn't freshly made. They just warmed it up. My waffle was ready in a secon. As a result, it's soggy and lacks of crispiness on the edges.

Shiumai: very small and there's more filler than the meat. You can pass.

Takoyaki is decent. I expect more octopus, the sauce is pretty good.

Please don't waste your money here. We wasted $260 for a cake  for a 50th Bday for 40 people. No one ate the cake and we ended up throwing away the majority of a chocolate with chocolate filling. It tastes like chemicals or that it was made with Crisco. What a shame. It would take a lot for me to throw out a chocolate cake but I didn't hesitate.

This place were recommended to us my my new neighbor and we are so glad that they did.  The dish took us back to the Middle East and breakfast was exciting the hummus and other dips just made our taste buds pop.  The main dishes were wonderful.

I came here for a pre-drink prior to going to dinner at another restaurant. I was lucky enough to stumble in after not knowing about this place. I couldn't resist trying a birria.com taco. It was SO good, and reminded me of the birria my dad used to make growing up. I also ordered a project mezcal margarita and a michelada verde. Both drinks were phenomenal! Being a huge fan of tomatillo and cilantro, the michelada blew my socks off. My only regret was not cancelling my previously made reservations and staying here to try more. I will definitely be back.

Service is always great. Very helpful and friendly staff. You need to try pimientos stuffed with goat cheese. So addictive. Also I recommend lemon ricotta cheese, which in my opinion is more like a dessert.

This supermarket is a great addition to the city. It's a literally giant modern supermarket. Upon entering the store you can find a nice Starbucks cafe. There's an escalator for human and escalator for the shopping cart. On the second floor there's a door to go to a nice size patio to enjoy beautiful weather and city view. Near the floral section you can find French macarons, cupcakes, and gelato. You pay it there. The macarons are pretty good but a bit too sweet for me. 

There are rows of handhelds scanners that links to your Giant card. You scan your groceries and pay what you bought. I haven't tried it but a friendly employee explained it to me.

If you don't have a Giant card you can apply at the customer service. It allows you to get special prices. Also at the customer service, you can find a map  of the store which is handy due to the size of the store.

There's kombucha station by the produce section. There are some local products such as varieties of peanut butter and almond butter. Once you pass the produce you will find sushi station where sushi are preapared on site, Salad works, prepared foods including varieties of uncooked flatbreads that can be made there. As you follow along on the left you will find Mission Taqueria. Their main restaurant is at 15 and Sansom. At the back area you will find varieties of beer on tap, in the fridge, and on the shelf. You can find soft pretzel to, perfect companion for the beer. There are seating areas and tv to watching sports. Also you can enjoy the view of river while you are enjoying your beer and or dessert, which are available next to the beer section. You don't feel like you're in a supermarket. 

What is special about this supermarket is that they carry a lot of local products: High Street Bread, Isgro's pastries, Claudio's pasta and cheese, DiBruno's cheese spread. Next to the deli station is the cannoli counter where you can pick the shell ( regular or chocolate covered), choose the fillings (regular, strawberry, blueberry) and put some toppings if you like. However I don't recommend the regular cannoli, it's bland. 

They have products that I've never seen them n other stores such as plantain flour, crepe mix. Most importantly, at the meat section they have dry-aged beef in a special glass display.

There's also a special section dedicated for plant-based food.

At the checkout, there are several self service and the regular ones. The register station is similar to the ones at Trader Joe's. No conveyor belt, small space to put your groceries so you have to unload them a bit at a time. Very environmentally friendly with paper bags.

In summary, this supermarket gives you a different kind of experience. I called it grocery shopping with a view.

Last night I ate the best meal I've had in a long time at HWK.  I went for No Menu Monday with a 7:30 reso (made the week before).  For the Genie question I said marrow bones, which IMO, set me up for the perfect menu of smooth, savory, fatty goodness.  
Along side the meal, I also went for the $12 wine pairings with each course.  
If you're into wine, do it.  If you're learning about wine, do it.  It's cheap and you're going to get to try some really good stuff.  
Started with muscles in this sweet, buttery white wine sauce.  Absolute perfection.
Duck breast for my entree: perfectly cooked to medium rare, beautifully seared skin and a fantastic flavorful layer of fat.
Dessert was paired with a sprightly brut.  The dish was a beautifully creamy panacotta with cranberries.  

The meal could not have been more perfect, the wine pairings were spot-on, we will be going back soon.

Always get the almond croissant. I tried the almond horn and it's delicious. Fully loaded with almond paste. Crunchy but not hard.

Staff is very knowledgeable about the baked goods .
You can find varieties of Middle Eastern food here. There's one aisle dedicated for this. Also varieties of sweets and boxes of dates during Ramadan.

I was not aware of this place until it was mentioned in 6ABC Facebook live for Latino Community Townhall.

I ordered through Grubhub for delivery and the food came at the promised time.

Each styrofoam container has a sticker of the restaurant  and they included the flyer for the menu. I noticed that they have more than those in Grubhub for example mofongo, coquito, and the dessert. I hope they include everything for delivery.

Pernil: very good, tender, and not dry, it has some broth but not soupy. Definitely get this.

Arroz con gandules is a perfect compliment to the pernil. Rice is moist, perfectly seasoned, not too salty.

Pollo guisado has chunks of chicken and potato. My least favorite because the meat was a little bit tough. The broth is leaking through the container. I suggest that they use better container instead of the styrofoam.

I want to visit the restaurant to try their other items. The food is definitely authentic. I work in a Puerto Rican organization and my coworkers also enjoy the food and recommend the coquito.

Ordered delivery from Grubhub. I called the restaurant for some questions and the staff was friendly and knowledgeable about the menu.

I had Texas chopped salad. Very good and fresh with chopped apple and crispy deep-fried brussel sprouts. The dressing is a perfect compliment to the salad.
When they say they advertise the coldest beers on the island they aren't joking.  Make sure to ask for Della. She is amazing and will truly take care of you!

The pernil has a lot of dry parts. It's mediocre. It taste like regular roast pork and lacks of typical pernil seasoning.

Chicken mofongo is my favorite. It's moist and has a lot of shredded chicken. Highly recommend.

Octopus salad which for me it's more to a ceviche . Very good and refreshing. Highly recommend . 

I should have read my own review for chicken pastellitos. It doesn't have much fillings.

Sweet plantain is really good. It's sweet and not over charred.

Small bakery offering very affordable Asian desserts including zhongzi and steamed pork bun. Super friendly owner and staff. 

Zhongzi has a lot of fillings, very authentic and delicious. The steamed pork bun has good amount of fillings and tasty too.

My favorite is the pineapple bun. Just want to clarify that it doesn't have pineapple fillings but it has a nice crumbs

I suggest that you follow their Instagram to find out new offers. For example today they posted that there had the fluffy sponge cake, very good.

In the fridge they have some cupcakes and some buns.

They also have some refreshing drinks.
The food was very good, healthy also not much oil as you usually get in Chinese restaurant.will come back!

A lot of varieties of cheese and different shapes of dry pasta, fresh mozzarella. Service is fast and efficient. If you want good quality of cured meats such as salami, prosciutto, you have to go to this place. They taste so much better than the ones at the grocery store.

Although they sell Italian bread, I recommend Sarcone's a block south for your perfect Italian hoagie.

Claudio is also a good place for your antipasti needs . They make marinated red peppers, sun dried tomatoes, varieties of olives, marinated mozzarella.

This place is super crowded during holidays

Authentic Thai. Not that I've been to Thailand and know first hand. I had the yellow curry and wifey had rice noodles with chicken (pad see eww?) and both were excellent. Can't wait to return and dine in. Only negative was the spring rolls were two tiny rolls for $4.50.
Got take out on a Friday night and had enough left over for dinner the next day!!! Food was very authentic, super good, and fresh! Would definitely order again and highly recommend!!!

My review is for the burnt end sandwich: it's delicious, the meat is tender and you can definitely taste the smoky barbecue flavor.  However the bun is small. You can fit only two chunks of it. 


The chicken is tender but still maintains the firmness of the meat. Highly recommended.
 I ordered mine for takeout so they put the bun and meat separate.

Service  is great. Super friendly staff.

The donuts are very soft and moist, not too greasy. The texture is more to cake style rather than the yeast donut. The icing is really sweet. The maple bacon donut is covered with a lot of bacon pieces.

Called to order take-out. Ordered two menu items for hubby. Then I learned the only thing I wanted to order is no longer on the menu. Since when? Order-Taker-Guy tried to convince me to pick something else--I repeatedly declined. Yes, I accepted the fact I would be making my own dinner (defeats the purpose of calling for takeout). When I asked how long until hubby could pick up HIS DINNER, Order-Taker-Guy taker DEMANDED my credit card number three times although I said EACH TIME hubby would pay in person. Order-Taker-Guy refused to hear me so I hung up. I called back and spoke to someone different to ensure Order-Taker-Guy got the point and cancelled hubby's order. I'll cook for both of us at home tonight. Since when do they require credit card numbers when an order is placed? We usually pay in person with good ole fashion ca$h. Yup -- we will NEVER order from Veekoo | Royersford EVER again. Buh-BYE !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I came here to kill some time for Mi Pueblito food truck outside. Super friendly staff, but most likely owners . I ordered chips and guacamole and my guacamole was made fresh in front of me so I can customize by asking not to put jalapeño. 

I will definitely come back to try their food

I heard a rumor that there was this hole in the wall Ethiopian restaurant in town and that instead of eating with utensils, you use... bread. Sounds too good to be true right? Eating with your hands? Bread instead of a fork? Yeah, it's true.

I've been twice now, both times for an early weekday dinner. Because of that, there has been only a few other people also dining at that time - fast and efficient service as well.

I cannot express enough how nice it is to have clearly labeled vegan options on a menu. It saves time to not have to ask for an ingredient list of the "vegetarian" options, and then I also don't have to pull out my PowerPoint presentation on what exactly it is that constitutes a vegan diet.

Queen of Sheba is here for the vegans/veg people in this community. There's a whole menu section dedicated to vegan dishes! You really can't go wrong with anything you order. If it's your first time, get the Queen's Eight Platter. You can mix and match what you get and the best part? You won't need to eat for 2 days afterwards. The veggie sambusa appetizer hit on another level, I could've kept ordering more and more and more. And as the tale was told, everything is served both ON and WITH loads of injera, which is thin spongy bread. Ethiopian food is a dream. I love this place and thankful they have so many accommodating options.

Decent prices as well, not too expensive for how filling the meal is! I desperately want to try the coffee ceremony, but I'm not sure how anyone has room left after their meal for that. Is that what self control is? Do people stop eating when they're full? Wild!

This review is for the takeout order.

Banh Xeo aka Vietnamese crepes. Very crunchy but greasy. The filling is delicious.

Summer rolls with grilled shrimp is delicious with the dipping sauce although the dipping sauce isn't the usual hoi sin and peanut. 

Red curry is delicious with perfect flavor and spiciness. You can pick the level of spiciness.

Steamed sticky rice with banana and red beans. There's not much filling only small slices of banana and several beans. It's sweet and delicious. 

Sticky rice with mango is awesome. Mango is really sweet and perfect combination with the sticky rice. It's definitely my fau

I really enjoy Italian restaurants, but this restaurant is the best of the lot.  It is a hidden gem in a strip shopping center in new Metairie.  It's lacking in ambience but the food more than outweighs those minor inconveniences.  The sesame bread was very good, the Italian salad enjoyable, the artichoke appetizer was light and delicious and mama's eggplant and brucioloni was amazing - the red gravy was delicious.  Other meals at the table which were totally enjoyed were a veal and mushroom dish and the fish special which looked very good as well.  After all that food, we didn't have any room for dessert.

I've only ever had the chance to sit at the bar here. 

The hostess informed me that all of the tables were booked through the rest of the night so I presume getting a reservation here might be a little difficult. 

The people were friendly and the bartender was knowledgeable about the menu. Food arrived pretty quickly and was delicious. 

The atmosphere is quite charming, very open and spacious. They also have a great courtyard in the back along with heaters for the winter. 

The wine beer and cocktail selection was pretty good. But also, they have a full bar so you can pretty much ask for anything.  

I like the area and would recommend to a friend.
My favorite besides the ricotta cannoli is the chocolate covered banana. Really refreshing and delicious. Definitely get this. The amaretti cookies are delicious with almond paste.

Went in to start getting info and look at Dodge Ram 1500 models and NO ONE approached or even asked if help was needed or to wait a minute and someone would be with me. NOT impressed. I like the Dodge Ram trucks, but we might be taking our business elsewhere...
Delicious pudding cake. I tried the raspberry. Creamy raspberry topping with moist cake. Don't forget to check out the manager's special to get the best deals of the dessert.

The chocolate champagne cake is okay. The caramel cake is delicious with sweet caramel fillings. 

Both cakes aren't  too sweet but it's very moist. Highly recommended.

I ordered walnut shrimp through Caviar. Food arrived fast. It comes with rice. The shrimps are big and fresh. Lightly breaded and not greasy. The mayonnaise sauce is a perfect complement for the dish. It's not too sweet. The walnut isn't hard. Broccoli is fresh and perfectly cooked. Definitely recommend this dish

This food truck is across Temple student center. It can be busy during lunch time. Very responsive to my questions via Instagram. They make birria tacos occasionally. 

The broth is soo delicious, definitely at par with Mi pueblito and Burrito Feliz in South Philly. Very flavorful and savory. The meat is chopped into small pieces and a little bit dry but after you dip it into the consommé it's not bad at all. The tortilla isn't crispy and one of my taco had less meat than the others.

Super friendly owner. A lot of options on the menu

Finally I had the chance to dine here. We were greeted by a friendly hostess who seated us in a safely spaced seating area. They adhere the social distancing guideline as each tables has nice space in between.

Appetizers: my favorite is the elote. Corn is sweet smothered with creamy flavorful topping sprinkled with cojita cheese. Special for that night was smoked salmon pastrami tostada. Beautiful presentation. It comes with 2 fried tortilla chips with slices of smoky salmon pastrami with spicy slaw. So good. I hope they make it as permanent menu. Guacamole was fresh with plentiful chips. Our table ordered fried pickles and stuffed jalapeños. They didn't disappoint. 

Main course: Texas chopped salad with goddesses dressing. I added shrimp. I love everything about this salad. It has chopped apples, crispy fried Brussels sprouts, sweet corn, pumpkin seeds that gave the crunch. My husband had fish sandwich. The fish was big and perfectly cooked. 

Dessert: tres leches. At a glance it looked like a tiramisu due to the cream cheese frosting with cinnamon dusting. Cake is moist and not overly soaked. Not too sweet and enough sweetness in the cream cheese. The best I've ever had.

Our waiter was very friendly and attentive.

The cocktail drink was not too boozy and not too sweet either. Great balance 


Dessert:

Dr. Poulin is an excellent eye doctor, who is thorough.
He is approachable, gentle and explains things in a way that the patient can understand.
He does not "rush" through  the appointment, either!

Grilled veggies are perfectly cooked but too many charred parts. The peanut sauce is a little bit spicy 

Vegetable dumplings has a nice fresh soft skin and flavor but not too much fillings.

This corner space on 11 and Oregon had been unutilized for years. I am glad to see a small business that I can support.

I got there in the late afternoon and most trays were empty. The baked goodies are similar to the ones in Chinatown with affordable price (less than $2). They also sell some drinks too . 

The kaya buns has some custard fillings. The bun itself is soft. I enjoyed it.

Friendly staff. Cash only 
I want to return to see their full selections

Ordered my lotus moon cake and was so fresh. A lot of fillings and not too sweet. Crust isn't dry. They have other fillings too such as red beans, white beans.

Super friendly owner. I'm happy to support this local business

It was a warm spring day. I had been up for hours, delivering Uber Eats in the Tampa area; getting more hungry with every passing moment. What did I want? Tacos? No... an impossible burger? No.

Thai food, I wanted Thai food. That's when I had a flashback to seeing a post on Tampa Vegans FB group about a precious little joint with a dedicated vegan menu. If only I could teleport to Brandon. It seemed so far away. After a quick pro/con analysis, I decided that I'd make the drive - I was worth it. I deserved it.

It looks like your typical joint upon arrival, but what I didn't expect was the question: "would you like a vegan menu?" Heck yeah I do, what gave it away? A very large vegan menu it was. It's funny how getting so used to having only two options to choose from leaves you in a state of dismay when you have to choose from 50 options!!

I went with the pad see ew - 10/10. The spring rolls were top notch too. But what made this experience was the customer service. Such sweet people that work there, warms my heart. This is also a very inexpensive place for the portion sizes. Did I finish my entire plate? Heck yeah. Did I immediately go to bed after? Heck yeah!

Can't wait to come back for a lunch special!

Finally I had the chance to visit this famous food truck. It is on 20 and Ludlow. I arrived there around 2 PM and there was a line, probably 5 people ahead of me. As I was getting closer, I could see how the marinated chicken was grilled and the green and yellow peppers were charred on a charcoal grill. The smell made me hungry and salivating. He finished the dish with a sauce and garnish. It's worth the wait because everything is cooked fresh. Definitely an inexpensive tasty meal for $10. The whole container is fully packed. Cash only. There's no menu so every day the dish is different. 

Chicken is perfectly flavored and cooked. You can taste the smokiness from the charred peppers. The sauce blends everything together. 

The falafel isn't dry and full of flavor. 
I recommend bringing utensils and plastic bag.

There's no name on the food truck but you can easily recognize it from the long line and the flower in a pot and dried flowers on the side of the truck.

He's super friendly and prideful of the quality of the food. He even encouraged me to review in Yelp.

Came in to restaurant to try more authentic Puerto Rican food.

The restaurant is small at the corner of the street. Very clean and fully decorated with Puerto Rican signs. I was greeted by a staff who took my temperature and advised me to use the hand sanitizers. I am glad that they take the COVID precautions seriously.

Jazmine was very welcoming and so was Hector. Make sure you follow the restaurant on Facebook or Instagram for their special menu item.

Maduros; not greasy and perfectly cooked. It's a great side dish.

Chicken pasteles comes in 2, it's a Puerto Rican style of tamales. Very authentic.

Coquito is a must have here. It doesn't have alcohol in it. Delicious, not overly sweet.

Gazpacho with bacalau is awesome, not too soupy or too acid. Flavor is on point. 

You can also grab Puerto Rican souvenir by the entrance door including Puerto Rican mask.

I came back here because I enjoyed the fresh guacamole. I saw a sign promoting the birria tacos. Keep in mind that this restaurant is not related to Mi Pueblito truck that makes awesome birria tacos.

I was greeted by super friendly lady, very welcoming. 

Birria tacos: the broth was salty, not too much flavor. I would rather wait an hour outside for the truck.

Al pastor: small pieces of pork, missing the pineapple pieces, not too much flavor. It's a little bit salty for my taste.

I am addicted to this place. I always get the super poke bowl. 

I tried the sushi pizza, which is served in a pizza box. It's pretty big, I was full for the rest of the day after eating it for lunch. Completely covered with fresh tuna and salmon drizzled with spicy Mayo. Even the "folding crust " has some fillings in it. Highly recommended.

The fries with Tokyo sauce is really good because of the spicy sauce.

The sushi sandwich is another creation with a nice crunch

This new poke place has very cute artwork on the wall. Upon entering I was greeted by a friendly staff. You can read the menu on the plexiglass. You can build your own poke or get what is on the menu. 

I recommend the sushi donut with everything. It has delicious spicy tuna. Cute presentation for Instagram post. 

Service is super fast and nicely packed.

They also serve ramen. I had mine to go. My suggestion is that the bowl should be bigger to contain all of the broth.

The service was a disappointment this time. We were never served with water and tea. Our waitress didn't smile at all.

As usual roti canai is always delicious, thin and crisp.

Chicken satay was perfectly flavored and cooked.

I ordered fillet of branzino. It comes with mashed red potatoes and asparagus. The branzino supposedly had lemon and wine sauce in it but I didn't taste any, and it's a bit greasy. The mashed potatoes is more to the salty side. They served complimentary Italian bread. It's very crusty and when it's cold , the crust is  hard as a rock.

My seafood salad is pretty good although the grilled tuna I believe was from a can. It has a lot of olives. The shrimp and crab meat is good and sweet.

My mother in law ordered manicotti and the serving is generous and she enjoyed it.

Service is great, they took the finished plate really fast.

I came here because I wanted to try their brick-oven. I made a reservation with google, it's so easy.

I asked for indoor seating and got seated near the balcony with a nice view of the street. Our seating is also next to the kitchen who had Latino music being played. I felt like I was in a Mexican restaurant instead of at an Italian restaurant. 

They served warm bread which used the same dough as the pizza. So delicious with the olive oil dipping.

Appetizer: bruschetta. The bread was nicely toasted with generous chunks of tomatoes drizzled with balsamic vinegar. Highly recommended.

I ordered salad with seafood. I was expecting a dinner size salad but it was served in a small bowl. It's quite expensive for $18.

Eggplant pizza: the crust is doughy in my opinion. Good stretch and chewiness but lack of some crispness of the crust.

Tiramisu is quite delicious, I enjoyed the lady fingers soaked with the espresso.

Friendly staff and amazing fresh donuts. Get the fried chicken too. A lot of topping options for the fried chicken.

I recommend getting the fancy donuts, the glaze is amazing. They change the flavor quite often. The gentleman who helped me was so welcoming and nice

I like the idea of build your own food. When you come in you place your order on the screen. If you pay cash you will go to the back where they prepare the food. I built my own spring rolls and it took over 10 minutes to make three. I hope they can speed it up. Only one order stayed in tack, the other two are torn or busted out. 

The shrimp is fresh and the veggie version is very tasty with pickled shredded carrots and slices of tofu. The one with the pork has several thin slices of pork. The dipping sauce is very delicious with chopped peanuts. 

There are plenty of seatings and several TVs.

If you are looking for authentic Italian food, you should go to this unassuming place: an Irish bar called Murph's Bar in Fishtown neighborhood next to Hajimaru Ramen. You would think that you are served by an Italian nonna. They have outdoor door seating to enjoy the delicious meals.

I ordered mine for takeout. I was told that it would take 40 minutes. The girl who took my order was super friendly. CASH Only.

Seafood manicotti: pasta is fresh, not skimpy on the seafood fillings. Fully covered with creamy marinara sauce. Seasoning is on point. Medium serving size. Highly recommended.

Stuffed gnocchi: gnocchi are fresh, melts in your mouth with grape tomato and fresh basil and covered with grated Parmesan. Big portion size, it can be shared with two people. 

Lemon cake: pretty good  and sweet.

I will definitely come back to try more.

Honey is a fun place to sit and eat, there isn't anything special about the place but the food is fun.  It's a good place for breakfast, lunch and a quick snack.  You can eat outside or inside but come and enjoy the experience
Caramel banana pudding is really good. Definitely get this one. Apple crisp is good too.

Saturday is Pokè day for my husband and he always get the super poke bowl. Most of the time I call ahead and the food is ready within 10 minutes.

Don't forget to check out their special menu such as sushi sandwich, sushi corn dog, and kimchi or jalapeño arancini.

Service is great, staff is friendly and welcoming

I would give 5 stars but I deduct one because of the waiting time for the food to come out. FYI the seatings are very limited. I had veggie burger which was great. Very moist not too salty, with tasty pickled cabbage and guacamole. Our waitress was a sweetheart . I asked the bun to be substituted with rye bread and they complied. Baked Alaska is awesome. It came out still flaming. It has rum and coffee ice cream with barely tasted chocolate cake with tons of meringue. The duck fat fries is their signature. You can ask not to be fried in duck fat if you prefer. My husband who had it said it didn't taste anything different.

The almond croissant is big and very crusty. You definitely get the crunch of the flakiness. The almond filling is a smear of buttery crushed almond. Not my cup of tea. I prefer more fillings. My favorite is still Swiss House bakery. But if you are into garden crunchy croissant, you will like it.

The worst service ever. Waiting in line with one register open but eventually 2 open. I only ordered hot cakes but took forever to get my order. I asked if they have McRib but nobody knows what it is. One girl said if I meant McGriddle. Other customer helped me to describe what it was. One girl said she didn't know what I was talking about. I never go back here again

Great spacious outdoor dining experience especially in a nice night. Very relaxing atmosphere, definitely a hot spot in the Northern Liberty area.

I had frozen piña colada. Doesn't have strong alcohol, perfect sweetness. It's very refreshing especially in a warm night. 

My friend had frozen strawberry mango margarita and she enjoyed it.

Finally Penang is available for delivery at Grubhub. I ordered Singapore fried noodles and wanted extra shrimp but the only options are extra chicken or beef. So I put a note to substitute chicken for shrimp and I called the restaurant to confirm. The lady at the restaurant was super friendly and helpful. I had two orders for my workplace and I asked if they could deliver them together. She was very  accommodating.

Singapore fried noodles: the noodles is rice noodles, a little bit spicy. Flavor is on point. 

Satay is very flavorful and even better with the peanut sauce.

Peanut pancake dessert is interesting. The "pancake" is thin similar to the roti canai with peanut paste and corn. Not too sweet, it's ok for me, not memorable.

Of course I couldn't forget roti canai which will be  much better if you eat it fresh in the restaurant. However, with this COVID-19 situation I take any canai from Penang. The curry dipping is spicy and full of flavor perfect for dunking the chewy canai.
Mochi was hard and stale. Ice cream roll was hard. I had Ferro Roche. Fruits are frozen. You better off go to Chinatown

I had jumbo crab cake. I was expecting two big lumps but they were in my opinion a regular size if you go to a store. They are very tasty, not over seasoned with old bay, all crab meat. It comes with two sides. I pick two orders of grilled asparagus. They were perfectly cooked and crunchy with some chopped tomatoes. You get four spears of asparagus per order. The whole meal cost me $25. I think it's a little bit overpriced for what you get. 

Upon being seated you will get warm cheese peppercorns biscuit with maple butter.  The best seats in the restaurant is by the window overlooking beautiful Rittenhouse Square. 

When you sign up mailing list you can get buy one get one meal on your birthday.

Great quaint little restaurant with outdoor seating.  They recently did an expansion which looks great. I highly recommend the sea bass with crabmeat.  It was delicious and worth every penny of the pricey $54 price tag!!

This place is amazing! They have such a good variety of items for baking. Things that I didn't even know existed... They also have very nice and helpful employees. I wouldn't go anywhere else for my baking needs...
Sat on the balcony upstairs. Service was well informed and attentive.   Oysters and crab au gratin were excellent.

Sunday brunch is the best time of the week. Ella's provides an awesome atmosphere and a very unique menu that caters to different people (vegetarian options!!). I've had the veggie burger several times, and it's always good. There is usually a wait, upwards of an hour, for Sunday brunch so plan accordingly! You can order drinks and hangout on the porch while you wait. $10 (giant) mimosas during brunch! They are very generous with the champagne. *Drew and Pauly are the dream team wait staff. They are attentive, patient, and funny individuals who made this brunch experience worth 5 stars!*
This is a real bookstore.  Books stacked everywhere, the clerk sitting at a desk listening to classical music, pretty awesome.  It is a maze of books but you can find hidden treasures.

Very nice and clean place for intimate setting. 

Seaweed salad: decent size, very fresh and tasty 

Sashimi: very fresh, unique combination of fresh seafood such as octopus, some smoked white fish.

Takoyaki: very delicious, not greasy, very tasty. Highly recommended.

I took my friend here for brunch because she is a vegetarian and I heard really good things. It was pretty small inside so I would recommend having a reservation, thankfully they had a table for us so we didn't have to wait!!! We ordered the grilled pineapple, hearts of palm and avocado salad for an appetizer. It was so delicious!! I've never had anything like it. Then we each ordered the Po Boy Tacos and they were AMAZING!!!!!!!! Seriously so delicious! The tofu was perfectly crispy on the outside and so soft on the inside. I'm not usually a fan of tofu but these were amazing!! The sauce on the taco was so good!! I would def recommend coming here, the food is just a little pricy for the small portions, but def worth checking out!!

My review is for build my own salad and avocado toast. The salad is fresh and fast service. The avocado toast is great. A multi grain toast topped woth smashed avocado, corn, and I think pickled red onio. Highly recommended

Just had a very pleasant stay.  Was on the road and wanted a nice place to stop and found good reviews for the Nestle Inn.  I was able to get a room and they accommodated a slightly late arrival and there were baked goods waiting to welcome us.  It was in a pleasant urban neighborhood in walking distance of fun restaurants. The free breakfast was for the coffee shop next door and the $10 per person voucher gets a very nice breakfast.  The room was charming but not cutesy and very clean.  There was free parking in the lot next door (though we had to ask because it wasn't clear from the signs if we could park there.). The only critique besides the parking ambiguity was the fact that they didn't provide conditioner, just shampoo.  I would still come back again.

Very good bread. My favorite is the multigrain baguette. They can slice the bread for you. 

Most of their bread is sourdough based. Very crusty on the outside but you can taste the perfect moist chewiness of the sourdough. 

There are different varieties of French bread too, such as pain subsides levain, brioche, baguette, ficelle.

They sell dessert too, such as canelle (It's ok), brownies, bread pudding, cakes which you can by by the slice.

My husband and I had a leisurely glass of wine in the  lobby of Hotel Monteleone where we could hear the fun sounds of the Carousel Bar but we weren't in the middle of the bar scene. We decided to have appetizers at Criolla's and were very pleasantly surprised at the excellent service and the great food.  We enjoyed a  first course of the refreshing avocado and grilled shrimp appetizer and then each had a soup- crayfish bisque and the onion soup- they were both great! We shared the greens salad. It was a perfect light meal.

I was looking forward to have the roasted cauliflower. After I placed my order, I was told that it is not available. I was so disappointed. I ended up not eating anything. I will never come back again.

This small museum is a gem.  The architecture of the museum is an exhibit in itself.  The exhibits were diverse and interesting.  A good balance between classic and contemporary.  Only two floors but enough to fill an afternoon.  Worth the $10 admission.

This was THE best restaurant I ate at while I spent the week in New Orleans for CTIA 2012.  

I'm really not an oyster person but due to everyone's raving reviews of this place and their oysters, I was peer pressured by yelpers to order it.  

Boy o Boy... I DID NOT REGRET IT.  

Wow, sooooo flavorful! I could not stop dipping my bread in the oyster topping and sauce.  It was so garlicy, fatty, oily that it made my heart just fill with love.  No other way to say it.  

And this is coming from someone who never ever eats oysters.  

We also got a filled lobster which is pretty tasty and filling but the highlight truely were the oysters.  I saw people just order the chargrilled oysters and ate that alone.  

definitely DO IT.  get the char oysters and never look back!

The shanghai crabmeat pork soup dumpling is very good. The shanghai steamed pork dumpling is good too. The crabmeat dumpling is one of their popular dishes. I had stir fried noodles (ho fun), it is ok, not recommended.
Amazing sushi. My salmon salad is very fresh. Sushi are amazing. Wednesday is buy 2 get 1 free.
