I got a new prescription for glasses but didn't get them filled there so I can't speak to the optical center that's attached.

After being on vacation for almost a week and eating nasty fried fast foods/dinners out I was VERY happy to eat here! I got the Cobb salad and it was delicious, served with a small piece of yummy sourdough bread. It was a wonderful, fresh, healthy alternative to what I've been eating! =) Yeah for my regular diet!

Service was poor although our waiter was nice. We had to ask for menu and bread. Utensils were not clean. We had to ask them to be replaced. Ahi tuna tataki salad was good and well seasoned with nice complementing dressing.

I've been here twice and loved it both times. The servers were incredibly helpful and friendly, but non intrusive. The restaurant was busy enough that we had to wait for a table both times, but we were able to sit by the fire so I didn't mind. The beer selections on tap or in the fridges were a great mix of regions and flavors. And the food. The food was amazing.

The first time, we got too much food. We ate the cheese plate (which had a variety of good but different cheeses that change regularly), and although it was tasty enough that neither of us regretted our choices, we couldn't finish our burgers.

I judge basically any ale house/pub/brewery by their burgers, and by that measurement, Craft passes with flying colors. I'll be honest, recently I'd been bored with burgers. They were my default order when there wasn't anything else that jumped out to me at a restaurant, but I had so many they ended up mostly tasting bland and a little dry. Craft Ale House's were a revelation and reminded me why I love burgers in the first place.

The second time we just had their artichoke dip  and split one of their pizzas. The pizza itself was delicious both that night, and when we heated it up for lunch the next day. I didn't love it quite as much as the burgers, but it was still a delicious dinner, so I'm not going to complain.

In fact the only complaint I might have is that the salads weren't anything special (I'll probably forget about being healthy and opt for the fries next time).

I was incredibly glad to discover Craft Ale House and I look forward to going back.

Their specialty is the French toast bagel. It has powdered sugar and cinnamon on top. Get here early otherwise you won't get any. I got there before 10 and only six left, 

They have tie-dye bagels and lots of other flavors and lots of cream cheese options according to the menu. You can order sandwich too.

I paid $15 for 13 bagels.

Great Penstemon and local plants in the garden Shop. Fun whimsical garden art abounds! Stroll through the park, breathe in the serene beauty and then savor tasty morsels and quench your thirst with a little prickly pear lemonade in the cantina. It's all good!
Get the ribeye steak and eggs, and the peppered bacon. Incredible biscuits!  Years ago I had THE TROUGH, but you will need a nap soon after...

You'll notice upon arrival that this is where all the tourists end up, and to be fair they're not wrong. It has a wonderful view of the beach, amazingly delicious food, and I loved the kiwi margarita. I've heard there are other locations, but this one is the best. :)
Amazing service. Very friendly staff including the chef who explained the dish really well. The poke is authentic. The fish is marinated. Ahi shoyu is really good. The dessert is great too.

I got a car but not very satisfy with my payment. The bank tells you what they want from you and there is no way you can change it or fight it. They always win. The car was over price by 500 dollars and Tyler said that their was no way they can bring the price down that they have a no hassle price. Because of my interest being so high I ended up not buying the extended warranty that I wanted to buy. Again the nu hassle deal. They don't detail the cars like they supposed to but good thing I have a wife that knows how and now looks like new in the inside. We are having some issues with the car and I understand they are taking care of these issues but the worst part on is that the driver side heater not working and with this weather it really needs it. They need to check the cars better before they sale them. One last thing the car I got has hail damage on the top and they told me that they won't fix it because it is a use car. I don't know if that was the reason why the car was 500 over priced. It was not a 3000 car it was a 25000 car so why can't they fix it. Thank you

Absolutely the most friendly group of guys. We had the time of our lives jetskiing across the gulf. Didn't even think they would let us go out there, but we did! We ended up jetskiing towards the end of the storm, so our ride was cut short, but they gave us a credit for the next day. Awesome service and unbelievable experience!
The service is slow  but the sweet potato pancakes are worth the wait.  The chorizo patties are a good side dish.
For a Lifetime facility this is the worst one I've attended. Poor weight room housecleaning, machines too close together & surprisingly this place is ALWAYS busy.
Nothing exciting, but good consistent decent quality food at reasonable prices. An old standby you can usually trust wherever you go.

My wife ordered a small Beach Bird (BBQ chicken), my son and I ordered a large Chicago deep dish. This was a carry out, so my review does not incorporate sit down service or ambiance. My wife said her beach bird was good, but the deep dish was not good. The cheese overpowered the other ingredients, so the pizza tasted very salty, even though the tomato sauce was on top (tasteless and not enough). I'm originally from Chicago so I know deep dish, and this doesn't cut it. Also it was so greasy that it poured out of the box and got several stains on my shorts. Finally they only offer a small or large, no medium, so we got way more pizza than we could eat. If it weren't for my wife liking her pizza, this would have been one star.
Their Crab Rangoon is amazing. Probably the best I've ever had. The General Tso's chicken is great as well. I wish we had stopped here sooner after driving by a million times.

Does the SnS management not read yelp or better yet go in this restaurant. It is in disgusting shape, floor looks like it has not been cleaned in years, service is terrible.  

I have been 3 times and swear I will never be back.  All the same 3 times.  Terrible service, dirty restaurant, and an attitude from the staff.  

I had a burger, and Chilli 5 ways, waited 20 minutes and then they were out of cheese for the 5 way.  HUH!!!!!!

Come On SnS. - you are better than this.  Management needs to close this store down and get it in shape.  

3 Strikes you are out.  Never again!!!!!!

A lot of fun in great weather. Lots of food options. 

Make sure to get the Bavarian pretzel from Brauhaus.

Don't forget to look for freebies and food samples too.

Decent pizza. Ordered a meatball pie, they said that wasn't technically on the menu but could put them on. The meatballs were terrible. Dry and flavorless. The pizza however, was borderline delicious. Sauce and doe tasted great, maybe could've been cooked another 90 seconds but still very good. So, I would say get the pizza, not the meatballs. 

Delivery was incredibly fast. Like 20 minutes. 

Pizza 7/10
Meatballs -6/10
Delivery speed 10/10
Stumbled on this place, fried calamari for app, tender. Pastas are really good and service was excellent. I hope Steve our waiter sees this. Nicely done.

I had very friendly service.  Ann is particular was awesome very pleasant and kind and made a difficult situation better! Often understaffed at the desk, but probably everyone comes at once.  Customer Service 5 stars!  Truck was good.

Great food and service. I ordered Branzino with jumbo shrimps, which was special of the night. The waiter described the fish would be served in lemon sauce but I didn't taste the lemon at all. It was perfectly cooked, came with penne in marinara sauce. The pasta was al dente and the sauce is fresh. I had tiramisu for dessert. It was good although I didn't taste any liquor at all the way it was described.

Although there was a snafu during my movie (the projection abruptly stopped), the management kindly offered tickets to another movie as compensation. I appreciate the way that they handled the situation.
garlic, salsa , green corn tamales, big bowls of soup,  and heaps of guac... perfect to satisfy a craving for mexican food. wash it down with a 'rita or a glass of horchata!

Finally had the chance for my first sit down dinner at the restaurant. 

As always, I was greeted by a friendly staff. I made reservations through open table. Waited only several minutes and got seated near the kitchen.

Our waitress is knowledgeable. I was able to customize my salmon salad order by substituting  arugula with romaine.

My salmon was perfectly cooked. The salad has super crunchy potato strings that gives a nice texture to the salad. The roasted peppers elevated the flavor. However as I was finishing it I found it's greasy at the bottom of the plate. I didn't expect salad to be greasy at all. The size could have been bigger. 

My husband had some kind of roast beef sandwich in ciabatta bread. The bread was toasted so it had a nice crunch but still retains the softness on the inside 

My waitress only checked on us once for water refills. I expected more attentiveness.

Can't recommend this studio enough.  I've had work done by Gia Rose and Cassie O'Neal, and they're both amazing artists and awesome ladies.  The studio is a beautiful space with fantastic vibes.  I couldn't be happier with the work I've had done here.  I'll definitely be back for more tattoos.

A completely plant based, eco-friendly restaurant in Trinity? Yep, I didn't believe it either. There's a decent amount of seating inside. The menu contains so many options that it's overwhelming, a good problem to (finally) have if you're a vegan living in the area. Check the menu online if you can't see very well, because there are no paper menus available (saving trees, very cool!) - you can get anything from a smoothie bowl, to chickn wings, to an impossible burger! There's also a bunch of really great dessert options that I believe are also GF. As expected, it's all a bit pricey ($4 for a cupcake) but where else you gonna go around to find this many plant based options? Brilliant idea, cool place supporting veganism & saving the animals/planet!

My Spanish students and I have enjoyed end of the year fiestas at Qué Pasa for many years. Every experience has been outstanding: the food is delicious and is ready as soon as we arrive. The staff also converses with my students in Spanish, giving them the opportunity to practice their skills! As a result of the efforts of the staff and the owner, lunch at Qué Pasa is an experience that my students and I look forward to each school year.

Very big supermarket. A lot of selections of organic products. Definitely competing against Whole Foods. 

Very crowded but the register moves fast. There's express lines for 10 items or less. Very friendly staff.

There are samples trays however there's no labels. It will be helpful if there's a sign.

I took a star down because of that and because the cantaloupes on sale didn't look fresh. 

There are bulk sections for nuts and sweets including taffy. 

Cheap muffins and assortment bread including from Liscio bakery.

Very friendly owner. Very delicious prepared food. Ham pie for Easter is really good. Get the stuffed chicken. They sell chicken cutlets, eggplant parm, antipasto. There's instructions how to cook the food. You can order a whole stuffed chicken for a crowd. They have soups too

Tried it for the first time last night for a quick carry out dinner.  Ordered the Chicken Shawarma Original Palestine and a Classic Falafel.  Very tasty!  One of the better falafel versions I've tried.  Prices are great and the people on the staff were very friendly.  My wife and I both thought the food was quite good.

Will definitely be back.

Customer service is exceptional. Upon entering you're greeted by very friendly staff. It's very rare to find this level of friendliness. They even opened the door for me because my hands were full.

The right side is for bar. First come first served. I went there on Saturday on lunch time and it's crowded.

The right side is for dining.

You can buy some beer too at the entrance.

I was greeted personally by the manager, Matt. Very friendly guy who made sure my order is taken carefully of and explained me about some of my dietary concerns.

This place is kids friendly. It has kids menu. The menu has several vegetarian options and they can accommodate special dietary needs such as vegan and dairy free.

I ordered voodoo flat bread, pretzel sticks and stout chocolate ice cream to go. My order came out rather slow. But the front desk staff were so nice and engaging conversation with me. I recommend to call to place the order to go.

Voodoo chicken flat bread: decent size, my father in law enjoyed it.

Pretzel sticks: definitely get this. It's seasoned with sesame seeds, poppy seeds, and a touch of garlic. It's not a typical pretzel sprinkled with salt so it's not very salty. Perfect crunch and well balanced flavor. The mustard and cheese dip is great. I prefer to enjoy it without the dip. I dipped mine in my chocolate ice cream. It sounds weird but it's great . The dough is soft and moist.

Chocolate stout ice cream: very delicious. Highly recommend for nice ending to your meal. Not heavy and creamy. Very light and refreshing and not overly sweet. Perfect sweetness.

The website provides nutritional information and allergen list. 

I will definitely come back to try different things. I am looking forward to try the cheesesteak spring rolls and the crab cake.

Oh my goodness, this place is delicious! I went with a group of my friends for lunch and enjoyed everything we ordered. I highly recommend their garlic knots, super delicious! Of course their pizza was amazing and so was the staff. Looking forward to going back to try other things, and maybe even dessert!

Very smooth hummus. The hummus by itself it's plain but the chicken schwarma is full of flavor but not to overpowering. The chicken is very tender and juicy. When eaten together with warm pita, it's very good and light. You can have either plain or wheat pita

The food is overpriced given that the portions are very small. When we got our food it was cold and stale (we were never told we had to get our own food because the server does not take it to you and they never even called out an order number or name so we knew to pick them up). The asada meat had absolutely no flavor and was difficult to chew, meaning it was not fresh, and the al pastor was extremely red and much sweeter than it should be. If you're looking for an authentic Mexican restaurant in the sparks area I recommend El Taconazo, the food is amazing, and the portions are more reasonable for the price.

Very cute ice cream shop. Has several vegan options made from coconut milk. According to the website it's sweetened with agave syrup. I tried the baby size ok speculoos. It has crumbs of speculoos in it. The coconut flavor masks the speculoos, I barely taste it. Very strong coconut flavor.

The oatmeal raisin and orange creamsicle are pretty good. So far that creamsicle is my favorite. They are not non dairy.

Friendly service. I sampled before making decision.

Wow, I'm impressed. Really nice cream of chicken soup, not overseasoned, nice and delicate, with finely shredded, *very* tender chicken. It would be nice to get that soup (and/or salad) with a side of that soft, pillowy pita, or grilled/toasty/buttered pita...or fattoush salad... They'd do well to offer that good pita on the side for things! 

I got the lamb gyro, and they sent the side-sauces just like I wanted, but I wished I'd gotten the lamb kebab. I'd rather have had grilled whole lamb-meat chunks, tender, I hope. Next time!  They have tzatziki and hot sauce you can get on the side, and they're so good together.  It'd be good with avocado, onion, cuke, alfalfa sprouts & feta and all those Greek-saladish things on a soft pita, in with the felafel or kebab. It seems they're keeping it simple, but could offer these additions. A nice surprise: the order came with a lime wedge :) 

I ordered through Door Dash: super fast, hot, and a lower fee than for Grubhub. However, the menu was maybe half the size of the one at Grubhub. I chose Door Dash because it let me customize sauces. These apps often oversimplify menus, and I should call and talk to the restaurant as I order; they're always more accommodating than the apps.

So, I was almost thinking maybe this is a different place.  It is located on Haley ST, just up from State Street, but the entrance is almost across Haley street from the Holiday Inn and it seems a block down from the corner of State & Haley.  I think there are actually two bars in this bar.  But I've only been there twice and been in the huge warehouse-type room with tall tables in the middle and couches around the outside.  Pool table and darts in the back.  

I stopped in here because I was famished and ordered the Salmon salad.  It took a while but it was delicious.  The kind of salad I craved several times afterwards.  Plenty of delicious salmon grilled perfectly with herbs both succulent and a bit crispy, fresh fresh fresh, veggies.. no brown or dried out spots anywhere in this salad.  Plenty of avocado and the balsamic vinaigrette is one of the better I've tasted.  Not harsh like drinking vinegar like some vinaigrettes, the SB Brewery vinaigrette is almost sweet but with a pleasantly distinctive tang.  Definitely, whomever made the dressing, taste-tested it to perfection.  Oh and the goat cheese, yum yum!  

I came back here a few weeks later, stopping out of my way, just for this salad.  Again it was slow to arrive.. almost 30 minutes between ordering and being served... and it wasn't that busy. Yet it is so delicious, I would order again, any day I'm in the area.

The best ham pie for Easter. They have broccoli knish which is disappointing because I barely tasted the broccoli, and pizza knish which is better because the bread is soft with lots of pizza fillings.

They also make ground chicken meat loaf stuffed with spinach and another one with roasted pepper. They gave the instruction on how to reheat it on the container.

Unfortunately they charge 2 percent fee for using card

I came in because I always see girls posting that they need clients. and I needed my hair done that day for an event I was going to later. all other salons near me were booked for the time frame I had. so I made an appt on thurs for Friday morning. I  stated I wanted a sort of color correction. if they could even out my bleached hair which was like 1 or 2 levels off... they made me sign a waiver so they could put bleach in my hair. as they didn't recommend bleaching it and don't want to be held accountable... that I understand.. but the teacher told the student to use 10 vol developer... I know enough that 10 % will not lift at all... if anything half a shade or brighten a bit.... I got irritated.. but I was all ok. her teacher instructed her to do so whatever.. then she informs me she can't do the smudge root.. ok no biggie I'll reschedule... this is where I got annoyed. After rinsing the bleach the student didn't even put toner on my hair saying they couldn't mix color's after 3 or something... like wth!!! I held back my tears then she recommended I go buy a purple shampoo to tone it at home.. my hair was a level 8 yellowish gold!!! I had to leave with damn highlighter piss hair! I should have went to an actual salon. she wanted to blow dry it i declined and made up a lie that i was late for whatever. she had the nerve to tell me that she would get in trouble if i walked out with my hair wet. mind you it had no toner she told me to go home and tone it myself wth would I want my hair styled for... paid and left. went to Sally's got toner and bleach with 20 % developer.. and I did what they couldn't do. no I don't recommend ...unless your getting a haircut...that's the only thing I liked.
The review is for summer rolls: pork and shrimp; and tofu. Both are fresh and delicious. The key is the dipping sauce. Highly recommended

Beef pho special is really good. It has brisket, filet, and tripe. I ordered without noodles and tripe. The bowl is huge, it comes with sliced jalapenos, bean sprouts, basil, and lime. I did not put the jalapeno in. The broth has perfectly balanced flavor. The spring and summer rolls are highly recommended too. The dipping sauce for summer rolls is really tasty. The chicken for chicken pho is very fresh and juicy, you can have either dark or white meat.

After waiting for an hour, I am told that because the powers to be at Jefferson did not renew their licensure with my insurance, I would have to pay $65.00 for my visit, as opposed to my $30 copay. I exclaimed why should I have to pay $65 for your company's mistake and I received some cock-a-'many excuse. To make matters worse, I have been seen at this location multiple times so I had no reason to believe my insurance was going to be an issue. Jefferson needs to get their acts together and stop focusing on increasing their revenue and learn to focus on client relations and regain trust with their clients!
The beef and onion pie is really good. A lot of fillings. It's not too heavy in seasoning but the flavor is on point. The pastry is very crispy. Highly recommended

Firstly I will never go back to this restaurant because they required a charge of $20/ person to make a reservation and then included a 20% tip on top of that.  And then they had the nerve to say there were no cancellations.  Where do they think we are - in New York?  We were the only table in the restaurant and I'm not the least surprised with that policy!

On the flip side, we had a very good waitress who really helped us get through the very complicated menu.  The yogurt chicken and the green beans were very good; the curried lamb special was way too spicy-the pickled eggplant put the spice level over the top.
Wait staff wasn't very attentive. I'm posting this a little late because it was in my drafts, but overall there were interesting meals for vegetarians which is a plus.

I took my three kids here for an early Saturday dinner. The restaurant was not too busy inside and we were seated right away. The waitress was very courteous and polite. However, the service was extremely slow. We waited at least 10 minutes for our drinks, another 30 minutes for our food, and I had to ask for the check several times before the waitress brought it out to the table. Even when I went to the counter to pay, I stood waiting for 10 minutes for a cashier to take my payment. The food was great, but not worth spending an hour and a half here for what I thought would be a quick dinner.

I had the veggie burger. The patty was thin and there's more fillers than the veggies. The ciabatta bread was warm. I think it's a little bit pricey.

There are a lot of vegan goodies including CBD cookies

I had the 3 cheese slate, chef selected, for lunch.  I was in on the early side so there were only a few guests.  How is it possible that this place wasn't overrun?!  By far, it's one of the most unique and enjoyable lunch experiences I've found and I can't wait to go back.  Plus, I'll try dinner with my husband.  I suggest letting the chef select your pairings, they know the cheese!
The review is for the pop tarts made by Freedom Pies. I picked s'mores and peanut butter. Great crispy crust. A lot of fillings, not too sweet

Very friendly owner. Very delicious prepared food. Ham pie for Easter is really good. Get the stuffed chicken. They sell chicken cutlets, eggplant parm, crab cakes and other delicious homemade prepared food. Different kinds of soups are available in the fridge.

I have to update my previous review and give this business the 5 stars it deserves as a PIZZA place. 

If you read my previous review, you saw I said the meatballs were terrible, pizza was great. I'm sticking with that, but because meatballs weren't technically offered on the menu as a PIZZA topping, I'm keeping it as strictly my pizza review since I just got another margherita pie, and it's freaking great. I posted a pic a week or so ago. I swear on all that is holy, I have never had a better margherita pizza in my life. And I swear, I've eaten more than I should have. The sauce, the fresh garlic, the doe... It's all incredible. I can't order from anywhere else, not after this last experience. Delivery time cannot be beat anywhere, and the pizza, I can't say enough good things about it. I still say stay away from the meatballs, but if you want PIZZA. Get it. Get the chicken tenders too, I picked some of those up and they were great.

This is one of my favorite restaurants! I always take out of town guest here! The food is incredible and you can't beat the prices!! There is always a long line, but it goes by fast because the service is very fast paced! My favorite thing to order is the pork soup dumplings, soooo delicious!!! The scallion noodles and sesame chicken are also great!

Chicken schawarma: it's ok, not too much flavor, not memorable. You get a lot of chicken, though. I added fatoush salad. It's a small portion 
 I enjoyed the dessert more than the main dish.

Baba ganoush and muhamara are tasty with good flavor, perfect for dipping. Unfortunately the pita was a little bit dry , kinda stale although it is big.

Baklava is small but fresh with crispy phyllo. Not too sweet and not dry at all.

The date cookies and pistachio cookies are fresh and delicious, good amount of fillings . I definitely taste the rose water. Very authentic.

Kunafe was a disappointment. I was expecting shredded wheats, instead I got semolina kind.

I stopped by just to check out this new eatery next to Sabrina  and had the chance to talk to the owner who is super friendly . 

On the side wall you can find the menu. It's a neat place with a nice Philadelpha skyline painting.

At the back of  the store  you can find some groceries including gluten free and Kashi products.

They also have free WiFi
Very friendly service . Canele: it has hard shell and not too moist. Tiramisu: pretty good but the mascarpone is light. The lady finger is the best part with perfect sweetness.

Horrible service and very slow, even at the bar.  Could not even get a glass of water, even after asking for one! Took 10 minutes to get a menu, 20 minutes to get any attention even after the first adult beverage.  Instead of showing the Dodgers-Cubs game they show a 1996 replay of SEINFELD?!  REALLY?

This review is for the sushi. It's mediocre. A lot of rice not much sushi. 

Download the app to get special offers. I got protein bar for free.

Tried a few different smoke shops, then found Wassabi about 3 years ago. I don't go anywhere else now. Good selection of products, well laid out stores, and staff who actually know about the products. I highly recommend giving them a try if you haven't already!

Used to come here as a kid, my friend from high school used to work here, didn't have very good things to say about the cleanliness of the place, in fact he said it was the dirtiest place he's ever worked in and to never go there. I can't attest to that first hand but after hearing that I'd rather be safe than sorry
I'm a huge fan of this place! I've been eating here for years and they never cease to amaze me! Excellent food and great customer service! I definitely recommend this restaurant!

I've used this company twice and both times they've been great!  The drivers were super friendly and skillful at maneuvering the large trucks in my narrow driveway without running over my landscaping.  The drivers were always polite and happy.  I ordered the compost and mulch, both really good products!  I highly recommend this company.

This review is for the egg tarts. It's the best in Chinatown. The crust is very flaky and the custard is very soft and jiggly wit perfect sweetness. It's very delicate. Definitely get this.

The store has really good and a lot of varieties of moon cakes, the big ones or small ones.

Beautiful renovation and the courtyard/ patio would be s great place to schedule a special event, but the food was very disappointing. Using the waiter's suggestions, we chose two salads and two appetizers. The salads were not fresh- they tasted like they had been sitting in the refrigerator already prepared for at least a day. The appetizers had been reheated in a microwave - the oysters were tough- you could barely tell that they were oysters and the crabmeat tasted and looked like canned crabmeat. Very disappointing. The service was good.

I place my order through Uber Eats. The food came as scheduled.

Summer rolls with shrimp : there are three of them in one order. Perfect balance of vermicelli and the veggies. Thai basil is the dominant flavor. For my the key of good summer roll is in the dipping sauce. It's an ok sauce

My favorite Thai dessert is mango sticky rice. The sliced mango are very sweet and fresh. Unfortunately the sticky rice is very dense and missing the crucial part of the dessert : cream of coconut.
The peanut-filled snowball is really good. The filling is sweet and crunchy. At the end of the day, around seven, 3 for $1.50.. The almond butter bun is my favorite.

It all started great. We got a car and we recommended a customer and they also got a car. When I was buying my car I grab a snack and wanted to pay for it. They said no worries is all for free I set great. I been there 2 other time and still free snacks and drinks. Today I took my car for service in the morning and like the other times. I went to the snack/store grab a donut and ask the guy who was in charge that I was going to grave a drink. He responded those donut are not free and that nothing was free and also ask who I'm I and what was I doing there. That was not his business to begin with so I guess I have the I have to buy a car all the time I go to grab a snack. Don't know but this was unprofessional. I was fine until I started seeing employees grabbing drink and snack including himself he share a life water with a co worker. Maybe it's now free for employees only. Just wanted to write it down and let people know this experience.
The review is for the churros. It's fresh, not too greasy with sweet cream inside. Super friendly staff.

It's a small bakery at the corner of 13 and Reed.

Not many bread options. Seeded, not seeded, round Italian bread.

There are some pastries, bread, donuts, and heated fried dough. Bread is cheap $2.50 for long bread.

Very nice lady.

The Italian bread unfortunately is very hard. The crust is thick and hard, the bread itself is on the dry side.

Chocolate pastry is ok, not much filling.

I went here to watch Liverpool game and interested in the Vegan restaurant week menu. I was informed that 2 items from the list are no longer available because it's the last day.  I was disappointed. It's Saturday and it's 4 pm. I couldn't believe they were not prepared. I ended up only with black bean hummus with sweet potato. The hummus is smooth and perfectly seasoned.

The most authentic Indonesian food. It's a small corner eatery on Moore and Hicks street with tight seating area. You will see a lot of Indonesian theme decorations. 

It's a cafeteria style food where the foo is already cooked except the satay. You place the order on the cute hawker cart. The menu is posted on the food counter on the left, more menu listing is on the wall to the right. For to-go food there are options based on the size of the container.

Gudeg: stewed jack fruit. The flavor is perfect and balanced. Jack fruit is tender but not mushy.

Lodeh: mixed stewed veggies. Also has perfect flavor and refreshing from the fresh veggies.

Gado gado: big portion with steamed veggies and rice cakes with fritters on top. The best part is in the amazing peanut sauce.

Chicken satay; big chunks of tender chicken and not over charred . The peanut sauce is amazing.

All of the dishes remind me home.

My criticism here is I don't think staff record the order when I told her what I wanted so you're at the mercy of her memory. You pay when the food is ready. I had to double check my order which turned out to be incorrect.

Also most of the container is styrofoam. I wish it's more environmentally friendly.
Great sushi. Service was phenomenal. We sat outside with our dog and we enjoyed a nice meal.

The room is decent with fridge and microwave. The sink is outside the bathroom. I had to ask for a trash can. 
The toilet made bubbly noises once in a while. 

I stayed for the weekend where there's breakfast buffet. I asked the front desk about the time and he said 7. I went to the buffet at 7 and was told it would be served 7:30. Apparently I was not the only one who thought it started at 7. There were some people who came at 7 too. I could make some waffles at least.

Buffet includes
Selections of oatmeal. Unfortunately the water was not hot. I had to ask for hot water from the kitchen and finally they replaced it. Ceramic bowls for the oatmeal came out late too. 

Bread and bagels: there are only several slices of multigrain. I asked for more and after a while they refill it

Fruit loops and Cheerios. Taste stale

Home fries: delicious 
omelette: very good
French toast: pretty good a little bit too much nutmeg 
Canadian bacon
Sausage
Fruits: cut up pineapple, cantaloupe, and honey dew. On the table there are oranges and apples
Chocolate chip muffins: very good and moist, came out late
Yogurt 

Overall it's a tasty breakfast. I was really stuffed.

There's a gym with dumbbells, treadmills, elyptical machines. However I had to ask for towel. There's water fountain with no water. There's no wipes to clean the equipment. There's television but I couldn't find the remote.

Other people complained about the smoke smell and also the television and WiFi were not working.

Service is great, 24 hours help desk. Very helpful and accommodating. That's the only reason I add another star.

When you enter the parking lot, you need to turn to the left for the outdoor dining. The main building is for pickup.

As I was walking towards the area, interestingly I saw several geese. You can sit at the bar area to watch sports on tv. Plenty nice covered seatings . I like to sit near the creek, very relaxing way to enjoy the nature I even saw a rooster and heard it crowing.

The umbrella is big enough to provide me and my husband some coverings during a sudden rain. 

The staff is very friendly and attentive. We were given only one set of menu for both of us and I had to ask another. I was told that they only gave one menu per table. I think it's an inconvenience as we would need to take turns. Fortunately she complied to my request.

I was interested in crab cake and asked if they are homemade. Unfortunately they are not.

I wanted the summer shrimp salad. Unfortunately they were out of it, so I ask for grilled chicken instead. The chicken is dry but the salad is fresh. My husband enjoyed the spicy chicken sandwich. 

I definitely will go back to try for the wings. They are well known for it and featured at Food Network.

I had the flounder stuffed with crabmeat. It comes with salad and 2 sides. Salad is fresh. Gus is perfectly cooked with good amount of cram meat which has perfect seasoning. Unfortunately I found a piece of shell in the crab meat.

Carrot cake is big as it has 4 layers. The cake isn't too sweet with some chopped walnut. I was expecting more nuts , raisins, coconut, or pineapple, not many shredded chicken coconut either. The sweetness is in the cream cheese icing.

Summer rolls: chicken and shrimp. So far it's the best I've ever had. The rice wrap isn't too chewy, the vermicelli isn't dry. The chicken is tender. The dipping sauce is really good. It's a mix of peanut butter and hoi sin sauce with some chopped peanuts. Definitely get this.

Vietnamese crepes: it's like omelette but crispy filled with pork and shrimp. It's really good. The flavor in the egg and the fresh veggies comes together. It has some greens on the side and I believe pickeled carrots.

Lotus salad is really refreshing.

Wet ho fun aka flat noodle with seafood is disappointing, lacks of flavor the dry version is a little bit better but it's still meh. Not recommended.

I ordered three different kinds of blue masa tamales for Christmas Eve. I ordered the through its Instagram account. My order was ready when I got there. Super nice lady who remembers me from last visit.

All tamales are delicious, perfect firmness of the masa, generous fillings.
Very friendly staff. Spacious and clean. Line moves fast. The sizzli is very good and fresh. Really good. There are croissant, English muffins, bagels, or French toast base sandwiches.

If you want awesome wings, you gotta try this place. The wings are huge with lots of meat. They are breaded and topped with the toppings of your choice. I had garlic Parmesan. In my opinion they are not too garlicky. However, they are pretty oily.

There several options of the toppings for the wings. If you want to have varieties of flavor you need to order several orders of 10 wings. 

The food is served as if you are ordering for takeout. The waitress gave us several paper containers for the bones and wet wipes because eating the wings are messy. 

I recommend sitting outdoor when the weather is beautiful. There was live music when I went there on Saturday night. 

You can read the menu by scanning the QR code.

Burgers writ large.

I had business near here and stopped in for dinner.  There was a brief wait - 10 minutes or so - until I got seated.  The server was quite pleasant, and knew the menu.  I had a cold Corona while I tried to decide on which burger to try.  I also saw a number of them delivered to other tables and some were behemoth burgers.  I landed on the BNE.
 
 1/2 lb beef patty | bacon | fried egg
hash brown | lettuce | tomato | red
onion | mayo | burger sauce
sourdough | 18 1⁄4

It came with a large bowl of hand cut fries.  It was not their largest burger, but was certainly bigger than most.  It was fresh, tasty and quite filling.  

I do see that franchises are available and would love one of these come to Calgary.  Until then, I will try and get back to this location.

Came here for lunch because of Instagram post on shot rib and mushroom pie.

There are probably 4 or 5 chunks of beef, but half of the chunks are mostly fat. The beef isn't hard and the crust is so crispy. I won't order this again.

Their breakfast and bagels are good but their muffins and spreads are amazing. The coffee is not the best, usually watered down, not very strong. But they do have a good variety of food and drinks. The staff is nice and helpful.

Truly terrible. Quite honestly the worst "Italian" food I've ever had. Chef Boyardee is better than this. The decor is dreadful and has a very rundown feel to it. I know some people swear by this place but I don't see why, even chain Italian restaurants destroy this place in the quality Italian food department.

Saw a article abt their traditional thanksgiving meal, thought it would be interesting to eat there. so when my friends were visiting philly, i took them there for their traditional thanksgiving meal. It was $98 per person. We were super excited about it. All the serves were dressed like 18th century. That was definitely very cool. However, the food definitely did not turn out to be as good as we were expecting it. It wasn't bad but It's definitely not good enough for $98 per person. And not to mention the super poor we got!! We waited almost 15 minutes for our server after we sat down. And waited 45 minutes for our salad. Didn't get our bread until we were getting the salad. The bread was also cold when we got it. And we also didn't get any utensils neither. How are we supposed to eat our food? With bare hands? The light was so dark but we were the only one didn't get a candle, we had to asked three times for it. 
Over all, it was not a great experience:( i was so excited about it

I went there on the second day after grand opening on November 1. They have free coffee for the opening weekend. The staff is very nice and friendly. I took a star down because they didn't keep up with the breakfast sandwiches. I could only get bacon egg and cheese kind and there were less than 10 left. A group of people was waiting for more supplies. It's a very spacious store and the line is moving fast.

Sunday school was a great finish to a perfect beer Sunday.

Headed to Trias late Sunday after recovering from the awesome experince at Monks cafe. It was hopping for a Sunday night, but Philly isn't sleepy town CT. Managed to get a seat at the bar between to couples.

The Sunday school was a great deal, I passed on the wine special but tried the cheese and beer specials.

The spicy crab stuffed Picadilla peppers were excellent. 

Bartenders were pretty busy but friendly.

Due to COVID 19, the only way to enjoy food is through delivery. Fortunately this place offers delivery through the website. It's easy to navigate.

I called before placing my order because I have a question about the guacamole. The lady who picked up my phone is super friendly. I asked if it is spicy and she said it's mild. 

My order came as scheduled and the delivery person is very friendly and courteous.

As she described, it has some kick but doesn't make you have a runny nose. It's fresh with fresh chips. Even my husband who isn't a guacamole fan said it's delicious. Unfortunately I found the stem of avocado in it. Be careful eating it.

Burritos: carnitas and al pastor for my husband and father in law. They said they are good.

Side of cactus: it's fresh with some onion, I really enjoyed it, not too salty.

Tiramisu: to my surprise it's is pretty good. It's small and unfortunately couldn't maintain its form during transport.

Tres leches: very light sponge cake, not soupy with milk, not overly sweet. I taste some pineapple. 

Flan: not too sweet, perfect density.  Great dessert. 

All of the dessert isn't big.

The containers are environmentally friendly. It's always a plus to order from here. 

Definitely recommend this place.

My review is for the macarons. Six pieces for $17, $3 each. The box has Macaron Cafe NY.

My favorites: dark chocolate, espresso/coffee, and Nutella. The dark chocolate has generous layer of chocolate. All of the macarons are fresh, moist, and some chewiness with generous flavorful butter.
cream filling

Tamales only available for weekends. It's ok, I expected more fillings.

Mole enchiladas is so good. Chicken is very tender. Tortilla is fresh and soft, melts together with the chicken. Flavor is on point. Not too spicy. Very authentic.

Staff is very friendly and welcoming.

Order through Grubhub because of free delivery and $5 off, it's a good deal. I was expecting my food to be delivered at 1:05 but got noticed that it's delayed to 1:35. That's a little bit disappointing because it would pass my husband's lunch time so the meal became dinner instead of lunch. Fortunately it arrived at the new ETA.

Spicy pork: decent portion size, packed with rice. Pork slices are thin but tender and not dry. However, it's not too flavorful, needs sesame oil and soy sauce, a little bit bland. It asked for level of spiciness and I wanted spicy. The pork as is without extra gochuchang isn't spicy at all. They put extra gochuchang on the side.

I really really enjoyed the atmosphere, loved the live musician/guitarist and how gorgeous it is inside. I chose poorly from the menu (slow BRAISED BEEF SHORT RIBS wild mushroom bread pudding, red wine reduction) and was not really impressed with their food. The "ribs" looked like chuck roast and tasted a bit bland. The bread pudding was not very tasty but I've never had bread pudding before. I did not finish my entree. 

Believe it or not, I would try it again but, unfortunately, I would stick to something SAFE. I enjoy trying new foods but it didn't work out for me so well here.

Usually on a Friday/Saturday night this place is pretty busy. I've had to wait in a line that went all the way out the door before. However, the line moves pretty quickly and the space is pretty large so you are sat in a timely fashion. 


The food is great. We always order the soup dumplings and scallion pancakes. Everything is very very affordable, even with a large group of people
You're not going to be breaking the bank. 

The food comes out as it is ready so dishes come to the table pretty rapidly. 

Service is good. 

It's also a BYOB I've seen people in there with straight up handles of alcohol so you do you. I think they offer fountain drinks and maybe coffee?? 

It's definitely a great place for larger groups, we typically are in attendance with about 5 or 6 people. It's kind of loud but as to be expected because like I said it's usually pretty busy. 

If you're not into waiting in lines I'd recommend that you check this place out during the week. 

Ps. Don't forget that it's cash only but there is an atm right when you walk in.

A completely plant based, eco-friendly restaurant in Trinity? Yep, I didn't believe it either. There's a decent amount of seating inside. The menu contains so many options that it's overwhelming, a good problem to (finally) have if you're a vegan living in the area. Check the menu online if you can't see very well, because there are no paper menus available (saving trees, very cool!) - you can get anything from a smoothie bowl, to chickn wings, to an impossible burger! The Mac n cheese was kind of on the rich/sweet side, but still good. There's also a bunch of really great dessert options that I believe are also GF. As expected, it's all a bit pricey ($4 for a cupcake) but where else you gonna go around to find this many plant based options? Brilliant idea, cool place supporting veganism & saving the animals!

Very helpful staff who gave me recommendations on what to pick. They have the menu on the wall with the calories information 

Açaí bowl is sweet, granola isn't too sweet so it's not overwhelming. The strawberry was a little bit mushy. Blueberry is fresh and pretty big.

Oatmeal bowl: steel cut oatmeal is perfectly cooked, I picked banana with dried figs and walnut for topping dusted with cinnamon. It's not sweet at all so I felt healthy eating it.

I was told that they don't add any sugar.
This review is for the amazing lobster tail. Crunchy shells filled with sweet French cream. Get the Nutella. However I think they are much smaller than those posted a year ago.

The review is for the fried pickles. My husband really enjoyed it.

You place your order on the station where you can see the description of each item of the menu. 

Very fast service and nice staff

The food is amazing here. Friendly staff and fast service. He helped me pick the dish as I told him I was looking for something not spicy.

Onion dosa: loaded with red onion. 

Malabar porotta was served warm and fresh perfect for dipping in the sauce of the entree.

Chicken talassery is very delicious. Full of flavor from the herbs, well balanced seasoning . Chicken is perfectly cooked. Highly recommend.

I got the cannoli and they  are pretty delicious. It's home made and definitely the same quality as the top Italian bakery in Philadelphia.

The roast pork is amazing and you have to serve it for n Cacia rolls because they are dense so they are able to soak up and hold the broth and make the sandwich wet . I always put good quality provolone, sharp provolone if you like stronger flavor, top it with sliced yellow and or hot peppers. You can ask the cheese and peppers there but I think it's extra cost. If you don't have them at home, I recommend adding it and worth the cost.

Great bread with nice bread. The garlic Parmesan boule is good. Well known for the Italian bread and pizza. On Sundays they made amazing roast pork. For Easter they make delicious Easier cookies. Cash only. Parking is a challenge. For Thanksgiving you can have your turkey roasted in their oven. They have wheat rolls too. They sell pasta in the freezer.

This review is for the dessert.

Babka: very interesting version of babka. Very dense with chocolate chips and raisins with streusel topping which fell apart. $7 for a slice which is a big slice. $20 for a loaf.  Delicious.

Rugelach: full of fillings with buttery pastry.

Apple streusel: a lot of apple fillings.

Dark chocolate cake: very big and rich in chocolate. Very delicious. One slice can be made 4 servings

All of the cake is supersize including the biggest eclairs I've ever seen.

Don't forget to grab the chocolate chip cookies too.

I was so lucky to be able to eat their fresh and warm pineapple bun. It's so soft and light like eating cotton candy. 

The pork bbq bun is delicious, authentic Chinese bbq flavor, good amount of fillings

Best grouper sandwiches on the beach ! Enjoying family time , beach and sunsets.
I love the smoked fish spread too!!

I'm struggling to write this review. I'll start with the fact that it's so cool that there is now an exclusively vegan spot in Safety Harbor. Located right on Main Street, this restaurant hits that previously untapped market.

Unfortunately, that's where the positive aspect ends. I came here on a Saturday afternoon, right around 4:45pm. The place was empty, which doesn't matter much to me. There was plenty of space inside, and this is a sit down and order establishment. I ordered the Rangoon and Gouda Mac & Cheese - both of which were extremely disappointing. The Rangoon were so tiny, so dry, and overall flavorless. The sweet & sour sauce made them edible, but they were not worth the price. The Mac was nothing extraordinary either, but the better of the two entrees. Think - velveeta.

I'm not sure if I made a mistake in what I ordered, or if this was due to the restaurant only having been open for less than an hour when I arrived (which shouldn't matter), but I have no desire to return. There was a handful of pantry items for sale, which is a nice touch. And my server was very kind and attentive. But the food just did not do it for me, at all. I appreciate the concept and hope to see this place thrive in the future.

It's a new healthy eatery at Rittenhouse square area. I saw it being featured at 6 ABC.

Very clean looking spot with some seatings at the back. You can see fresh fruits and veggies on the wall.

Very friendly service. The meal is made to order on weekends.

Harvest bowl: I substituted kale with romaine. It has perfect combination of greens with quinoa, sweet potato and chickpeas with hummus on top. Very healthy and delicious. Mine is to go on an environmentally friendly container.

Hummus with baby carrots, cucumber, and whole grain pita. The hummus is good but the pita is hard. That's why I took a star down.

I recommend to call to order because I had to wait a while.

Definitely come back.

Delicious and authentic Mexican food.

Beef tongue tacos are my favorite. It's very tender but still maintains the cube shape of the meat. Taste like beef. Flavor is on point.

Red tamales is spicy but delicious

My review is for the pastries. They are made by Machine Shop who makes amazing baked goods. There are raspberry kouign amman, croissants, and cannele.

Their pastries are very flaky and crispy. The cannele is very moist inside but has a nice outside texture with perfect sweetness.

My concern is I saw a fruitfly flying inside the case which is open on the side. It hop on top of one of the croissant.
I went there in the morning looking for the sizzli but again it's empty. They didn't make a lot so they are gone in a second. Terrible and dissatisfied.

Very delicious chocolate chip cookies. I was lucky to try when it's still hot. You can smell the butter. 

I follow their Instagram and took advantage of $1 for the chocolate chip cookies which is usually $2.

This review is for the Reading Terminal Market.

This review is for the shrimp fajitas. To my disappointment the shrimps and bell peppers lack of flavor although the veggies are fresh and perfectly cooked. The refried beans is very runny and not appetizing. The red Mexican rice is the ok. It comes with warm tortillas. I don't recommend this at all.

Called ahead to check market price on oysters. Arrived shortly after and the server sat us at a table on the patio. She brought us our drinks and took our order. We ordered oysters & salad. 25 minutes (!!!!) later, the server came to the table and informed us the restaurant ran out of oysters. 25 minutes later! We left.

First time at Clementine's this week and service, food, and overall experience was impeccable. Go try any of their meat and fish dishes. Portions are generous, every plate comes with bread /soup / a beautiful salad and starter garnish plate. Best part is every meal comes with a slice of their homemade pies (tons of flavors to choose from). Patty was our server, and she was hands down one of the top servers I've ever had. Very knowledgeable about the dishes, what to order, and 10/10 on her customer service-- you can tell she truly cares about her customers and wants them to leave happy and full. Amazing dinner, great wine and comfort foods! Highly recommend for an amazing meal with superb food and service. Thanks for everything staff @ clementines!

I had the banh mi salad with salmon. The cucumber is diced into small dices. The pickled daikon is really good. The nuts are finely chopped too that gives crunchy texture. My salmon is on the well done side.

My husband had chorizo sandwich and it's really good. Flavor is on point. Highly recommended.
Great slices of pizza. Rolls and Italian bread is fresh and crusty but soft inside. For Easter they make sweet Easter cake, either round or wreath for bigger crowd . Highly recommend

About 2 1/2 years ago we bought a kia 2012 Sportage. They did not disclose everything about the used cars to us. And by law, they were supposed to disclose everything about the car specifically when an engine was recently replaced. What they did, they called us 3 days later and told use about what they had not disclose to us. Yes they made us sign a paper about telling us that the engine of the car had been replaced. Never offered a warranty on or at least a service contract or something. Now my Kia's engine is a total lost. They try to help and for me to ask Kia corporation to help out because they said part of the engine failure was due a recall on the engine not being done on time. But honestly due to Covid-19 nothing was done in time.Well we got the end of the stick now we have a total loss car that cost more to fix it then what it's worth. And still old payments on it. 
Basically be careful out there when you purchase a car with them. Don't know if they don't always disclose everything to there customers when they have to. 
Funny after I talk to one of the managers in the dealership, beside my car not working at all. He even offered me $3,000 for it and put it towards another car. To try to cover it up there mistakes.
The roast pork is out of this world. The best I have ever had. Only available on Sundays. A container can make 4-5 sandwiches. Ask for provolone and peppers on the side.
I went here around 8 and again no sizzli is available. Only hash browns. Very disappointed

When I entered this restaurant I felt like I was entering the land of the giants. All of the desserts are humongous. 

On the top shelf of the cake display you will see giant six layer cake. You can buy them per slice mostly $9.75.
The cake options among others 
Chocolate peanut butter
Chocolate raspberry 
Funfetti
Chocolate 
Cannoli
German chocolate

On the middle shelf you will see cheesecake: strawberry and chocolate swirl (if I remember correctly)

On the bottom shelf you will see giant eclairs, black and white cookies, streudel. Also containers of Boston cream pies, Lemon meringue (maybe? I saw the meringue topping), and others.

On the left of the cake displays you can find cookies, a lot of varieties of rugelach and hammentaschen. The rugelach and hammentaschen are fresh and the pastries are soft. Good amount of fillings.

One  cake slice is so big that you can feed 4-6 people. The cake is moist and sweet. I got chocolate peanut butter, chocolate raspberry, and German chocolate. All of them have the same chocolate cake but the icing and the fillings between layers makes the difference. 

The coconut macaroon is as big as a soft ball. Further down to the right I saw giant knishes. 

Next time I want to try the sandwich which will be ginormous too.

Like the other reviewers, I had an awful experience with Dr. Wilke!! Went in with a small problem....after spending 10 minutes telling me how minor it was and how other people have it much worse (!), she then told me how it couldn't really be cured. I pressed and pressed for answers and she *finally* gave me some ideas for handling it. Honestly, it was like pulling teeth getting any information out of her. Her staff then messed up the prescriptions multiple times, requiring about 10 call backs. What a complete nightmare. Worst doctor I have ever seen. New podiatrist (at a different office) is very pleasant and very competent and my issue has RESOLVED, with her help.
The steamed chicken is fresh and perfectly cooked. Be careful for small bones. My coworker had chicken pho and she enjoyed it very much.

This review is for the dark chocolate covered pretzels.

I follow the Instagram and found out that they have 50 percent off on chocolate covered pretzels that day. Very friendly staff. The pretzels are very crunchy and bigger than common chocolate covered pretzels. The chocolate is thick and not too sweet. It's very delicious and addicting.
Dine In was great, the Carne Asada and garlic shrimp was fantastic.  The Murrietas margarita was strong,  and the service was great.  92° outside and it was pleasant inside....

Very nice hotel. Man who checked me in was great. I got a room in the VIP tower for $93 and it was very very nice. Also put me on the concierge floor so breakfast was included. Not smokey in the casino. If I come back to Reno I will stay here again
The ba ba rum cake is to die for. The pesca ala creme (it looks like a peach) is a must

Ricotta cannoli is highly recommended, great crispy shells.
Everything here looks very enticing. The papal s'more has a beautiful browning of the marshmallow.
This Wawa is going downhill in terms of cleanliness. I went to ATM and smelled a strong odor of urine as if In a filthy bathroom. I was very nauseating. I was even wearing a KN95 mask.

An unexpected gem! Came here for the first time for Sunday brunch and would highly recommend! Got in right away.. no wait time (unlike other brunch spots nearby who have a 1-2 hour wait), and their food is SO GOOD! Wholesome, home style, comfort brunch food. I was really craving banana walnut pancakes, and even though it wasn't on the menu, the waitress was super nice about it and went back to ask the chef if it was possible. The spicy chicken and waffles is also amazing! We will definitely be returning!
Lots of choices if macarons and adorable truffles. However I saw a fruit fly in the truffles display that deterred me to try.
I had one experience there.  Was fast, no crowd.  Got right in and out to renew plates.  Wife had a similar experience.

Thousand layer bread: the bread is greasier than Penang's roti canai but the chicken curry dipping sauce is very delicious. The chicken is moist with great flavor.

Mandalay nungyi noodles: very fresh soft noodles. The flavor is in the chicken. I really like it. 

My husband ordered the Northern Burmese noodles and he likes it. It's spicy.

The pork, peanut, and mushroom is very delicious. Perfect flavoring and perfect density  the sticky rice. The pork is in big chunks and peanuts give the crunchy texture. 

However the sweet one is super duper dry. It's a waste of money.

The snowball is filled with ground peanuts and coconut. Very good with a lot of filling but doesn't stay together, the balls tend to open up

There is a spacious room upstairs for dining in. It's a BYOB restaurant, Hale and True Cider is across the restaurant, so convenient for having a nice dinner. Our server was very friendly. We started salad. The portion was big so it's shareable. 

They have gluten-free pizza to accommodate those with special dietary needs. It tasted like flat bread. The regular pizza is pretty good, the crust wasn't too thick so it wasn't a heavy meal.

I came here because of the dorayaki that I saw on the menu. I was so disappointed after finding out that it's not available and when I asked when it would be available I was told that they didn't know.

The place looks so clean with some seatings. It used to be a karaoke place near intersection of 11 and Arch.

Judy, whom I assumed to be the supervisor, helped me picked the tea that I wanted to try. She explained each kind pretty well but I didn't get clear answer about Da Hong Pao tea. She said it's a kind of oolong tea.

Peach oolong tea without the cheese foam. It's perfect peach flavor and sweetness without overpowering the tea flavor. Very refreshing for hot summer day. I add bubble and red bean. The additions didn't interfere the flavor of the tea. 

Taro bubble milk tea. The base of I'm not mistaken is black tea. Again it has well balanced flavor of tea and milk.

All of my tea was hot but the temperature was perfect. Not too hot that you have to wait to drink it. The bubble isn't black and not too big. Perfect chewiness and portion. The mashed taro is at the bottom so you need spoon to eat it.

I think they need to put the sugar level requests just like the other tea places.
The cups are not made with styrofoam. It's a very sturdy paper cup with a stopper on the drinking opening so it doesn't get messy during travel. The bag has cup holders so it prevents accidental spills.

I will come back to try different kinds and wait for dorayaki. I feel like I am doraemon waiting for his favorite food.

Although the sign by the door says open at 11 on Saturday, they actually open at 11:30
Awesome chicken fingers and beer selection. Should cook wings a little more to make them crispy though but otherwise good!

My family and I love coming here! By far one of the best breakfast spots in town! I've yet to taste a meal on the menu that disappoints! Although they get quite busy, the staff does a great job making sure no one is left unattended and always have a smile on their faces! If you haven't given em' try head on down! You won't regret it!
This review is for the chicken parm sandwich. The bread is burnt, the sandwich is dry, and the chicken is very thin. Very disappointing.

Amazing dinner experience. The waiter and waitress are also the singers who sang beautifully. Food is excellent. My salmon was perfectly cooked with delicious sauce. Berry salad was very good. Tiramisu is good too. My only complaint is they were already out of pork chop and zablagione although we were there early. Definitely coming back.
Great breakfast -- good OMG scramble with lots of flavors. The bananas foster pain perdu was delicious with bacon.  Biscuits were good.

Even on a Tuesday afternoon at 4 there was live music.  It was absolutely a hoot!  There is a definite dive bar atmosphere, bottled beer only.  We had the yucca fries which were very thick cut and softer than french fries, but quite good.  A great venue.

This review is for poke bowl. Very fresh salad and fish. I always have build my own salad bowl. The salmon is not really raw. They seared it on one side and seasoned with pepper. The tuna is raw, however.

There are not many selections of toppings compared to poke bowl in Chinatown.
This place has the most outstanding selection of aquarium supplies of all kinds! If you want it, chances are they have it. The staff is extremely knowledgeable as well!

Mediocre Mexican food. Portions were kind of small. I only had enough meat to make 2 fajitas with. Food was fresh but lacked flavor, it had virtually no spice in it. Service was acceptable but nothing special. Even the menus had several spelling errors. The only high point was the very cold beers. If you want A+ Mexican food go to Border Cafe.

I want to give this place 2.5 stars. Overall a wholly mediocre Italian restaurant. The garlic bread wasn't very good for it to be labeled "soon to be famous." My baked ziti was pretty awful due to the meatballs being bland and just crumbling like sawdust in your mouth, which made it just gross. Most people find the meatballs in their food as a gift and hunt for each one to eat but i hunted for them to remove them from the dish. My wife liked her gnocchi however. Service was average and I did like the decor since it didn't try to hit you over the head with the Tuscan theme crap you see at every other Italian restaurant.
Great food and service. Highly recommended. Free meal on your birthday and free ice cream with Yelp check in.

Family owned wholesale and retail nursery for over 50 years! The staff and certified sales personnel are friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable. Great spot to find colorful annuals to spruce up your pots, herbs for the kitchen, or perennials to fill in the xeriscaped backyard.

First time here - I will be back. 

Not sure why it took me so long to try this place out, but I am very glad that I did! Great experience from the staff to the food. Started with easily the largest mussels I have ever seen, served in a savory Bloody Mary sauce. Dinner was two brick oven pizzas. The Margarita pizza was fantastic. Only miss of the night was the arugula & prosciutto pizza which was hard to eat and missing something. My girlfriend had a spicy margarita that she really enjoyed. 

Can't wait to come back and try more menu options!

Great food. Even better whiskey selection. Easily one of the best in the city. Bar tenders and absolutely phenomenal, great to talk to about the bourbons and whiskeys. My only reasoning for not giving Fette Sau a five star rating was the prices are some what high. Walking in there thinking that you're going to a regular old barbecue joint then racking up $100 tab before you even hit the bar was some what of a shock. All things considered, the experience was good and I'd gladly go again.

There's this place in the middle of the Adirondack Mountains in New York called Old Forge Hardware where you can pretty much find anything under the sun.  New Market Hardware brings back memories of Old Forge - only New Market doesn't sell novelty items, that I know of.
I go to New Market when I have a hardware need and they are open.  It's one of those friendly neighborhood hardware stores where you can get a handful of nails for a dollar.  
Everyone I've come across there is always friendly and extremely helpful - and you will probably need to ask for some help locating what you need or you could get lost in everything they have.

My first açaí bowl. They give out samples during lunch time. Very friendly and helpful staff. I asked for a sample of the pitaya and they gave it to me and my friend.

Pitaya is sweeter than açaí. There are displays of how a bowl looks like. Basically it's a layer of granola, acai, granola, topped with banana, blueberry, strawberry, and coconut. You can add more toppings to which cost $1.25 each. I don't think it's worth it. You can get only a dollop of the nut butter or cookie butter. 

It's really refreshing and perfect sweetness. It comes in 3 sizes: kids, regular, and super.

They sell granola and granola bars too. 

They also have loyalty card. 

Definitely a great dessert spot.

Plenty of seatings including the upstairs

This review is for the bread. All of them are sourdough based. The potato bread is very soft and nice outer crust. Perfect for sandwich. The same bread served at a kitchen.The multigrain is very chewy but the crust is very hard.

This is an amazing place. I'm sure it's crazy given that it's super bowl Sunday. They delivered my order in a timely fashion. Food was hot. They even added the additional requests. I would absolutely order from king of wings again. Plus these wings are delicious. Go birds!!

BEST SZECHUAN IN PHILLY! Jane G's blows Han Dynasty out of the water. My first taste of Dan Dan noodles was from Han Dynasty and they were delicious. When I tried Jane G's, my mind was blown. The flavor, the spice, everything is delicious. I have tried their Kung Pao Chicken, General Tsao's Shrimp, and Dry Pepper Chicken, and all of these dishes were absolutely delectable. Very fast delivery to your door as well, especially considering there's only one of them in the city. (Pro-tip - ask to hold red peppers with your dishes, they add a lot of extra baggage to your plate and you don't end up eating them anyway) Been living here for about 3 months and have already ate there at least 10 times and will continue to do so!

Will preface this with they were visibly working through their opening glitches and kinks. Overall our service went smoothly minus a couple of very minor mis-steps (such as bussing our silverware after our appetizer). Had the tater tot poutine and it was AWESOME. Also had the pimento and jalapeño hot dog which was very good. I can safely recommend both. My wife's burger was uninspiring. We both had soda with cherry syrup added and really enjoyed the childhood memories that brought back. Will definitely be returning and exploring other menu options.

Granted I have absolutely nothing to compare this Philly Cheesesteak to, but I thought it was amazing. Got the classic with whiz, and onions, and am now STUFFED. Delicious! It was a hike to get there (we took a cab) but totally worth it! Yum!!!
This review is for margarita pizza. The crust is moist and not greasy at all with fresh tomato sauce
Grabbed lunch here while downtown on my second day of jury duty.  The flying pig made my day.  Only thing that could've elevated it was the 1 hour egg.  Still amazing, though.

My first visit didn't start well. They open about 10 minutes late. Super friendly owner who explained that the fish is prepared Hawaiian style. All of the fish is marinated. Since I cannot eat spicy food. I asked if there's any kind without sriracha like the rest on the station. He took out tuna marinated in soy and sesame oil.

I built my own bowl with greens. What is unique about this place is the coconut topping which brings tropical flavor to the dish. Definitely get it for your toppings.

Service was super slow. We waited for a while to get water and our waiter. Food came out after a long wait. However the food is pretty good. My jumbo lump crab meat salad is very fresh. The crabmeat is sweet and the sliced almonds gives a crunchy texture. The avocado mousse is very smooth, a nice complement to the salad.My friend really enjoyed the grilled shrimp appetizer.

The service at Takenoya ruined the whole restaurant experience for my family on Mothers Day. Upon being seated we were given a poor greeting from our waiter. After he asked how we were doing, we responded and likewise asked how he was. The waiter then decided to go on about how tired he was and how he wanted to get home. This alone was a cause for concern, and our waiter lived up to his self description by being both unaware and mentally detached during the ordering. As well as this, the waiter seemed to be unkempt and almost dirty with a clear lack of personal grooming. 

After we received our food, we basically never saw the waiter again. We had utensils missing, empty water glasses, and unfilled requests, but these things went unnoticed by the Takenoya staff. Now, we aren't the kind of people who will sans a tip completely, but we did plan to at least dock a few dollars for the poor service. This plan was ruined when our party of only six was given an automatic service charge on the bill. For what service we were charged for I really am not sure!

The food itself was mediocre, and coupled with the fact that we were provided terrible service, my family will not be going back and definitely will recommend against Takenoya.

I went to this location to have a margarita for Cinco de Mayo.  The location was easy to find and parking was not an issue.  The margarita was not great and tasted pretty bland.  I also ordered the Queso appetizer to go with my chips and I could not have been more disappointed.  The dip was bland and had no real flavor at all.  The menu stated the queso was spicy but mine was less than desired.  I have definitely had better margaritas and better queso.

Disclaimer: I am not a Dim Sum aficionado. I enjoy the occasional dumpling here and there but do not crave them. That being said, Bing Bing did not disappoint. Social vibe with quick service. We opted to sit outside and enjoyed the weather and vibe. Got the Crispy Lamb Rolls and Spicy Lamb dumplings followed by the Taiwamese Beef Noodle Soup (ramen with beed essentially) -- all of which were delicious and spicy. Also ordered the Shrimp dumplings which were bland and were pretty much dough wrapped around boiled shrimp. Would visit here again and try more of their "spicy"' offerings.

Great chicken sandwich! I ordered online and it was ready for pick up right away. And it was delicious. The chicken was crispy and flavored. This small burger store is at the back of a bar. You need to get into the bar to find it.

My husband loves the dan dan noodle. I had chicken mushroom dumpling. I should have requested steamed, they served it pan fried. My entree was fish with wooden mushrooms. It was way too salty. I should have sent it back. Very disappointing birthday lunch.

Absolute worst. Nothing but problems with the plumbing. Our kitchen flooded every 4-5 months even though maintenance and the plumbing company came to so called "fix it" and even took further steps to pressure wash the pipes from the outside. I'm so glad we moved out. Beware of the nonstop plumbing issues.

Hidden gem in South Philly. The bread and rolls are very soft and light, perfect for dipping. The arancini (Italian rice ball) is very good. Super friendly guy. He said the raisin bread does not have preservatives so he recommended freezing it soon. Definitely come back for more rolls and bread.

I would give this Five starts if I was rating it soley on the drinks and bartender. The Caipirinhas, both original lime & black cherry were fantastic. Poppy pours a great drink.

I had the Rainbow ceviche which was good. The fish was great, unfortunately the sauce was a little over salted, which took away from the fish.

The Vaca Frita, the steak was very good but I think they over did it with the pickled onions.

All in all they get a 5 star review for the excellent drinks and the excellent bartender. The food gets 3 stars because they over did it with the seasoning and the garnish. The food could easily be 5 stars if they get back to basics a little bit. 

If the steak is the star of the dish let the star shine. 

Four stars when I average it out.

Another excellent dinner by Stephen Starr's restaurant. The ceviches are amazing. I tried 3 samplers: Thai young coconut, shrimp, and yellow tail. Cobb salad is really good, the dressing is not drenching, it's just perfect. I also ordered guacamole with plantain chips which is not on the menu. I dad tuna with sugar cane which is excellent too. I tried my husband's scallops with quinoa, crab and Serrano ham. It's good too but in the salty side. For dessert, get the signature cigar dessert, you won't be disappointed.

Stopped here on my trek back home with my daughter in a stroller. An added bonus of this place is that there's no step to when entering which is a plus for strollers. 

It was relatively quiet inside. Owners were very warm and friendly. 

I got the traditional bahn mi and a coconut bubble tea for $7. The bahn mi is spot on! Nice flavor and the bread is crunchy yet soft.  

Boba tea was good, but I've had better coconut so I'll probably try a smoothie next time. And there will be a next time!
Great service and excellent food. Waiter was awesome and staff was friendly. Nice and clean.
Good service, great atmosphere but below average food. I love the location and the whole vibe, food just is not consistent.

I'm in love with Vault + Vine! It's my new favorite coffee shop!!! First of all it's super cute! Not only is it a coffee shop, it's also a florist and they sell jewelry, candles and more!!! I bought the cutest earrings for my friends birthday! Their coffee is great! And I'm obsessed with their scones! I've had the pistachio, chocolate hazelnut and my favorite was the lemon poppy seed! Yum!! They also have a lot of vegan pastries! It's an awesome place to hang out or sit and read! I would def recommend coming to check out this hidden gem!!!!
Had red bean ice cream with regular waffle. If you have waffle, the ice cream won't be rolled upped. The red bean is very sweet. Unlimited toppings, great presentation. Nice service.

I LOVE it here.  The gel manicures last for at least 2 weeks or you can come back and get them fixed.  I have been going here ever two weeks since they opened.  As everyone has said it is clean, the technicians are super sweet and the mani/pedis are great quality.

Word is out so - They can be quite busy you may want to call ahead for an appointment.

From my call to Felicia to make the appointment, to meeting Carmine to get my smart key and keyfob done for my 2013 Nissan Altima, it was an excellent experience! Professional, courteous, honest and reasonably priced. They have earned another loyal customer, and I would recommend them to anyone! There was a problem programming the fob I provided, and Carmine took the time to show me what was wrong, and provided a fob that programmed properly.

Never had Moroccan bread like this, it was really good. Much better than a pita or naan.

The slow cooked lamb sandwich had good seasoning, very tender. Let the owner pick the sides to go with your meat selection.

Also had mint tea and a side of humus.

Everything was really good, I am glad I finally stopped in on the last day of my trip.

This was my first tattoo and it was on my ribs, so I was very very nervous; but the shop had such a good vibe, and everyone was so friendly and welcoming, that it really put me at ease.  Dina did my tattoo, and she's super skilled and very reassuring to a newbie.  I'll definitely be back for another tattoo.

Best of all, it barely hurt.  There were a few spots right over the bone that were kind of a trial, but that's about it.  My new tattoo is beautiful and just the way I imagined it and I love it.  Highly recommended.

I booked a room at John Ascuaga's Nugget Casino for my anniversary weekend.  I booked a Deluxe Room with King bed and a view for a great price.  I was really looking forward to the weekend and the room with my wife.

The Check-In
We arrived at the Casino around 3:00 PM and I was able to park in front to go inside to check-in.  I went into the Casino and found the hotel check in but the line was massive.  I had to wait in line for 30 to 45 minutes just to check in.  The line moved but the size of the line never got any smaller during my time waiting.  Once I got to the desk I gave the clerk my hotel reservation and had no issue getting my room key.  I parked my car, got my wife and my luggage and proceeded to the room.

The Room
Remember, I had booked a 'Deluxe Room with a King Bed' but upon opening the room door I found I had been assigned a room with 2 Queen beds.
