Ordering was slightly intimidating (confusing is probably a better word- I mean that I was not sure how to order and the hostess/bartender was talking to the group that was there- it's that find of an atmosphere- super relaxed), but then going up to the bar the bartender was very friendly and helped me with my order. A lot of food for the money. I'm sure it's a really fun place to hang out at most nights.

This review is mainly for horrible customer service. 

The lady who is working there is very unfriendly. No smile and I felt I was not welcomed.

I saw at Instagram that for National oatmeal cookie day all oatmeal cookies (oatmeal raisin and oatmeal chocolate walnut) is $1. I asked her about the deal and she said it's for oatmeal raisin.

I was disappointed but did not want to argue.

The oatmeal raisin cookies was warm, soft, and moist. More to cake than cookie. Not too sweet and I didn't find the oatmeal texture.It's  good but not as good as the chocolate chip.
They make best Italian bread in South Philly. I always get the seeded kind. Make sure you go there early on Saturdays because they sold out quickly. They also make pizza and cookies. Cash only.

Great service. They have discount offer on Facebook so make sure you follow them. 

I ordered sweet martabak with Ovomaltine and peanut but they didn't put peanut in it. I called to complain and they will compensate me with free martabak next time. What a service. Ovomaltine is not too sweet at all.

This place is on second floor of the Comcast building.  Very clean and neat area.

7 grain muffin is very moist and sweet. However the button of my muffin is a little bit burnt. That's why I took a star down. It's more to dessert than healthy breakfast. 

Grapefruit Kouign Aman is amazing. Definitely get this. Very sweet and crunchy pastries filled with refreshing grapefruit fillings.

The olive oil cake is pretty good too with 
refreshing slices of fresh white grapefruit.

Chocolate covered canele is delicious. Very moist canele but the chocolate isn't overly sweet.

After watching Netflix documentary I decided to get the tacos. I got there around 10 and the line was building up. Christina was passing around the menu.

When you come in go to the ordering desk. Cash only. After paying you will get the receipt. Stand in line to the meat chopping counter where you are getting the food. The cactus, onion, lime, salsa toppings are available there.

Barbacoa and pancita aka pork are delicious. I ordered veggie and the flavor was on point. However there are not much filling, I believe it consists of potato, squash, but no green veggies. The veggie toppings are spicy. 

The tortilla is the best I've ever had. It's made there and so soft and fresh.

Sweet tamales is very sweet but falls apart. That's why I took a star down.

The customer service is outstanding. The owner reached me to resolve chocolate chip cookie day pricing issue.

The double chocolate chip cookies are my second favorite after the traditional chocolate chip cookies. It's crispy on the outside but soft on the inside. They are generous in filling the cookies with chocolate chip but the cookie itself it's not overly sweet so overall it's perfect sweetness.

My review is for the original pound cake with vanilla icing. It's really the best pound cake I have ever had. Very light, moist, and soft texture with perfect sweetness. Definitely get this. There are also plain with chocolate icing, and the chocolate swirl version. Almost $10 per pound cake. They have pies, danish, and butter cake that they are famous for. Cash only

This place is really nice. The outside looks cheap but the inside is very clean and decent 

House Salad: fresh with I think a carrot purée 

Seaweed salad: tasty and sweet

Sashimi:really fresh definitely get the white tuna . The eel is a hit too, very flavorful.

The shumai is ok you can pass this one

This airport was pretty warm, warmer than most airports. I flew on  Southwest Airlines and the terminal was pretty small and crowded. The baggage claim was pretty frustrating. I flew on a Monday and it took about an hour for the bags to come to baggage claim. Aside from that it takes along time to get a rental car. You ride on a shuttle bus that takes you to a car rental place miles away  from the airport.

Waitress was quick and attentive. Many vegetarian friendly options! The lunch menu was limited, but a decent price and delicious otherwise. The ambiance was very relaxing, however if you prefer to sit at booths you might be disappointed as only tables are available.

Steamed vegetable dumplings: it falls apart, the dough doesn't hold the filling at all although the filling is good. Most of them went to the trash. Don't get it.

Summer rolls: 95 percent noodles, disappointing. I had shrimp and tofu. The sauce is pretty good.

Drunken noodles: super greasy, I had burnt chicken, noodles sticks together. Another disappointment.

Chicken pad thai is the only one that is decent, not much meat, mostly noodles. My coworker had the shrimp version and there are only five shrimps.

Chicken broccoli with rice: 70 percent is rice. Not much of the chicken and broccoli.

I won't order again.

This is my absolute favorite Thai restaurant within the Tampa Bay Area. The ambience of the restaurant itself gets 5 stars. It's a really cute place to take your tinder date, or even your mom. My personal favorite is the Amazing Tofu. It comes with jasmine rice, tofu and broccoli. The tofu and broccoli is smothered in peanut sauce, so I would recommend asking for it on the side. They throw cilantro on the tofu I think, which makes it 6 times better. WiFi is available!

The service is always great here but the food is slow to come out. It took almost 45 minutes. 

The meatballs are delicious but this time I tasted so much pepper in it

Really rude young female bartender. We tried to get a six pack for a friend then decided he would stay for a beer. She thought we were trying to take one beer to go. Then continued to tell us that she didn't trust us and said we were gonna take the miller lite and put it in our pocket and leave. She said I don't trust you and now I will not serve you. This was 2 minutes after we walked into the bar. The staff is extremely rude and disrespectful to their customers. Our other two friends paid their tab and left their drinks full because we couldn't believe how rude the bartender was. We were also 6 of the 7 people in there. They lost 6 good point customers tonight due to our extremely rude and disrespectful encounter. Please get rid of the entitled girl and we will return.

It's been three and a half weeks since I dropped off my lawnmower for repairs. When I first brought it in, they said that it will be one week before they can assess and/or repair it. Every Time I call they tell me it will be ready "next week". Do yourself a favor and don't bring your lawnmower for repairs here. I am going to pick it up and bring it somewhere else. The most recent time I called I was told that they prioritize lawnmowers that are purchased there, which I understand but don't think is a way to bring in new customers. Grant it, if they would have told me that my lawnmower wasn't worth fixing, I probably would have bought a new one from them, NOT ANYMORE!!

I made pre order for delivery at 6 PM through grubhub and the food came early to my surprise. I was dreading for late delivery after reading many  delivery issues by other yelpers.

Food is still hot. Tacos al pastor is loaded with meat. My husband really enjoyed it.

A must get at this place is fried plantains with condensed milk as dessert. There are a lot of slices of plantains in one portion so it's perfect for sharing.

Lots selections of prepared food. The bread is very soft and moist.

You can buy hummus by the pound near the cheese area.

Staff is friendly.

This place is really nice. There's one area with the bar, and another section for more formal dining setting.

Mushroom soup: highly recommended. It has a lot of chopped mushroom.

Crab Salad: pretty big size and fresh. A lot of crab meat 

Crab cake sandwich: really delicious. Pretty big and all are crab meat . Not overly seasoned. 

Key lime pie: beautiful charred meringue, really good and not overly w.

I always on the lookout of their specials on Instagram. The smoked brisket pizza cheesesteak looked awesome. Along with $5 off from Grubhub and my friend's Instagram post and review , I decided to order. It was sooo delicious. The tender brisket is on the bottom, topped with fried mozzarella, and finally the pizza sauce with shredded parmesan on top. The mozzarella melts as you bite it, perfect combination of sweetness from the pizza sauce and the savory of the brisket. It comes with fresh abd crispy potato chips. Definitely get it when it is available

We went for Christmas Day brunch, absolutely amazing! Loved the family style and more food than anyone could ever eat! Everything is seasoned just right. The only thing we didn't care for was the chocolate marshmallow dessert.
This place is a hidden gem! Small menu but the food is fresh and very well seasoned. The service was also top notch! This is a must try.

Very nice and clean place. Beautiful presentation. Very fresh sashimi especially the white tuna. The ginger salad dressing is pretty good.

I went to this place because it offers chocolate soufflé for dessert. I asked how long it would take to prepare it because I know it takes a while to make it. The waitress said it wouldn't take long because it's premised. I was disappointed that it's not freshly made so I decided not to order. That's why I took a star down.
The dough isn't thick. The size each dumplings is small. I wish they put more fillings. Not much flavor in it. I will not go back again.

Came here on the first weekend of the opening. Many stores aren't opened . There are interactive screens to find the store you are looking for. They need to put customer service station to help visitors.

Main food area is at the lower level aka the concourse near Jefferson Station. Chickie's and Pete's, Pei Wei, Pizza, chick fil a.

South Fellini is an awesome store to find Philadelphia themed clothing. Don't forget to take a picture with Kim Cattral's mannequin.

There's a jerky store where you can have samples

The pizza here is great. I got margarita, fresh sauce and mozzarella. Crust is super crispy. I took a star down because it's over charred and it ruined my enjoyment of the crust.

Nutella pie. It's actually a dessert pizza. Nutella spread topped with slices of apple and walnut giving a crunchy texture.

This is one of my favorite restaurants in the Greater New Orleans area. My parents are locals here, and the staff is absolutely incredible. Their hamburger steak is super delicious and so is the fried chicken! Anything you get will be delicious and huge in portion. I can't wait to have them cater our wedding because I know they won't disappoint!

I came here on Christmas Eve to grab a dessert as a Christmas gift. One thing that caught my attention is the  Christmas Yule log cake. Very cutely decorated. They also had other Christmas cakes too. I asked the staff there about the price and she said $18. Not a bad price for a Yule log. I left the store weighing my options and decided to get the Yule log.

A different person helped me with the order and I gave my credit card to pay. After walking a half block away I checked my receipt and saw that he charged me $25 so I went back and said that she told me it was $18. I got my $7 in cash.

I had a box of cuccidati and it's kinda hard. The Mexican bread and pastries: the pineapple pastry is moist and pretty good, some other bread tend to be dry. 

The fruit tarts look enticing.

Great breakfast spot! Our server was very friendly and food has really good flavor. Blueberry French Toast has cheesecake topping, yum!
Greek Omelette was very flavorful. Biscuits are REALLY GOOD! Cider mimosa is ok for 5.99
Will def come back again!

The review is for the tomato pie. 

The corner crust is super crunchy. My favorite part of any pizza. The sauce is fresh and not heavy and sweet. Very refreshing. However the bread part is soggy. Unfortunately it's not my favorite tomato pie

Have been here many times now and have learned their strengths and weaknesses. Strengths: great British beer selection on tap, excellent fish and chips and scotch eggs, solid on other British favorites. The outside covered patio is a great spot for people watching and leisurely meals. Surprise: they actually have GREAT burgers. Weaknesses: brunch is meh. It's ok but there are better options in the neighborhood. Sometimes service is a tad slow, especially on the patio.
It's a smaller version of regular Acme supermarkets but it can meet your basic grocery needs. There's salad bar and they carry wine and beer too. It's a way better than Superfresh used to be.

Upon entering you will see bar area. Several steps up you will find the dining area.

Fried calamari: really delicious. Perfectly cooked and tender with crunchy batter. Highly recommended.

Salad is fresh. Vegan meatballs are made from eggplants and mushrooms as I was told. I had it as side order. It's dense and delicious but it's more to the salty side. The gravy is a little bit thick and salty. My father in law had regular meatballs and spaghetti. It's pretty good and gravy is thick, I think it's need more gravy.  Both are okay, I don't see any wow factor.

My husband had bacon kimchi burger and he loves it. 

Tiramisu is my ok, you can skip it. It's just soaked lady fingers with whipped cream
I am glad they carry Van Leuwen famous ice cream from Brooklyn. The ingredients are natural and very homemade. The peanut butter marshmallow crunch is amazing

It's a nice and clean place. Very friendly staff. You can build your own or choose from the signature bowls. 

I took a star down because the bowl is not full. I ordered both the salad and rice base. The container is made of plastic instead of environmentally friendly cardboard. 

On the good side, the eel is awesome. It's served warm with great flavor. The fish is fresh too with unlimited toppings. 

Free WiFi and complimentary water.

I went in to get my brakes done as well as get the front two tires replaced and check the alignment. After I dropped off my car, I got a call telling me that it would cost about $300 to align my wheels. I told the guy no to the alignment. When I showed up to pay for the tires and brakes, the guy charged me for the alignment. When I questioned it, he said that I authorized the additional work which was not true. There was not much I could do other than pay and tell people about my experience.

Do not trust this place. I was lied to and ripped off.

Pet-Grumpy, not Pet-Friendly.

I stayed here with my furkin and I registered my pet and was assigned room 31.  At first I had high hopes, the room was a bit cramped but it had everything I needed and was less a block from the beach.  It was very clean.

Each time I inquired to borrow a bike, I was met with some grumpy remark. By the third time I inquired and was ready to go, it was 3:40pm I was told:  
"No, it's our policy not to rent the bikes out that late."  
I asked if I could bring it back by 4:30 (Sunset at 5:15pm).  
I was told no.  
The next afternoon I asked earlier in the day, and was told "It looks like it might rain, i can't let the bike out."  
I said, it's cloudy but it doesn't really seem like it's going to rain.  
Front desk:  "Yes, I felt raindrops earlier."  
It did NOT rain earlier at this location and the sky completely cleared up by sunset, with no precipitation.  
Arggg!  What's  the use?! 

The bed was terrible.  The worst bed I've ever slept in, so soft with negative support.  Re-activated back issues and took weeks and several massages to restore.  If you must stay here, spring for the Jacuzzi suites, so maybe you can fix your back in the tub the next morning.  I'm joking!  At least in #31 the bed is terrible and if you've ever experienced a problem with lack of bed or chair support, I'd avoid this place.

This motel very cute and the morning spread is appetizing and generous (bakery quality baked goods, no Costco muffins here!).  The patio area is pretty, and it's in a great neighborhood, super close to the beach, marina, and pier.  If they got better beds, I'd try again.

It's my first visit after the renovation. The menu has changed a lot except the burger, which is their signature dish. My friend is disappointed that her favorite duck confit has disappeared from the menu.

The waiters are very friendly but definitely not knowledgeable on the menu. They had to go to the kitchen or ask someone else.

Grilled swordfish with a escarole, fava beans, and artichoke:

I ordered Pad See Ew and Pad Thai for pickup through caviar because of a discount. The food was ready when I got there. Each container is wrapped with plastic wrap to prevent spilling.

I had high expectations for the food, especially the pad Thai that cost $32. The portion size is big, you can definitely share with another person. A lot of crab meat, big fresh shrimp. The crushed red pepper gives some heat to the dish. There's not much sauce in the noodles and it was bland, it's a disappointment for me.

On the other hand, the pad see ew is very delicious. In Chinese dish is also known as ho fun/kwetiaw. Noodles is perfectly cooked, perfect chewiness, balanced flavor between sweet and salty. Chinese broccoli is so crunchy. Highly recommended. Big size portion too.

Great atmosphere. We went after 2 pm and the service was just ok. Our drinks took forever to get there but then servers picked up to standard . 
Great fried chicken

It's been a couple of years since I came here and it has changed not in a good way.

There's no sliced tees leches. You can only buy the whole cake.

Macaron is a waste of money. It's $10 for the whole box and all are destroyed on my way home. FYI I only live 2 blocks away.

The rum cake and cannoli cake are great. The cake is super moist layered with chocolate and vanilla custard. However, the ricotta layered of the cannoli cake has a weird taste.?

The chocolate covered banana is my favorite. It has almond cookie on the bottom, sweet strawberry preserves, fresh banana covered with hard shell chocolate. 

They have several Mexican bread too. I tried one kind and it's meh for me.

Next time I want to try the churros.

We recently hired Olympia Moving after our realtor recommended them for a 50 mile move from one house to another. The process to get a quote was seamless with the virtual facetime option-- I walked the customer service rep through each room of the house and explained which items we were planning to move.  I received the quote about a day later.  The price was pretty average with other quotes I was receiving and comparing at the time.  We decided to book them based on our positive experience so far and other positive reviews online.  The day of the move, a team of 3 movers arrived 15 min early.  We briefly walked through the house to show them everything.  They worked quickly and efficiently.  They tried really hard to get a couch out of the house, but due to the width of the narrow door frames, we decided to leave it.  This set us back about 45 minutes, and they called a 4th mover to come help to stay on track. They apologized, but I honestly just appreciated their effort regardless. When we arrived at the new house (about one hour drive), they worked just as fast to unload everything.  4-stars because they accidentally dinged the wall moving one of the pieces of furniture inside and scuffed up the walls along the stairs-- nothing that can't be fixed with a magic eraser though.  Overall, 7 hours total and very pleased with the experience.  Definitely recommend!

If you're looking for a relaxing massage with therapeutic benefits...Robin is absolutely THE BEST! Upon arrival the front desk staff is friendly and they go out of their way to make sure you feel at home. Thank you OSHO! I am a loyal, returning customer for a reason!

Eggplant parm is delicious. Instead of using regular Italian roll, the bread is a flat similar to ciabatta, very nice crust. I'm not a big fan of arugula but I can enjoy it in the sandwich because it's not too much and blended well with the melty cheese and the tomato sauce.
Unique and masculine decor, awesome music playing, and free beer while you wait. Go here...often.

The receptionist is hilarious.  everyone maintains professionalism. All equipment is wiped off and cleaned properly between usage. You still need to wear a mask of course. Physical therapists are friendly, knowledgeable, and really helpful. They have an online system as well to help you maintain exercises at home. Would recommend.

Super friendly owner who expressed his appreciation of doing business with him. The specialty of this restaurant is the homemade tortilla. So fresh and elevate the meal. 

I had mole tacos. One serving has three tacos. One taco has one layer of tortilla so it's not too heavy, loaded with flavorful chicken mole. It has some kick but not too spicy. Highly recommended

Guacamole and chips is large enough for sharing. Churros are fresh and super crunchy.

This was a fun little spot, located behind the Sand Pearl Resort on North beach. They do not take reservations, and due to the pandemic, they had very limited seating outside. Unfortunately it started to pour and they were unable to relocate us inside (which was strange) so our time there was cut extremely short and some of our food was ruined.

For my vegans - they have an impossible burger! Skip the $2 up charge for cheese, it's just a small handful of shredded, melted cheese. The burger was good though!

This is a more pricey restaurant, but you're paying for the views!

Gnocchis: very fresh and soft with fresh tomato sauce 

Porcini ravioli: generous in the mushroom fillings perfectly seasoned 

Butternut squash tortellini has smooth and perfectly seasoned fillings, again it has generous fillings 

If you want fresh pasta, this is a place to go.

Super friendly service. You can smell the smokiness of the food as soon as you come in. Cheesesteak brisket is delicious. The bread is soft and soaking the juiciness of the brisket. The cheese is enough and not overwhelming so that the spice and the flavor is not lost. The brisket is so moist and tender, melts in your mouth with that cheese. It comes with barbecue potato chips which are perfectly seasoned. Not too salty and very thin and crispy. The best barbecue in the city.

If you like the usual cheap Americanized Chinese this isn't for you. The food and seasonings taste fresh but we discovered through this spot that we prefer the cheap usual msg type! The general chicken here tasted less tangy and kind of bland. Rice was on point. Will try again sometime to make sure and update accordingly.

I bought the dough in a tub for $10. There are 16 cookie dough already rounded so you just put it in the oven. It comes with instructions.

The result is the smaller size of the cookies sold on the store. In my opinion they are crunchier than the store version. Still delicious especially when they just came out from the oven.Highly recommend.

The "cupcake" which I think more to angel food or chiffon cake texture. It's super soft and moist like a pillow. It's smaller compared to other bakeries. It's not too sweet. Highly recommended.

The mochi is big but unfortunately not too much fillings. I won't buy it again.

Amazing bbq place. As soon as you walk in you can smell the smoky barbecue flavor. There are seating area but not many tables. You can go ahead and place an order for pick up. Mine was ready in 10 minutes. They deliver through caviar and accept card payment. There is a table for different kinds of the sauce and for different dish. Don't forget to get it to enhance the flavor of your meal. The sandwiches come with fresh potato chips. Salmon is available on weekends and served in a six ounce fillet. It's very good, not dry. I had half chicken also. Both of them are very moist with perfect barbecue flavor. The sandwiches are great too. There's nothing negative to say about the food here. The containers are environmentally friendly. It's sold out frequently, so you're better off come here early.

I made pre order for delivery at 6 PM through grubhub and the food came early to my surprise. I was dreading for late delivery after reading many  delivery issues by other yelpers.

Food is still hot. Tacos al pastor is loaded with meat. My husband really enjoyed it.

A must get at this place is plantains with condensed milk as dessert. However this time the plantains are hard and not sweet at all because it's not ripe. That's why I took a star down
The chilli is amazing. No beans but a lot of dessert meat. It's spicy but not too overwhelming

The review is for the mango sticky rice. I follow this restaurant on Instagram. As soon as I saw its post about this dessert, I immediately ordered online for delivery. 

Food came on time. Delivery person was very friendly and wearing a mask.

The mango still has the skin intact so that it's a little bit hard to eat. The sticky rice was still warm and moist. It comes with ground peanuts and coconut cream which brings crunchy texture and an awesome combination of sweet and salty. Definitely get this
My review is for the Chinese New Year cake. It's the most expensive compared to other bakeries but the best. $8. It's very dense so it reminds me of my childhood
This review is for the lasagna. It has layers of fresh pasta with beschamel and ground beef in between instead of ricotta. It's pretty good.

I ordered for pick up through Grubhub. Great in communication. They called when my coworker didn't pick up as scheduled and they were willing to redo my order when they missed my notes.

They are also able to make low sodium for each kind of ramen.

Octopus balls: only several bits of octopus. Mostly dough. The sauce is very delicious and it has generous amount of bonito flakes to give umami flavor.

Calamari is very greasy but soft and perfectly cooked.

Miso: very light and great. The pork is so tender and melts in your mouth.

My husband had the signature ramen and he likes it.

The to go container is a very nice size of bowl perfect size after you put the broth in and it is microwaveable.

I had to untangle the noodles because they are crumpled and sticks together. That's why I took a star down.

Churros: it's the only one I enjoyed here. It's not hard but has crunch. It's not greasy and very moist inside with some cream filling.

St Joseph cake: the pastry is dry and the filling is okay more to bland.

The coffee is great, but the Dulce de España is by far my favorite, and with a couple espresso shots you will not only love it more but have the energy to work on projects, homework, etc. For hours. The environment is great, relaxed, and soothing. Not too expensive considering the size of the cups and best of all if you stay there you can get a glass cup so it's environment friendly!

I ordered casarecce pasta and it is fresh and al dente with perfect chewiness. Because I couldn't decide between al pomodoro and pesto, I ordered both. They are amazingly delicious. 

Pesto is fresh with rich aromatic basil flavor without being too overpowering. Perfect flavor. It was topped with pine nuts for crunchy texture, decorated with fresh basil.  Highly recommend. I think it's the best pesto pasta I've ever had.

The pomodoro is also good. The gravy is fresh and not too heavy with enough amount of melted cheese on top. It's not too soaked and soupy. I wish they put a little bit more sauce because it's absorbed in the pasta. 

Order is placed through the touch screen and you can see how you pasta is made. 

I am looking forward to trying the other kinds on the menu
One of our favorite places for pizza and beer. Great selection of toppings and a nice variety of beers to choose from.

The cupcake which has the texture of angel food cake is my favorite here, so soft and moist. The buns are a little bit dry compared to other Chinatown bakery.

I came here a day after Chinese New Year and got the Chinese New Year cake (pink and yellow), unfortunately they are dry.

This review is for the Tiramisu. Super friendly owners and made me feel welcomed.
Tiramisu is homemade with lady fingers soaked in coffee. I had mine to go and upon arriving home it was watery. It's pretty good and not overly sweet.

It's a nice and clean restaurant. I am impressed with the metal chandeliers on the ceiling and the wall. There are pictures of NYC skyline on the right hand by the stairs which is where the restroom is, definitely not handicapped friendly.

On the right there's a flatscreen TV showing aerial landscapes, and with the accompaniment of slow instrumental music, it gives a relaxing atmosphere.

The girl who took my take out order was very nice and friendly despite her mistake of putting the bill on the credit card machine.

Don't forget to checkout a lot of varieties of ice cream. Some flavors are interesting.

I was disappointed with the unavailability of the rice rolls printed on the menu.

Second disappointment was there's a hole on the styrofoam container of my ban xeo so the grease was leaking. It's a greasy dish.

Summer rolls are ok. The dipping sauce is meh.

When Mike's BBQ makes their version of McRib, get it while you can because it's very delicious. Loaded with lots of meat, not over drenched with sugary barbecue sauce. The pickles and onion complete the sandwich Perfect bbq flavor. It comes with homemade potato chips

The review is for order through Grubhub. First of all the delivery fee is expensive $6.99 and it took a long time to get the food.

Takoyaki was a disappointment. There's only one tiny bit of octopus and the rest is batter. Sauce isn't the regular takoyaki instead I got cocktail sauce and no bonito flakes 

Catfish needs to be fried longer.

Sweet potato fries is soggy.

As the name suggests the restaurant is decorated with roses on the tables and bar area.

Staff is very friendly and helpful. I took a star down because the food came out so slow. My friend and I were the second table in the restaurant but it took forever to get the food.

My friend had salmon sandwich, she said the salmon was dry. That's another star down 

I had roasted beet salad with fried goat cheese  . It's very delicious and unique. The goat cheese wasn't too tangy. The dressing is subtle but perfect. I personally don't like  over drenched salad dressing. The candied pecan give crunchy texture and some sweetness  . The greens are fresh and  beets are soft. I added chicken to my salad and it cost me additional $8 so my salad is $22.50 . It's a little bit expensive for a salad in my opinion . The chicken is perfectly cooked, not dry at all

They do not stand behind their products. I've been buying cigars from them for some time. The guy that works there is cool but the lady is very mean. I had bought a $50 vector lighter from them and it stopped working. Instead of refunding or even replacing it, they said that the sale is final. I literally bought it a week ago and they have a "lifetime guarantee". Unbelievable lack of customer service

The review is for the delicious tiramisu French toast. The bread is thick perfectly cooked and moist with delicious fillings. The fillings isn't a lot but it brings the sweetness to the toast.

Kouign aman is crunchy and buttery. The fig muffin is ok not much filling. You can pass this

I always buy the marinated spicy pork, seaweed, Korean desserts. 

There's a whole section dedicated to the seaweed, plenty of prepared Korean food at the back of the store.

Outside the supermarket, you can find a store selling prepared Korean food, Paris baguette, a store selling Korean dessert. By the entrance I recommend that you visit the dumpling store which also sells jumbo buns with some choices of fillings such as Kimchi, red bean, pork. The buns are fresh from the huge steamers. They are so soft and generous with the full. Highly recommended. I ate it right away.

Reviewing a list of my favorite things, you'd find "books" and "bottles of wine" pretty close to the top. Depending on the day, wine may rank #1.

The vibes here are very relaxing. It's not quiet like a library, but not too loud like... any other bar within .5 miles. It's the happiest medium, and the happiest place. I've been here a handful of times, and I truly mean the following statement: this is my favorite place in dtsp. As I mentioned, I read a lot and drink wine a lot. The fact that you can go hangout here, read in silence, drink wine AND consider that a social day (if you go with pals) checks off every box of my ideal outing. There isn't a LOT of seating, but there is at least one table for bigger groups (maybe 6ish), bar seating, outdoor seating and other random tables inside.

The wine offerings are pretty expanse, and you can take a bottle home if you don't finish it (lol haven't experienced that yet - what is self control?) They also sell small plates - think: charcuterie-ish. For my vegan fam, this is conveniently located across the street from Cider Press ;-) 

Pricing: it's truly decent for what it is. No one is forcing you to buy books, and they have a wide range of bottle prices. You can also buy wine by the glass!

I actually celebrated my birthday here and they allowed us to bring in a cake and such. Such a great place, cool staff, and truly a unique experience. I wish I thought of it!!! Xoxo book + bottle, plz sponsor me and thank you for not judging me for bringing my Kindle :-)

I came here with my husband and a friend without a reservation on Wednesday night. It's a bit busy but to my surprise they have plenty of outdoor seatings on 9 street and Fitzwater street. Our server was very knowledgeable and attentive. It turns out that the take out menu is different than dining in menu. I was expecting delicious mango sticky rice but it wasn't available. They didn't even have pad Thai and pad see ew.

Appetizer: chicken dumplings in the form of flowers, so pretty, perfect for Instagram post. For me, I could only taste white pepper. 

Mushroom salad: a lot of meaty mushrooms, very fresh. Unfortunately it's salty.

Steamed glass noodles with jumbo prawns: the shrimps were huge. Again, the black pepper is the dominant flavor.

Curry scallops: this one is the winner: so aromatic and full of flavor. Scallops were perfectly cooked, authentic spice , I can put the curry sauce on anything.

Beef and broccoli: beef was super tender, broccoli was fresh and not over cooked. Flavor is ok, not memorable.

Overall in my opinion they were over priced. I definitely recommend the curry scallops. It's the only one that wowed me
Friendly service and delicious food. I came here for private event and really enjoyed the food.

Amazing pizza. The crust is thin and crispy. Ingredients are fresh: fresh tomato and mozzarella. There are a lot of varieties. You can have the pizza reheated. Sold by weight and you can tell how big thes slice.

For dessert you can have the award-winning amazing gelato and delicious pastries from Isgro's.

Service is fast and friendly.

The low stars is due to unsatisfactory service that we experienced. 

My husband wanted ARS Passyunk Avenue double IPA from the draft list. Our waiter came and poured hazy IPA from a can. My husband said that it wasn't what he wanted and our waiter said that they didn't have it on tap. So my husband had Tecate instead.

Guacamole is very fresh. I asked for no Serrano chili and they complied. It has chunks of fresh avocado with fresh tortilla chips.

Tlayuda with chicken tinga. It's basically a big fried tortilla topped with black beans, cheese, tomato, onions, and flavorful tender chicken. The shell is harder than regular tortilla. Very good.

Ensalada verde. As the name implies the dominant color of the salad is green. Arugula is bitter, I didn't taste the dressing. I didn't enjoy it.

Elotes comes in with two small corns. My husband enjoyed it.

As I mentioned earlier, the service wasn't great. He never checked on our drinks. My husband decided not to get another drink because of this. It took forever to get his attention for our check. He charged the beer that incorrectly served. My husband had to point this mistake. After it was corrected, the amount charged to credit card is less than the bill. As honest customers, we pointed out the mistake.

This kind of service makes me hesitant to come back.

There are pretty good amount of seatings and nicely distanced. You have to keep an eye on your food from the pesky flies flying around the food.

This review is for horrible customer service experience. I used the checkout and noticed that I didn't get the discounted price after clipping my digital coupon. So I asked for a customer service help. She was so unfriendly, very rude. After she found out that I didn't put my phone number in, she was huffing and puffing explained it to me. I felt bad that it was my fault but she could have been nicer. I will never go to her register or self checkout if she is around.

Very helpful, friendly staff. They genuinely seem to want to make you happy with your order. Very busy but the line moves quickly. Delicious food. Great location if you are staying at one of the hotels close up the airport.

Great farmers market by Rittenhouse Square. There are varities of vendors some of them offer samples 

-fresh flowers
-canele. The best ever. Very moist inside with custard texture. Not overly sweet with a hint of lemon taste, but crispy on the outside. They have regular and mini size. I recommend the regular because you can taste the custard. If you like more crunchy texture, get the mi i.
- cookies by Flour and Oats: they have some samples for shortbread cookies and regular cookies. Very moist and delicious cookies. Highly recommended.
-wild caught fish
- fresh fruit
-chocolate :offers samples 
-bakeries: huge scones, flat, bread, gluten free
-gourmet popcorn: offers samples.
-pickles 
-guacamole and chips: offers samples 
-soup
-international food
-fresh plants

I had the traditional with ovomaltine and peanuts. It has generous amount of crunchy peanuts and the ovomaltine is melting on the warm martabak. It's so good. Definitely my favorite besides the Nutella

So finally I tried the chicken sandwich, which has been part of  the chicken sandwich wars. The picture of the sandwich looks very enticing but in reality it's not the same. 

The chicken is not as humongous as the picture. The chicken has a nice crunchy batter, not dry, but overall, the sandwich lacks flavor. I guess I am spoiled by Fed Donuts, which I think has more flavor 

Cajun fries is good but the Cajun flavor is not strong 

I wanted to order chicken strips but was told that I had to wait a while.

The drive through is fast and very convenient

Went here on a whim after seeing some positive reviews online. I was very disappointed. The crust has that distinctly pizza hut-ish feel to it. My girlfriend liked it, but she loves pizza hut...so no surprise there. The pie itself was greasy and unappetizing. The woman who worked there was awesome and provided great service, but the food was just not up to par. 

Recently got a coupon in the mail for $10 off a $20 order, but could not bring myself to eat here again. 

Make better pizza. Please.

I bought heavy cream and when I poured it, it already curdled. The expiration date is about 28 days away. So the next day I went to customer service expecting a refund. Instead of apology and refund I was told that the store did not accept return. I was saving my breath from arguing. If it's Trader Joe's I bet they will refund me. I would be better off going to Whole Foods across the street or Wawa around the corner.

I always keep an eye on its Instagram post for Thursday special. They always have innovative sandwiches such as general tso chicken sandwich, Thai chicken sandwich. I had Mac and cheese balls with smoked pork, highly recommended. It comes with 2 different kinds of barbecue dipping.

Delicious, order a Cali Motxo. The burgers here are in competition with Hawkins for best burger in Boise. Also good is the Lamb Grinder with some crouquetas & tiber sauce....mmm. I don't like flan but apparently the flan here is rad. If you go, though, nothing finishes the meal up better than Basque rice pudding and a coffee.

Hummus is ok, not too flavorful. Baba ganoush is a little bit salty but you can taste the smokiness. There are a lot of varieties of baklava. They sell pita bread too, regular and whole wheat. 

They have juice and middle eastern food to such as schwarma

I live around the corner from Broad and Shunk so I almost order from here daily since their food is so good! I always get their general chicken with brown rice and last night I finally had the guts to try out some sushi rolls. I got the crab and cream cheese roll and a cucumber roll, doesn't sound interesting but it was delicious! Now I'm guessing I'll be ordering more sushi in the future since it's healthier. This place always have excellent service and the cashiers are super nice!
Asparagus fries, beef satay salads,  happy hour even on weekends, friendly bartender and plenty of places to watch college football!  Good drinks...

Not bad.  Only the first floor had live music, but as it was too crowded and hot we went to the third floor.  It had a nice view of Broadway, but piped in music rather than letting us hear the love music on the first floor. Nothing was on tap, no happy hour, and the drinks were overpriced. The bartender was very helpful.
My review is for the baklava. It is very good. Highly recommended. Very juicy and flaky. I will try their other dessert.
Chopped salad is great, and so is the breakfast porridge. The chocolate croissant is flaky with enough filling.

Had egg white mushroom truffle and vegetarian lover. Both are very good. Highly recommended. The girl at the counter is very friendly and helpful. I took mine home and she gave me clear cone-shaped plastic bags that fit perfectly. Both were in good shape upon arriving home. Definetely will go back.
Awesome place! Great customer service and awesome prices. So lucky to have this in the neighborhood.

The worst service i've ever had. There's only one waiter / server for the whole guests. I asked the gado gado sauce to be on the side but when it came out, it's already mixed in. I said that was not how I requested. He went to the kitchen and came out with that dish and told me it's already mixed in. Basically saying too bad, it's already done so take it or leave it. It took forever for us to get his attention to place our order. When we were ready to order dessert, he said no more orders because it closed at 8. It's not 8 yet.

Their peanut-filled mochi is the best. The egg custard is pretty good too. Very friendly lady at the counter. They have steamed buns, I had regular pork bun and there's plenty meat filling. Next time I will try the bbq pork.

A simple, family style place with very good food and excellent service. Family owned and operated, we ate there for our second time last night and thoroughly enjoyed it. Their Gyro meat is a lamb and beef mix, nicely spiced. The chicken and pork souvlaki are both delicious, very juicy and tender. The salads have been fresh and crisp both times, and the Saganaki Flaming Cheese as an appetizer was the perfect touch!

This place was recommended to us by valet at our hotel.  We said we wanted someplace with great food that was lively.  We ate "outside" under cover and not long after we arrived it started raining, then pouring.  Some of the rain dripped through, which was not a big deal, but there was a situation with a gentleman and his dog that had come in the entryway to take cover from the rain.  It ended up with the police being called and a fist fight.  We did want lively.  Our waitress was Irish and was really wonderful. The food was good, I didn't think it was great.  I had the chicken with lemon sauce.  We had the chicken satay for an app and it was good.   We ordered top shelf margaritas straight up in martini glasses.  The first was very good, then next two were just ok, sort of disappointing.  I would go here again.  Also, the outside seating is very crowded, barely room to pull out your chair.  They could do with a few less tables out there.

While walking put first night in Nashville we happened upon the back door of Cabana and wandered in, looking for a beer.  We got a table and a waiter who was very helpful.  The atmosphere was nice there was a lot of dark wood and private booths, in addition to a larger and more open bar area and a patio.  When we could not decide between the sangria and the rum punch the waiter brought samples.  The run punch was super sweet, the sangria was very refreshing.  I had the sangria.  Not a lot of fresh fruit in it but it hit the spot.  We shared a crab cake which was deliciously seasoned and nicely crispy outside and soft inside.  They had a selection of small plates and large plates.  I would go back.

I wouldn't bother: I ate here on Saturday, sat out on the patio.  The food was meh.  The Baby Arancini were cheesy, but not my favorite; the seafood ravioli packed flavor and was my favorite item of the night; the margarita pizza wasn't traditional, did not use fresh mozz for the cheese and the tomatoes were scarce.  The crust was nice, and when you got the rare bite of all the ingredients together, it tasted good.  

The service was questionable.  I got one glass of water at the beginning of the meal and it was not refilled once.  The waitress wasn't up-to-snuff on the red wine list.  I tried three wines that night and ALL of them were lacking body; pretty disappointing when you're looking for an inky, full flavored Italian red.  

The free bread at the beginning of the meal was pretty solid if you salt the oo and balsamic.

Recently visited here for first time. Live walking distance so was hoping to find a regular spot. Sides had been sitting under warmers a while, entrees were fair. Catfish ponchatrain wasn't fully cooked. Should have sent it back but I didn't. So...... got food poisoning. I know this could happen anywhere but for me it happened here. Won't be returning.

This place was recommended to us by a waitress at the Marriott in Sand Key.  We made reservations that day.  The atmosphere is very good, cozy.  Our server, I think his name was Adam, was amazing.  He knew the menu inside and out, so helpful and informative.  I had complete confidence in his recommendations.  Our friends ordered cold water oysters on the half-shell and said they were fantastic. I had the steak tartar as an appetizer and it was served with capers, onions, pickles and toasted french bread.  It was amazing.  I had the chicken cordon bleu and wasn't crazy about it.  My friends had special requests, which were all accommodated graciously. The bread and oil dipping sauce was also amazing.  The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars was my meal and it may have just been my preference.  Would definitely eat here again.
Very tasty hummus and baba ganoush. The hummus is fresh and the baba ganoush has smoky flavor. The pita bread is made there but it's not typical pita bread, it's more to focaccia bread.

Im apprehensive to give this place a great review, because I kind of want to keep it my awesome bar that nobody knows about. Its always had great service and atmosphere, and it's not usually too crowded.  Nice courtyard in the back, too.  Can't speak for the food- never eaten here.  But they have a decent selection of draft beers.
The fruit pierogies are ok. Very doughy when boiled. However the sauerkraut and mushrooms kind is better. The dessert is pretty good. My favorite is cappuccino cake. The tiramisu is Ok.

This was my second time here, tried their dimsum the first time nothing special from other dimsum places except for the price is higher and less of a selection than other dimsum places.

It was my dads birthday so we wanted to try out the dinner since it was closer than china town, we had a 6 person dinner. I would say the food wasn't special at all and the dishes seems they were downgraded from what you would usually get from other Chinese restaurants, had a cold dish which had meat and jellyfish tasted good but the dish was really small. 

The fish maw soup was good had a little surprise of fish roe in it, which was new but didn't make the taste different or better. Had the lobster and fried noodles, this tasted great at the same level as most Chinese restaurant. Had a dish with bok choy, with a shitaki mushroom sliced up very thin hahaha it was thinner than a piece of paper not sure if there was even 1 mushroom if put together.
The beef dish came out which was cut up in squares mixed with white mushrooms and peppers, the taste was good but the beef was very chewy and the dish was very small.
We had soy chicken as well, and I swear it was so small it looked like a quarter of a chicken I didn't eat it because there wasn't enough pieces to go around. The last was the fish dish, we were expecting fresh fish but it was deep fried basa fillet which was mostly dough not enough fish.

At the end of the dinner when we got the bill, it was $20 more than what was advertised online. We asked about it and the lady say yeah that is old price we forgot to update it. So beware to ask for the price before you book a table or even order. The funny thing is my sister said they told her the same thing a couple months back when she came with friends. 

The lower price is prob meant to lure people in, than they switch it with their new higher price after you ask for the bill. I think the only good thing about this place is the location. I gave it 1 star for the lobster. For paying over $240 for 6 people to eat mediocre dishes, I wouldn't recommend to anyone.

Giving this 3 out of 5 stars. Although the iced coffee and bacon egg and cheese are good, I have never ever paid $28 for two coffees and two breakfast sandwiches. This place should be in rittenhouse if they are going to charge that much.

This place was great.  The server was friendly and knowledgeable about the menu.  I have Celiac Disease and her response was "well you came to the right place!"  and she was right!  Some friends and I split the Cauliflower tacos, Enchiladas de Vegetal, sweet plaintains and rice & beans.  Everything was aaaammmaaaazing!  The sweet plaintains were to-die-for, it's like I was back in Costa Rica.

Fun funky restaurant in a restored home on Oretha Castle Haley with a nice patio in the back.  We enjoyed refreshing Cadillac margaritas with our appetizers.  All our food was delicious including the mole and the tacos, especially the shrimp and the pork.  They have live bands on the weekends!  We'lldefinitely be back.

Was in St. Louis for the night and decided to try some Kansas City style BBQ. Overall, I didn't think it was anything special. Growing up in Texas, I've been lucky enough to try some of the best BBQ joints in the country like the Salt Lick in Driftwood, TX. 

I thought the atmosphere was pretty laid back and good for coming with a group of friends. There's tvs around the place so you can catch a game along with some BBQ. 

I had the combo plate with beef and shredded pork with cole slaw and fried okra as sides, oh and a single rib. They also include two pieces of toasted garlic bread. All the meats are served naked (no sauce), but they have 5 different BBQ sauces on the table. In my opinion, I rank the sauces in this order from best to worst:

1. Original
2. Sweet and Smoky
3. Chicago Sweet
4. Kansas City
5. Spicy. 

Usually, I love a spicy BBQ sauce but this one wasn't very good. The spices were a bit off. Overall, I'd come here again, but it wouldn't be a place I'd rave about to others.

The pistachio baklava is really good. Very juicy without being overly sweet. The walnut baklava is pretty good to and you will find the sweet juice dripping from the bottom. However, the phylo is separated from the nut section.Both of them are not dry at all.

Great tamales. I had the chicken, the cornmeal is light, the chicken has good flavor. However, there was not much of the salsa as described or pictured in previous reviews. One order is for two tamales $5 plus tax.

We've been coming to longboards for years. Came for lunch on our way home and sat inside at the bar on the top level. Overall, it was an okay experience, nothing great. Ian was our server, who honestly, looked clueless about his job, hardly checked on us, and couldn't even do the basics. I had to serve my own self and table water and retrieve napkins and silverware. Ian was slow and didn't appear busy in the slightest. When asking to substitute items instead of fries, he did not mention that the substitutes would cost $3.00. I find that to be bothersome and I'd like to know beforehand what's extra cost wise prior to ordering substitutes. Again, clueless. Food was boring and nothing amazing, but sure was expensive for the basics- hamburger and fish and chips. Wouldn't go back for the food. But view and drinks are decent if you want to visit the wharf in SB.
I had salad bowl. A lot of selections of toppings. Very fresh salmon. Highly recommend. Credit card for $10 minimum purchase

Being stationed in Colorado for 3 years I became quite familiar with Smashburger since that's where they originated. I love their burgers and sweet potato fries. They are a upscale burger joint that uses fresh ingredients not frozen processed meat so the cost is somewhat higher than typical fast food. They give you practically every option there is as far as condiments, cheeses, etc. I live in Delaware and drove 45 minutes to eat at this location. It did not disappoint. Much better than the 5 guys/Jake's that are nearby.

The smell of the buns really calling you to stop by whenever you pass by. Very friendly service.

It's cheaper to buy a box of mini buns and heat them up.

If you value your bacon as much as I do, YOU WILL NOT LIKE CLEAVERS! 

Ordered a Chicken Bacon Ranch sandwich. Called to talk to someone regarding the absence of the key ingredient.. bacon and received horrible customer service. Manager wouldn't get on the phone and was insisting that I was wrong. There is not bacon unless the bacon described on there website as "thick cut" so small that it's invisible. Manager must be family because they clearly aren't qualified to be in such a position.
Cocido soup. Mole... Tres leches.... Simple setting. Decent fare.
Old style New Orleans fare, price fix is the way to go. Good flavor sand standard dishes. Great staff, great courtyard atmosphere.

This is the place to go to for breakfast.  They have a tremendous number of omelettes to chose from along with a number of other great breakfast selections.  I ordered the Eggs Benedict and it was WONDERFUL.  The potatoes that came with the breakfast can be ordered with cheese and onions, I would suggest this option.  My wife ordered a short stack of pancakes with some bacon and it was really good.  The staff was extremely friendly and efficient with helping each other as well as clearing tables to make more room for new customers.  This is a small location and could have a chance of getting really busy so come early or plan on waiting.

I have been getting my haircut at this location for 3+ years and the original crew that was there was great and all staff knew how to cut hair. About 1.5 years ago the entire staff left due to ownership issues. The next staff weren't as skilled overall but a few were good stylists. Now those people are gone and an even less skilled staff is in place. Many have voiced issues with the owner as the reason for all the staff turnover. A few of the original crew are now at the Newark location and I will be going there in the future.

Horrible service. I usually like lone star from time to time but the service was so awful my wife and I walked out without dining. We waited over 15 minutes after being seated for our drinks and the place was less than 50% full. Unacceptable. Will not return.

Brunched at B&B with a friend. Attentive wait staff. Ate half of an amazing omelet special, unusual chips&onions, and cheesy grits....the rest came home with me for another day. Will be back for dinner and a beer.

Best haircut I've ever had. Nicole was a pleasure and gave great advice. The atmosphere is clean and relaxing and the staff are friendly, professional, and knowledgeable. I highly recommend them and will be returning frequently.
This is the only shop I will ever go for my tattoo/piercing needs! Aldo is amazing!! I love the hospitality and they all make you feel welcome! Best place to go if you're looking for some ink!

Milagro is a pretty cool place.  Even when walking in, no reso, on a Saturday, we were able to get one of the many tables in the bar area.  The waiter was very enthusiastic, which can be a turn off, but he knew his stuff and was very attentive, even while keeping track of 5 other tables.  
This is a place you'd want to try the margaritas if you like that kind of thing.  For Mexican, I tend to do Cerveza or other not-so-sweet Tequila drinks.  They also had a pretty broad offering in terms of local and craft beers, both on tap and by the bottle.  The menu is very approachable, we ordered the guac to go with our chips to start.  The guacamole was very good: smooth, fresh and served with queso fresca on top to give a creamy tang in some bites.  
I had the Diablo Shrimp Tacos with a side of ?charro? beans (not the black beans).  The beans were awesome, the Tacos had tons of flavor and were not lacking shrimp.  The portions were excellent, especially for the price.  
We ended with an order of the Churros with Mexican chocolate; again: excellent.  

Good luck finding it.  Milagro can't be seen from the main drag through Webster Groves as it's tucked away in the back corner of a small plaza, so make sure to check the map before you try to come by.  If you're in the mood for some excellent food, though, give Milagro a go on your next night out.
Excellent service. Excellent pricing on great Greek food. Did not leave hungry and was completely satisfied with the experience. Will absolutely be returning.

My salad is fresh in a big bowl. The dressing isn't overwhelming and add freshness to it. The salmon is perfectly cooked but small.

The pancakes are light and delicious comes in 3 with home fries. The syrup is pretty sweet so add it moderately if you aren't into sweets. The fries is greasy and mostly burnt.
 My friend's omelette is a little bit too greasy according to her.

I would recommend for sweet breakfast than the savory. They have Elvis pancake with chocolate crunch, Nutella, and tempura battered banana. Sounds yummy.

Korean food is definitely starting to add food scene in Philadelphia.

Super friendly owner and staff. I went here when they've just opened and got free gift of nice hand towel.

I got the jap chai and beef bowl. Beef bowl has rice on the bottom, a dumpling, fresh salsa, jap chai, and delicious beef. 

The beef is very tender and amazingly delicious. Perfect seasoning, still retains the beef juice and well balanced in flavor. It melts in your mouth, not chewy or dry at all. 

The salsa is fresh with a spicy kick to it but not overwhelming and overly dominant. It gives a nice freshness to the meal. I also got the veggie jap chai. Noodle is very fresh and perfect flavor, a lot in a portion. 


The dumplings are amazingly fresh. The dough is thin and super soft but still retains the shape. Although it's fried, it's not greasy at all. Definitely get this.
The owner explained that the meat is fresh and prepared in the house. They trim and season the meat themselves.

The take out container is environmentally friendly. 

Currently not everything is available. The oven roasted chicken isn't available until March.

There are two ordering stations to place your order and there's complimentary water station.

There are some seats to eat in. 

I can't wait to try their other dish.

I am highly disappointed with not only the service, but with the quality of the food. The waitress did not even take our drink order for 10, maybe 15 minutes. She then insinuated she would take care of us and offer a break, but rather gave us a coupon for $5.00 off our next meal. Frankly, the food was mediocre and overpriced. I would have much rather received $5.00 off my bill, as I know I will never willingly eat there again.

Got burrito al pastor. It's big full of fillings.  The pork is tender.

I was disappointed because they didn't have chocolate flan. 

There are snacks and packaged cakes.

Friendly staff. Food came out fast.

My husband had al pastor burrito and he said it's good.

I had lengua aka beef tongue tacos and it's the most tender I've ever had. The tongue is cut in dice shape.
Flan is ok not too sweet.

Good food, good ambience, great hostess, fair prices- so overall a great experience (except for the one thing).
We had the jambalaya (amazing), rice and beans (great though slightly too salty) and catfish Po-Boy (ok-good) with onion rings (great). The food was too much for two people- not that we mind it! They were open late on Christmas Day which was a HUGE plus for us (don't want to encourage people staying away from their family to keep their business open, but I'm glad we had this!).

All would have been fine but for the sign that said 'beware pick pockeloose women'. I understand that's supposed to be a joke, but it still is a tasteless one. I know you are catering to a mostly drunk crowd there to have a good time, but you shouldn't have to reinforce crass stereotypes to get business (specially when you have everything else working for you). I hope the owners consider taking it down and trying to understand what's wrong with it in the first place.

Wings: very crunchy but not dry. The chicken is very moist and tender. I had honey soy spicy. It has mild spiciness. Highly recommend.

I had the crunch balls: the name says it all, it's has crunchy outside texture. It's very delicious from the mix of sweet and spicy. The filling has some veggie, It's definitely their signature dish. You will get hooked.
A proper bar and many choices of great beer! I had peanut butter blonde! Pool tables  great patios front and back porch's!

I came in around 10 and it's crowded. I had nectarine toast with ricotta and it's delicious. The bread is crunchy and the nectarine slices are fresh and sweet. I had to wait quite a while to get my order.

Peach brioche is pretty good . The bread is soft but I don't think it should be called brioche because it does not have the typical golden brioche signature color. It has some cream underneath the peach.

Granola bars with preserves are great and sweet.

I was disappointed because they didn't have walnut raisin bread.

The review is for pumpkin pie which was amazing. Ginger is the dominant flavor of the pie which is my liking. It gives some refreshing tone to it. Highly recommend it.

Staff is really nice and friendly.

The popcorn chicken is awesome. Just like the wings it's very crunchy and the meat is still tender. Honey soy and Korean barbecue has good flavor. The Korean barbecue has some spicy kick. 

The spicy tuna taco is spicy but delicious. It's like poke meets taco. One taco is big and fillings. It has generous amount of guacamole and some veggies on top.  It also has spicy mayo on the side.

Everything here doesn't disappoint me

Cheese curd; it's a nice appetizer. The breading is light and the cheese is very stretchy.

Tofu hash is delicious with two runny eggs. The tofu is soft. A lot of potato in it not too much veggies. It's on the salty side although I asked to reduce the sodium. 
I asked for no peppers in my food but I saw black specks on my egg. I asked the waiter about it and he just answered that there should not be. That's all the response I got 

The customer service needs improvement. The waiter wasn't very attentive to us. He never asked how the food was.

The chocolate cake looks yummy and big.

The food was delicious and beautifully presented. My pork and grits dish was delicious with all its accoutrements, and the shrimp and rice dish was wonderful as was the seafood stew.  However, the restaurant was a disappointment because of the ambience.  All that fine food deserves a beautiful backdrop, and the romantic, intimate atmosphere of Stella's has been transformed into a casual bistro atmosphere.  Very disappointing.

Good food, good ambience, great hostess, fair prices- so overall a great experience (except for the one thing).
We had the jambalaya (amazing), rice and beans (great though slightly too salty) and catfish Po-Boy (ok-good) with onion rings (great). The food was too much for two people- not that we mind it!They were open late on Christmas Day which was a HUGE plus for us (don't want to encourage people staying away from their family to keep their business open, but I'm glad we had this!).

All would have been fine but for the sign that said 'beware pick pockets and loose women'. I understand that's supposed to be a joke, but it still is a tasteless one. I know you are catering to a mostly drunk crowd there to have a good time, but you shouldn't have to reinforce crass stereotypes to get business (specially when you have everything else working for you). I hope the owners consider taking it down and trying to understand what's wrong with it in the first place.

This relatively new spot is great in the summer time. They have a cute outdoor space. If it's hot out though you'll definitely be sweaty as there isn't much shade. 

The hostesses were friendly and got us sat in a timely fashion. We didn't have reservations so it's a good place to go for walk ins. 

At least in the summer time they changed their menu frequently which was cool but also kind of annoying because I came back to try my second choice entree and then it obviously wasn't available. 

It's mostly american fare/casual bar food. The food was definitely tasty - they had some pretty great oysters. Happy Hour didn't get too crazy which is nice. Servers were accommodating and gave great recommendations. 

The wine list was pretty small but they had a relatively good selection for what it was. 

I was really into the outdoor space, so I'd recommend that if you're looking for a good place to grab a drink in the summer. 

Inside seems a little small but maybe they have an upstairs that i am missing.

I think I would've liked this place if I had gotten waited on. Wow unbelievable. My mom and I sat down only to watch the server wait on three other tables that came in after us before he took our drink order. After he brought us our water we were clearly ready to order and again waited on the server just to watch him take everyone else's order. He came towards us once but looked to the side and quickly changed courses and took care of another table. Fine, he got side tracked, but after that he kept waiting on other tables never to come back to us. We finally just left. Should've said something but he was too busy taking care of everyone but us. Thanks a lot, I was looking forward to trying this place out.

Cute small Thai restaurant. Service is great, very accommodating to special requests. Food came out fast.

Crab and shrimp dumplings. Five small dumplings with sauce on the bottom. Very good and full of fillings. 

Vegetable dumplings. Interesting fillings in a green dough. Pretty good.

Seafood salad. Very fresh with refreshing lime dressing. Big shrimp.

Flat noodle aka pad sew ew. Very good, noodles is perfectly cooked and soft not to chewy melts in your mouth. Fresh shrimp. 

Definitely get the mango sticky rice. It's served warm. Very delicious and sweet with fresh mango.

Overall I enjoyed the meal because the flavors is light, not too bland and not heavy in sodium. 

Definitely coming back to try more maybe the pad Thai.

You can create your own entree.
This place went downhill quick.  Dreadful service, even with a nearly empty establishment at noon on a Saturday.
The Nutella filling doesn't taste Nutella at all. The traditional ricotta is Ok. Termini ricotta cannoli is the best.

This review is for the delicious sesame cookie with chocolate and marmalade filling. The cookie is covered with toasted sesame that gives crunchy texture.They posted in Instagram and I responded that I would like to get it. That's a great decision because when I got there around 10 it was already sold out but he saved mine. What a service.

Towing services usually get a bad rap, but this is scathing review is more than deserved. 

I was sent to them via my insurance carrier to replace a dead battery. They did and within a year, the battery died. They REFUSED to honor the 2 year warranty they provided upon purchase of the first battery. After a month of unanswered calls and un-returned voicemails, I finally got the driver to come out. Then that battery died within a month!!!! I cut my loses and purchased a new battery from a different source. This place deserves no stars and no business. They should be removed as a vendor from every insurance policy.

They are truly, terrible people.

I've been trying different Chinese places for the past few weeks to find a "go-to" for all my Chinese cravings. This has been the best thus far. I live too far out for the delivery service so I had to pick it up but it was worth it! 
We had the sweet and sour pork, general tso chicken, beef and broccoli, and pork egg rolls. The egg rolls were pretty good - had lots of flavor and were nice and crunchy. The sweet and sour pork was my fave- they use just the right amount of breading and the sauce was spot on! The beef and broccoli was good but I actually ended up putting a little salt on it bc I found it to be on the sweeter side. The fried rice was pretty good - pretty much standard for any other Chinese place around here. 
My DH had the general Tsos chicken and although he's not super picky he said it was good and he would order it again. 
The person taking my order was nice too. They seemed to understand my order and I could understand her when she spoke to me. The food was ready and waiting for us 15min later. 
I think the prices are good too. Definitely got the bang for our buck! 
Overall 4/5.

Good Chinese takeout food. I say takeout, because they do not deliver :(

My standard order of dumplings, lo mein, and wonton soup is delicious and so are the egg rolls. I have also had the general tso's, beef and broccoli, pepper steak, and BBQ spare ribs as well. All above average. 

If you want authentic Chinese fare, Han Dynasty is right down the street. But as far as takeout, this stacks up with the best in the area.

Korean food is definitely starting to add food scene in Philadelphia.Super friendly owner and staff. I went here when they've just opened and got free gift of nice hand towel.

I got the jap chai and beef bowl. Beef bowl has rice on the bottom, a dumpling, fresh salsa, jap chai, and delicious beef. 

The beef is very tender and amazingly delicious. Perfect seasoning, still retains the beef juice and well balanced in flavor. It melts in your mouth, not chewy or dry at all. 

The salsa is fresh with a spicy kick to it but not overwhelming and overly dominant. It gives a nice freshness to the meal. I also got the veggie jap chai. Noodle is very fresh and perfect flavor, a lot in a portion. 


The dumplings are amazingly fresh. The dough is thin and super soft but still retains the shape. Although it's fried, it's not greasy at all. Definitely get this.
The owner explained that the meat is fresh and prepared in the house. They trim and season the meat themselves.

Currently not everything is available. The oven roasted chicken isn't available until March.

There are two ordering stations to place your order and there's complimentary water station.

There are some seats to eat in. 

I can't wait to try their other dish.

It usually sells for public every other Saturday or when they announce it through Instagram. The same owner as Mighty Melt at the Bourse. There's an easel of sign of the bakery on 12th st to let public know it's open.

They have samples of the bread. If they don't have it you can ask.

Their bread is sourdough and they are the chewy and moist. The best time to eat it is when it's fresh right away from the bakery . There are some seats and table outside.

There are variety of breads and some sweet treats and cookies.

Walnut raisin: my favorite. The raisins are big and juicy and the walnuts give a crunchy texture.

Chocolate: not to sweet filled with mini chocolate chips.

Country, sesame, and seeded : all of them really good, perfect sourdough. Very crunchy crust when it's fresh 

There are cheddar and jalapeño kinds too.

Ricotta pound cake: very moist, sweet, and delicious. Highly recommended.

There are sliced toasted bread with sweet spread topping and sliced almond. Delicious too.

Rye cookies: sweet and crunchy. 

Very friendly staff. You feel welcomed. The lady gave me plastic to wrap the bread to be frozen.

My favorite bakery for perfect sourdough

The review is for the mochi pie and tahini cookie.

Mochi pie has smooth filling with perfect soft chewy mochi. Sweetness is on point.

Tahini chocolate chip cookie is delicious. Not overly sweet with chunks of chocolate. 

Friendly staff and fast service.

Vegan breakfast Cuban (possibly not listed on menu) - 10/10. Picture this: Cuban bread, tofu scramble, bacon, cheese, smashed into a Cuban making machine. Delicious. Was it cheap? No, I spent my last $11. Would I get it again? Every day for the rest of my life

Definitely get the chocolate and walnut raisin and enjoy it while they are warm. 

The oatmeal raisin cookies is delicious and very crunchy.

Very friendly owner. Everyone is welcomed as family.

This review is for sashimi platter: very fresh with beautiful presentation.

Service is good as they are willing with my substitution of spicy tuna roll. Food came out slow considering i

We were sitting next to an aquarium which looks a little bit dirty and I saw a floating rubber band

I placed my order for pickup through its website. Very user friendly. The menu is extensive: pizza, Stromboli, breakfast, milkshake, smoothies.

When I arrived about half hour later, my food was ready. Staff is friendly. 

Tacos al pastor is delicious. I can taste the spice of the seasoning which is very down distinct. It has some pineapple and small pieces of nopales aka cactus. Meat is a little bit overcooked but generous in portion. It also comes with some carrot sticks, jalapeño, and small onion. Overall it's a pretty good tacos

Very friendly staff. A lot of choices of chocolate. I definitely recommend the hazelnut spread. You won't regret it. I think it's better than Nutella. I like the European collection next to the bins of truffles.

First time trying Popeye's and not impressed at all. Very small servings, asked for ranch dressing, didn't get any. Ordered strawberry cheesecake pies, didn't have either of the flavors we wanted so we ordered plain pies, 1 cherry, 1 apple, got 2 apple (1 marked as cherry but wasn't).  The staff were nice, tho seemed distracted and were talking a lot amongst themselves, place was pretty clean in the lobby.

Came here for the Crown exhibit. From the welcoming center you take a shuttle to go to the house. The tour guide for the house tour is very knowledgeable and friendly. The house is beautiful. You can take pictures.

The cafeteria area is big and spacious. There's a buffet area for salad, pasta, sliders, station for sandwich, and they also have soup. Mushroom soup is delicious and you can taste the mushroom. Salad is fresh . I also had brussel sprouts, gnocchis, chickpea salad. All of them are delicious and perfectly seasoned. The grilled chicken is tough though. The cake has a taste of made from the box of cake mix

The tour of the garden is great too. Very knowledgeable guide and friendly

Friday night, curfew is about to strike, state-wide quarantine has you hallucinating to the point you forgot to grocery shop... now what? I was striving to add to my pandemic weight gain, so ordering out was the move. I heard about Xtreme Tacos from a vegan FB group, and decided to take a look at the menu. They have a WHOLE VEGAN section!!!!!! I'm talkin vegan burritos and tacos, the works.

Thought things were already going so well, that I decided to give them a call. The line was busy, but if this happens to you - CALL AGAIN! They only have one line. 

When the call finally went through, I was met with a very pleasant individual on the other line. Not only was she beyond helpful, but she offered me a sample of the establishment's vegan queso (sweet potato based I believe) and let me in on a little secret item (probably not a secret) which was BARBACOA SEITAN!!! heck yeah. I ordered 2 of the buffalo cauliflower and one of the seitan. In addition, ordered chips & guac.

Pulled up, went to pick up the food, added some to-go sangria and called it a day. In total, we ordered 6 tacos, chips & queso, chips & guac, elotes and two sangrias for less than $60. I personally think that's a steal.

Here's the info you're waiting for:
Buffalo cauliflower tacos - 10/10, would order again
Barbacoa seitan - 13/10
Guac - 4/10 (I personally like very chunky guac, but if you do not prefer chunky guac, get this guac. The chips are freshly made, thick and delicious though)
Sangria - 10/10, freaking delicious red sangria 
Sample of vegan queso - 9/10!!! Very good!!

Second hand info on the non-vegan items:
Fish taco - 4/10 ("it's not for me, the fish tacos in Arizona are better)
Carne asada - 10/10
Elotes - 5/10 ("too watery, not enough cream")
Chips and queso - 10/10

Overall, this was an excellent experience from ordering to pick-up. I can't wait to go back! The seitan tacos were so freaking good and I could eat them every day. Be sure to map this if you're not familiar with how to navigate the one way streets. There's ample parking spots that can be accessed off of both Platt and Howard.
Ordered takeout here due to covid. Empanadas were great! Fries were good. I don't have a large background in empanadas so I will reserve comparing to anywhere else. Will return.

I called to place my order of tacos al pastor. and it's ready pretty fast. Good flavor, which is enhanced with the lime and salsa verde. However, the meat is a little bit dry with a lot of charred pieces. It comes with a big jalapeño 

They sell tamales every day. It is smaller than those from other places. Meat is a little bit tough, has spicy kick.
Andrew is very professional and knowledgeable. He was able to fix our wooden base in our dining room table and we couldn't be happier with the result! Would highly recommend!

I came in here after seeing Craig Laban's post on Instagram. He recommended al pastor tacos and he is right. My husband and my father in law enjoyed their al pastor. I ordered birria tacos available only on Friday and Saturday.

This place is small but can accommodate at least three groups of customers. There are a lot of construction area in the neighborhood, so parking can be a challenge.

The owner is very friendly and welcoming. It was a cold day so she put a space heater near our table. On the shelves on the wall there are masks of luchador/wrestler. She explained that before Covid people took pictures with the masks.

Guacamole and chips are fresh. The only dessert available was tres leches. I hope they make the flan an churros as printed on the menu
