Birria tacos: it's pretty good served with hot consommé in a small cup with chunks of meat in it. One of my tacos had chunks of fat that I removed. The tortilla wasn't as crispy as I expected.

I came in here because of the sign saying that they have some dim sum dish. I got the shiumai and sticky rice wrapped in leaves. Both have great authentic flavor. One container of shiumai has 8 of nice size of them. Highly recommend it.

It's a cash only bakery. An elderly Italian lady was helping me. You can definitely feel the mom and pop atmosphere as she was talking to a well known customer in Italian.  I showed the yelp check in offer of free fig bar. She said it's old but she would honor it.

Fig bar: a lot of moist fig fillings. Not hard at all and not overly sweet. Highly recommend.

Baba rum is really soaked with light rum. She put it in a plastic bag with the soaking liquid. Not too sweet, has a very light run. 

Italian rum cake is very moist and the cake layer is super soft. Unfortunately I didn't taste any rum. It's okay.

Ricotta cannoli is ok, no chocolate chip in it.

Food is above average, along with the ambience. Our waiters have also been great. However, the hostess throws everything off as they are the 1st impression coming into the restaurant. This isn't the first time we've had a negative experience with the host. No greeting, just sort of a head nod. When our table was called we would of needed to sprint to keep up with her.

I've been meaning to review Cafe Hey for awhile, but since I order so often, now is a good time. While my opinion on the "sit down" aspect of this establishment might not be relevant right now, I will say, this place is somewhere to look forward to visiting. The ambiance inside is very quaint and laid back. There are some seats outside too, so when n life goes back to normal, be sure to visit!!!

Anyways, I'm here to tell you about the vegan breakfast sandwich. Cuban bread, pressed. Scrambled tofu, better than I've ever made. FYH vegan cheese and (maybe?) sweet earth vegan bacon!! Sound delicious? Yes. This GIANT sandwich  will cost you a grand total of SIX DOLLARS. This is the cheapest, most delicious vegan breakfast sandwich in the area and I highly recommend. They carry We Vegan Eats snacks, have delicious coffee and an array of vegan syrup and I just really love this place okay.

Tried the vegan pasta salad today for the first time and it was 10/10.

I had my eyes checked yesterday by Dr Bilalis and it was a great experience. He found that my previous Dr had too strong of a prescription which was causing headaches and issues with my contacts and now am doing a whole lot better. Very professional staff and a great experience overall. I highly recommend.

First visited this shop a few years back, and they seem to have a decent variety of classic game systems and games. However, the experience was below par in terms of trade-ins and purchases. They market themselves as a shop that buys anything game or electronic-related,as well as a repair shop. So, when I have brought in working and cosmetically clean goods they have given less than reasonable trade in value. Or, as in the most recent 2 visits, they have refused workable goods because of minor cosmetic flaws. As if they have not sold reduced-sale products with flaws before. Their whole attitude was "well, this is a project to fix, and I don't feel like it". That's fine and all, but maybe we should stop advertising ourselves as a repair shop, which buys, sells, and trades. These two visits were my last, there are OTHER SHOPS that may be worth going out of my way for, I suggest shopping around before coming here.

Very disappointed in my experience here. Not only did I receive and eat half of a "vegan" sandwich before realizing that the cheese was not in fact vegan, but I wasn't offered a replacement or a refund or anything.

If you're vegan, ask multiple times for clarification on what is and isn't vegan, because I was told by two different employees that the sandwich was vegan. I hope the owners are aware of this because if I had a dairy allergy that would've been real bad.

2 stars because it looks like a cool place, has a chill atmosphere and I'm sure the food is good otherwise.

As the weather is getting nicer, they take advantage of the seating area outside by selling coffee an more breakfast toast.

I had this toast with avocado and citrus slices. It's so good and refreshing.

The toast with chocolate sourdough and preserves and slices of toasted almond is another one to recommend.
This spot was amazing!! We stopped by while shopping around and had the beet salad and chicken fried rice. Mind blowingly amazing flavor!!! We will definitely be back for both dishes!

The review is for the sandwiches that I bought at Rittenhouse square festival.

All sandwiches are made with delicious and crusty Sarcone's bread.

My husband had Matteo and he said it's excellent.

Phillies special: the eggplant spread with balsamic vinegar on the base of the sandwich was a bomb. The cutlet isn't crispy deep fried kind. It's lightly fried and mine was cold because I saw it being taken out from a cooler. I asked the owner about the cutlet and she said it was supposed to be room temperature. Maybe when I go to the restaurant it will be different.

I will try different kinds next time.

If you are hoping to find Local AZ Plants to add to your xeriscape, here's the motherload of flora! Unique non-profit outfit nursery that offers indigenous southwestern plants while providing employment for persons with disabilities. WIN-WIN!

Fried chicken that's crispy on the outside and juicy in the middle. Wide array of sauces. Cold beer on tap. Excellent fries. Good mac n cheese balls. It's the epitome of what a chicken and beer joint can and should be. Excellent.

Very friendly staff. I got cannoli cake and it's awesome. Taste like tiramisu.

I also recommend this cannoli, taste like regular version. You won't know it's vegan

Great atmosphere for an upscale dining experience. There's harp player at the entrance. Service was excellent

Appetizer: crab cakes comes in three small cakes. Very crunchy and perfectly seasoned. Very light and perfect appetizer size.

Seabass was amazing. Perfectly cooked and melts in your mouth. The sauce is light and in point.

Duck with orange sauce was unbelievably delicious. The marmalade orange was refreshing and perfect compliment to the fatty duck. The skin was crispy, the meat was tender. 

Bread: roll is dry but the zucchini bread is my favorite. You can buy a loaf.

Dessert: chocolate soufflé. I was expecting a warm soufflé in ramekin but It was served small on a plate. It's delicious with chocolate sauce around it. I was a little bit disappointed. 

Mini eclairs are delicious they are special that day. Full of fillings. Tangerine is very refreshing.

I am giving this place another chance due to its extensive menu to introduce my friend to Indonesian cuisine. It's a big mistake. There's only one waiter. He abandoned us while taking our orders to seat people, serve food, and fill out water to different tables.

Entrees came out first while my appetizer came out last. We wanted to order fried banana for dessert at 7:33 but was told that kitchen had closed. He's blaming us for not ordering earlier, now it's 3 minutes late.

My husband loves kwetiaw as it is written on the menu but was told it's no longer available. So dissatisfied. 

I will take my business to Sky Cafe at 11 and Washington mall with parking area.

I will never dine here again.

My usual stop is The streudel. Very flaky and delicious. You can choose sweet or savory fillings. Sweet Fillings: apple, cherry, almond. They have Bavarian pretzel, churros, cinnamon sugar pretzel too. 

There's Nutella and chocolate peanut butter puff pastry. 

Accept credit card payment.
It's a must visit for Christmas. The streudels are very flaky and crispy. Very friendly staff. It's big and there is a box for 2 strudels.

The store manager is extremely rude racism and lazy, I forgot how to exactly spell her name, is something like si.. ta,the name card has say manager, i went there shopping, I ask her one simple question, do you have  that ?she answer me so unpatienction and rude , I didn't say anything that time, i just go find the item i was looking for , than when I try paid my item with the credit card,I told her can I pay with my card, she didn't answer me, just stare at me,did not say a word,  so I just inserted my card, finally when I finished pay, i though she try to hand me the receipt, so i just take me recipe, she went crazy about it,she said I snatch the recipe,which I didn't and not mean to, I even said sorry i didn't know that, I thought you try to hand me the recipe, I'm not try to give you any hard time ok,she just keep give me the attitude said I did snatch the recipe, give me the hard time.   Even try to take next customer  behind me when she is not even finish pack my stuff,thou whole time , she never act nice and smile or be understanding,maybe because i'm asian,because right after i left,she act so nice to others people which Is not asian.As a store manager, I don't think that is the right way to treat people ,if you are not in the goodmood or you don't like other colors people, I don't think you can handle the manager job , because you don't have any customer service

The bread is okay and it's on the dry side. 

However the tomato pie is delicious. Crunchy crust especially the corner topped with fresh tomato sauce. I wish there's more sauce because it's very good

Found this place a couple of visits ago to avoid the crowd and hassle of getting to Cafe Du Monde. It's inside the Renaissance Arts Hotel with cozy seating. EXCELLENT beignets and coffee!!! If you're in or near the warehouse district, just come here for your beignets and enjoy them in peace :)

Beautiful mansion and garden. Staff is super friendly and knowledgeable. They are available in the whole mansion. The tour shuttles are pretty frequent 

Don't forget to get some gifts at the gift shop.

I arrived at this place at 11 but there's nobody at the main area. Finally a lady from the kitchen came out and asked me what I wanted. After giving my orders I was surprised that she didn't put them in the order station so I asked her to write them down on a piece of paper. Finally a gentleman came out apologizing for shortness of staff and officially put my orders in. I assume he's the manager. Super friendly and welcoming to all guests. Great customer service. 

The menu is nicely shown on the wall with a picture of Rocky holding a bun on each hand. The fillings are various and in my opinion a fusion, such as Gringo with salsa rojas, Yenti with pastrami. The names are pretty funny. For dessert I had the fried bun with cinnamon and sugar with glaze dipping It's ok, you can skip it.

I ordered hot motha clucks, Yenti, bao boa. All of them are delicious. Three of the baos are nicely packed in a paper container with dividers to separate the baos and also to maintain the shape and fillings of the baos. I am looking forward to trying more.

I was in town for my nephews graduation- yes!! Tonight was my last night and my sista  said hey let's go out one last night ... um Sunday night ! The Social is new so we decided to try it on a quiet night. Bang Bang Shrimp yum- Brussel Sprouts with truffle oil and bacon yum - I needed a veggie after eating and drinking since last Monday starting my vaca
Everything was good but Emily our bartender was not real attentive - having to ask to order food - asked for water - my sisters water was empty and I had to give her mine. Makes me wonder how the service is when they are busy - other than that I hope it makes it for this area - we were talking to someone behind us I turned around to make a toast and my drink was gone ! It's 11:30 they close at midnight.... really ??

I was underwhelmed with my meal. I ordered the chicken fried chicken. The portion was quite small with barely any chicken and tasteless, and the stuffing was very dry. The waitress was very nice and attentive.

Ordered two parts for my vacuum and waited two weeks to get them, when the one came in they said they could order the second part if I needed it. Wtf! So I told them never mind I will pick up the filter and see if I could get it somewhere else, they asked me to leave the filter at their store so they could match it up when  I went to pick up the original filter they had lost the original part. Will not go again.

Love this place.  The rooms are beautifully designed, simple, crisp and fresh.  Owner and Manager (two people I dealt with) are helpful and professional.  

It is a motel and it is very clean and minimal design.  Easy to unpack your car.  Pluses:  Flat screen TV, great little guide to Santa Barbara, adjustable heating, blackout curtains, mini fridge, microwave, light breakfast snack and fairly spacious and well appointed rooms with an artistic flavor.  

The two flaws in the experience are the thin walls and the beds are not the best.  I found the beds to be reasonable (I tend to be picky in this area) but lacking.  My neighbor was loud one early AM and while I was not pleased, the Management handled it beautifully and it was no longer a problem. 

It is near Whole Foods and a fantastic French bakery among other amenities.  Not near the beach, but a quiet location.   

I really enjoyed my stay.  This is a very well run place.  For the price, comfort and location, I would stay here again if I am within 60 miles of SB.

Came here at 1:30 on a Friday (they're open until 3). Fast service, even better food. Went with the Paneer Tikka roll and Lamb Kabob roll - excellent! Tastes just as good as the original Kati roll in NYC. Make sure you grab some white sauce and hot sauce on the side. Will definitely come here again

I was all set to love this place and I'm super sad that I didn't. There were a few good points, the concept is cool, the bartender and server were really nice, the steak was perfectly cooked and seasoned, and they brew their own ginger beer, which was amazing.

However, the things that are supposed to make this place unique were lacking. They called to confirm my reservation and during that conversation I was told there was a dress code (business casual and absolutely no ripped jeans, t-shirts, etc.) and that there was a password to get in. When we got there, we were not asked for the password, and there were definitely people there in ripped jeans and t-shirts. This normally wouldn't be an issue for me, but it felt like they went through great lengths to let me know the policies and I didn't feel like they took it all that seriously. 

The food (besides the steak) was just okay, the drinks were just okay, we were sat at the worst possible table in the bar area right by the bar/server station and it definitely took away from the experience. Our reservation was for two hours and we would have loved to have stayed for dessert, but after an hour of being jostled and interrupted, we were just ready to get out of there. 

This place got such good reviews and I was so excited to go, but it was not a good experience. I might like to try it again because it seems like a cool concept and everyone has off nights.*

*I had to edit my review because customer service from Ciro's messaged me to apologize for my experience and offer me a gift certificate to return. That is some pretty excellent customer service and that is hard to come by these days. Thanks, Ciro's.

The food was good, the price was good, the service was good, the ambience in the restaurant was that of a waffle house, yellow with plastic chairs.  That said, the food was authentic, well seasoned, and in generous portions.  The chips were made fresh but the salsa that went with them was not.  I think it would be better as a food truck than the standing location.  Or get it to go.

Tonight I had an awful and unprecedented experience with a driver named George. After he had picked us up from the airport, he engaged with us in an aggressive and combative manner. He clearly has a significant problem with impulse control. In order to get his point across about possible liability if we were to get injured while he was driving us from the airport, he slammed on his brakes in the middle of a highway, sending my partner onto the floor of the bus and also an old lady sprawling onto her husband. We were very shaken, shocked and upset. After the adrenaline wore off, my partner slowly became aware of the discomfort of her fall. If Wallypark would like to be considered a reputable business, having a driver who treats customers like this is truly a liability for them. Since George broached the topic of liability, we will consider whether contacting a lawyer is the appropriate next step.

Since Amazon bought Whole Foods, the price is more reasonable even cheaper than Reading Terminal Market. Banana, organic apple, broccoli are cheaper. Broccoli crown at Reading is $1.99 per pound but Whole Foods is $1.49 per pound. On Saturday between 12 to 4 there are sampling stations. Sushi is really fresh and delicious

My husband and I's recent visit was very disappointing not because of the food, but because of the service.  We were literally rushed out of there.  We went looking for a special meal in a special restaurant.  We frequent many restaurants in New Orleans and hadn't had the opportunity to go to go to Galatoire's in awhile and we wanted to try it out.  We didn't ask for a specific waiter - Big Mistake!  We repeatedly told the waiter that we wanted to take our time and enjoy the evening and even refused to order for awhile to enjoy our wine and hors d'oeuvres, but he hovered constantly and repeatedly came to the table even though it was quite obvious that we wanted to relax and have a leisurely meal.  Even though we had coffee and dessert, we finished way before two other groups of friends who are regular customers and who had arrived there long before us.  So beware,  if you're not a regular customer, you are not treated equally at Galatoire's!

Came back - this time, this place exceeded my expectations!  Great service.  Delicious food (again!).  Curry Udon noodles were spicier than last time, but so good.  Rebellion Ramen on point.  Wife and I had craft cocktails as well which were amazing.

Amazing chocolate. Very mom and pop store. Very nice and friendly owner . My Easter candies shopping spot. They are well known for the Easter candies. Coconut., coconut cream, butter cream, peanut butter, nuts with different sizes based on the weight. Closes at 4 Sunday usually closes but a week before Easter it is open. Delicious chocolate covered pretzel too. Everything is cheap.

I'm not only reviewing this classy bar with detailed tin ceiling, classic wood  bar, great top shelf liquors, and excellent upscale pub vibe.  I am also reviewing the band that plays on Saturday nights.. FANTASTIC!  Old time music that makes you dance and the singer has some of the most amazing pipes I've heard.  I enjoyed the mixed crowd, mixed ages and types of people.  Some tourists from LA just stood around gawking, not drinking or dancing, getting in the way of both.   Whatcha gonna do?  It's a bar.  Bartenders are fast.  As others have mentioned, you may find a peanut in your pocket the next day.

SweetWater is one of the best restaurants in the area - it has something for everyone! The Thai chicken wrap is to die for, especially with a side of sweet potato fries. The staff and owners are always warm, welcoming, and attentive. I always look forward to having a meal here!

I love this family owned brewery!  Their beer is amazing and the setting is spectacular.  A nice aspect is that you can bring in your own food to eat while enjoying their brews.  Try the Paridise and Jubilee beers, they're popular for a good reason.
Great bagels!  Their sesame seed bagels with cream cheese are fabulous.  Quick service is also a plus.

Fast checkout because there are many express registers for 20ish items. They upgraded the dessert displays to make it more appealing. The pizza is really good. The crust is very moist. Sometimes there are samples. Get the mochi by the sushi area. It's self serve wit plastic containers next it. Very good, not too sweet.

I got a coupon for a free class and went last night to the 6:30 class with Kimmy. It was super great! Kimmy was so nice, actually everyone in there was super nice, even the other people in the class. 

Even as a first timer, I felt pretty comfortable. The class is set up for people at all stages of fitness, each of the movements have modifications to make it more challenging, but if you aren't there yet, it's no problem at all. It says the class is for all levels and they absolutely mean it. 

It's a completely different way to work out and I thought it would be hard to catch on because I am lacking in grace and have no dance background but it really wasn't. I will definitely be back.

We had a wonderful birthday celebration dinner at Rosedale's. The service was great ( Alec) and the ambiance was fun although a little too noisy. The food was delicious - we had caponata ( delicious!) and shrimp as appetizers. The lamp meatballs were delicious as was the warm mushroom salad. Another person got the venison ragout which they said was delicious.
Walked on the tracks from Lee Circle to Canal.  Never saw the first car.  Waited 45 minutes for the Canal line. And finally saw a St Charles car turning to go uptown.

Was here on Sunday for their boozy brunch trivia. 

I liked the idea of trivia on a Sunday afternoon paired with brunch. The execution of the trivia was great and they offer bottomless mimosas, bloody marys, and domestic beer for $20 a person. Pretty great deal. 

However...the spicy chicken sandwich that I, along with half of our group ordered was easily the most over salted piece of chicken I ever had. Also, the amount of red onion they put on the sandwich was almost comical (way to much). The food was a miss, but the cheap drinks and good trivia made this a fun day.

My favorite is the salad bar.
There are mixed green, ice berg, romaine, and spinach.
 Next to it you can find veggies such as roasted corn, broccoli, mushroom, peas, shredded carrot, edamame, chopped ham, and chopped eggs. You can find hummus, beets, pico de gallo at the next station. At the end of salad bar you can get pasta salad, egg salad, and orrechiette pesto, which is I highly recommend. There are several options of dressing too.

At the end you can find some flat bread kinda of pita, really good crispy lavash (another favorite), dried cranberries,  and croutons.

It's definitely worth it.

If you sign up at the website,  you can get special deals, such as $5 for salad bar for lunch. How can you beat such a bargain?

I took one star down because some of the ice berg has some brownish edges and they don't keep up with the pesto pasta. When I wanted to get my second, it's pretty much empty and it's still not at the peak of lunch hour yet.

I would like to thank Dr. Java who saved my dogs life about this time last year. I would like to know a good email to submit a photo of my happy and healthy Boston terrier Stella. My little girl accidently ate a friends muscle relaxers in early April last year. I came home to an almost lifeless dog and rushed her to your Philadelphia location. Dr. Java was amazing along with all the staff that I wish I could remember all their names. Stella was in a coma for 2 days before she finally woke up. I have never seen such a caring staff. Not only did Dr. Java keep me updated every day and night, the entire staff was just amazing.
 Even while Stella was in a coma, every day when I would show up to see her, there would be a member of your staff looking after her, and constantly talking to her and petting her. When we first got there, Melissa was just getting done her shift and was about to leave when she saw us come in. Not only did she help out, she went out of her way to drive to UPENN and back to get by baby the medicine she needed that you did not have on site. I would really appreciate knowing her name if it is possible to look in the records. 
When my baby girl finally woke up while I was there during one of my the visits, Dr. Garret Pachtinger,  was overseeing her at the time, he said that usually at this time they ask that family members leave, however since Stella woke up to my voice, and he said it seemed that I was helping calm her, he said I could stay. This was the turning point he told me, either she will fight through it, or she won't make it and only time will tell if she will make be able to recover, and if so, will be it a full one or if she will have brain damage.  This was one of the happiest and scariest moments in my life. I had no control and could only try and calm my little girl as she screamed and yelped in confusion. She could not see or walk, but would try and move towards me and my voice. I stayed for an hour or two and could see that she was making more and more progress. Finally they told me I should let her rest and I could come back later that night. 
When I came back the staff gave me a private room, and brought Stella in to see me. They allowed me to lay with her for as long as I wanted, never once did I feel like anyone was trying to rush me or tell me I had to leave.  Needless to say for those few nights I didn't sleep at all, and that night when I went home it was the same, except this time I couldn't sleep due to excitement. I had to work the next day and drove straight to the hospital after, at which point I was again given my own private room. To my surprise when the door opened, Stella came walking in all on her own!
 Today she is back to her normal self of running around and if anything has more energy and passion then before her accident. I want to say THANK YOU to all of your staff members. I would also like to send a photo of her now so that the people who saved her life and see the results of the amazing work. I would also love to know who the other doctors that helped save my baby girl's life if that is not too much to ask.

Day one of jury duty we got let out for a longish lunch, stopped by rooster for some savory crepes and was so happy I did.  The goat cheese with mushroom and roasted tomatoes was excellent.  

They were super quick, too.  I recommend for bfast or lunch!
The Tanzanian brew with HWC is worth the wait.  Not far from the train tracks but a great place for a caffeine jolt

Arrived there around 9:30 Saturday morning. There are several pastries choices available. I saw plain, chocolate, and apple croissants. The chocolate croissant is really good and so is the apple, tiramisu is good too. Macarons are available around noon. I have to come back some other time.

Horrible!!!! Husband and I signed a lease with them I was moving out of state to tennessee from Phoenix plan was to get off the plane and go straight to the house.. lease had started that same day. Got off the plane I had no car atm had to get an uber.. so I get there the damn padlock and code wouldn't work kept getting a message that said code does not match the padlock or whatever.. I was livid kids were cold in 30 degree weather I had my luggage. Stuff was dropped off in pods.. I was in tears!!! Tried calling them and nothing offices were closed that's understandable but I called every number I found linked to them on Google. No answer. Called next day got a hold of the California leasing office.. since the Nashville office dismt answer their phones. California couldn't get a hold of them either. Nsahville didn't call me back nothing.. but hey she answered my emails. -_- .. motherless I finally got into my house the next day after having to pay for a hotel and they charged us for that day of rent when I couldn't even get in!... fast forward a couple days later some guy comes to take the padlock off the front door handle.. what do you k ow ge struggled to get it off.. it was faulty. Now I'm going back and forth with their office trying to get reimbursed for that day and the stupid hotel stay.. this is bs. Worst company ever filing a claim with the bbb
Delicious!! Wonderful service and even though it was busy and crowded, we got our food in no time. The seafood pot pie is AMAZING!!!

The best Canelé ever. The outside is very crunchy and crispy but the inside is moist with custard texture. Not overly sensitive with a hint of lemon and vanilla. The mini size is crunchier and you cannot really taste the custard compared to the regular size

Food is amazing, 5 stars! The lamb vindaloo is epic, the naan is awesome but you will die of thirst before you get a refill on a drink or waited on in general. I would come here much more often if the staff were even the slightest bit attentive.

Perfect location to go for a date night or when in the mood for some great sushi! Their lobster mac & cheese will leave you craving for more! Not to mention their filet mignon quesadillas are delicious! If ever in the soho area you fed want to give them a try!

Recently started charging an extra 3% when paying your bill by credit card.  While this is now legal to do, it is poor business practice.  So many other great places in this town-- I'll take my business elsewhere.

This is very nice hippie place,gourment food,exactly the style I usually cook.I saw the waitress fingers in my carot shake and there was something sticked to spoon but I did not really care,as I said it is hippie place and the food was awesome.

First impression: bad-- Hostess had all the personality of a dead fish.  Maybe some restaurants think that's cool, but I don't.
We got three dishes.
The Korean rib sliders were awesome.  
Likewise, the Udon curry noodles with kaffir lime and lemongrass chicken also delicious. 
Duck with pho spices-- either not as advertised in menu, or they brought us the wrong thing.  Waitress explained it was correct, but it seemed more like a ground meat empanada.  Tasted good, but cold in the middle.
Hopefully they are just still getting the kinks worked out.  Overall a good concept with tasty, interesting food.
I will definitely go back (and hopefully be able to give it 5 stars!)
Just moved to the neighborhood and tried Pizza Dads as our first pizza experience. Will for sure be coming back often. Long hot pepper aioli on the side is to die for !

Not quite a fan, but this can be a good stay.  The location is ideal.  Next to beach and harbor.

The rooms looking West are great, the ones which face the park. 

The rooms facing the ocean and along the inside all rattle from a probably code violating HVAC system or the fan from the neighboring restaurant.  A loud/intense rattle vibration in the rooms at 11pm.

Staff is nice, but a few are a touch ingratiating.  Breakfast reasonably good.
Free wifi and parking.

The staff definitely deserves five star rating. Really welcoming and giving recommendations. The mushroom is amazing, very light and addictive. The roasted veggies is really good too. It has roasted sweet potato, eggplants, green and yellow zucchini, red pepper, and cauliflower . The hummus itself is not heavy and not too salty, served warm. It's perfect consistency of smooth creaminess. I was advised not to refrigerate the warm version because it's made from hot chickpeas. You can ask for cold version too that can be stored in the fridge. 

Each order comes with pita. Regular or whole wheat, and some pickled veggies 

The baklava is very fresh and crispy with perfect sweetness and loaded with nuts. I believe it's pistachios.

The seating area has a nice view of a small park. Very relaxing.

They have loyalty program, $10 after 10 visits.

The entrance is the door close to the park.

A great place that is consistently good.

We had dinner and drinks there, and breakfast the next day.  We quite liked the atmosphere and setting.  

The staff are simply terrific.  They are knowledgable and friendly.  The food was quite good.  There is also live entertainment.  

Have a look at the menu and give it a try.
You've got to be crazy to go here. Way outdated, bad food and servers who same to be from the civil war era. We ordered apps and couldn't make it to dinner. Left and went elsewhere.

By far the worst staff to ever deal with! They don't care about kids or family all they care about is money! We had a death in the family and had to fly to New York and they said because it wasn't 2 weeks we still had to pay for the week he was out. When the Hurricane Irma and Maria hit we were on a cruise and the captain kept us out at sea setting us back 9 days and the day care said we were still responsible for those 2 weeks not even caring that we had a letter from the cruise line and all. My son went through 4 teachers in a matter of months and as parents never once were we notified. I would randomly walk my son into his class and see someone new to then be told that was his new teacher. While there were 2 or 3 excellent teachers that my son had such as Ms.Betsy and Ms.Sonia for some reason the good ones leave. Due to many reasons that had built up over time we decided our son wasn't going back and were going to withdraw him. We then find out that they wouldn't accept verbal notification and were going to be billed 2 extra weeks plus be charged back a week of vacation time he had time used since he didn't not complete the school year even though he's been attending for 2 years!!

I had to go the pork carnitas. Good flavor but it's greasy. The grease leaked out from the container.

I was the only customer but after placing my order, it's not passed on to the chef until he realized that there's an order waiting. He's not far from the order counter.

I took the kids to Seger Park and stopped by here on the way back. What a gem! I was looking for some nice yarn for a crocheter as part of a Secret Santa swap and was directed to the baby alpaca wool. Beautiful solids and variegated colors and sooo soft! I even bought a couple skeins for myself. Very friendly atmosphere and beautiful yarn!

I've been to Soulard's twice for lunch and gotten the same thing each time because I'm a vegetarian, and apparently on a menu with forty different options, you only need to have a quiche, a veggie melt and a vegetable salad to be considered vegetarian friendly.  I know going into places that my options are going to be limited.  That's something I expect, it's easier to pick from two or three items rather than forty.  
But if you're going to put two or three vegetarian options on your menu... They'd better be good.  

My salad was good: Soulard's house dressing is enjoyable (tons of sugar).  But my quiche came out looking like a deflated mess, had a soggy crust and tasted like it had been reheated.  

I was entertaining the idea of the leek and mushroom soup, but after asking the kitchen the server informed me that it was made with chicken broth.  

If you're vegetarian and enjoy being made to feel like a second class citizen, or that your dietary choices are unusual, at best, then come to Soulard's.  Don't bother if you're vegan, there's absolutely nothing for you here.  

I will note that the service was fine and none of the actual staff upset me (except maybe the menu creator for their lack of insight).  

I will also add that I am usually not a belligerent vegetarian (see my other reviews).  Also, I have yet to and do not plan to ever visit Soulard's on my own volition.

I was looking at the special which is tilapia with crab meat in creamy lobster sauce. I asked the waitress whether the fish was broiled and she said yes. I asked not to have creamy sauce and she said ok. 

My food came out slow and turned out the fish was breaded and looked fried and she insisted its broiled but I didn't think so. I sent it back and ordered different meal. The menu should be more descriptive or the staff should be able to describe.

The crab cake is okay. Nothing special. 

I also saw an employee gave my waitress a shoulder massage in the restaurant which I thought it was inappropriate and unprofessional.

I als order the salad with shrimp and crab. It's delicious but the shrimps were not cleaned.
Definitely get the cinnamon bun, it's made fresh at the spot. The shoo fly pie is a unique Amish dessert. You can only find it mostly in Lancaster
Blueberry and apple fritters are moist and soft. There are maple bacon and Elvis (peanut butter and bacon). Everything is fresh and made in the premises
I had al pastor salad bowl with red salsa. Very good. I wanted to give 5 stars but they don't have carnitas, which surprised me because I went there 11:30 AM

Ordered through Uber eats.

Hummus: it's creamy but lack of signature hummus/chickpea flavor. I think it has too much parsley in it. I don't recommend it.

Baba ganoush is pretty good because it has the smokiness flavor.

Baklava: big size but it's soggy. The pastry has no crispness at all

Leonard and Eric are the best!
As usual, the food is excellent!

Most of my clothes are from Loft because they have petite size.

Customer service needs more staff especially weekends. I went there on Saturday and there's a long line

This review is for Frankfurt in May. 

Upon arriving we were served with a tray of sliced of hard boiled eggs with the green sauce on rye bread. Also being passed around is bite size of frankfurter and pretzel. The pretzel is Bavarian kind, decent size, soft, and not much salt on it. My favorite and it's authentic.

Food came out slow, it's not ready as the event started.

Dessert looks very inviting but they are ok. Disappointed for not finding streudel.
No more sampling. There are a lot of gluten free and dairy free products and local items too. Super helpful and friendly staff

Wide array selections of organic produce and products that you cannot find anywhere else including Whole Foods. They have sampling table too at the back. Perfect spot for gluten free and health conscious people. They have supplements too and cricket products too. FYI they don't carry bottled water. There's breakfast and lunch place next to it
Very nice store. Have samples for weekend. There are several self checkout and sometimes it's hard to get help. They have organic products too.

Very very vast. Many stores and restaurants and a very nice Simon Mall. Lots to do including a water park, Dave and Busters, etc. The only reason I am giving it a 4 and not a 5 is because I kept getting harassed by the people with vendor carts in the middle of the aisles selling aging cream and hair straighteners. They kept walking next to me and calling after me to try their products.
Best vegan delivery style pizza around! 10/10 recommend you eat the whole pie yourself

Been wanting to try Chubby Cattle every since i heard it opened in Chinatown. Tried it for the first time with my friend tonight, i would say that was not a disappointment!:) Great food and great services! Our waitress Shanshan has showed us the greatest hospitality:)

The food is amazing. Be prepared to wait in a long line and make sure to come in early to get what you want before they are running out.

The cafe is narrow but deep so the line can build up to the back. There are not many seating area. There are outdoor seating and some by the bar.

Service was great. Staff is friendly, service is pretty fast. You can see the kitchen.

Borekas: they are like puff pastry. Potato : it has curry flavor lots of filling flavor is on point . Jam and sweet cheese: delicious but not much filling compared to the potato version. Both has perfect pastry and flavor.

Rugelach: one order consists of 3 rugelachs. Generous with chocolate fillings and moist. It's awesome. Definitely get it. 

Mini babka has orange flavor in it. It's moist and delicious.

Tahini chocolate chip is awesome too, it's soft kind cookie. It's fragile so it didn't survive after I finish running my errands. 

Walnut cake is very moist and sweet, the sweetest among all that I tried. 

Avocado kubaneh toast is amazing. It has spread of Schug sauce that gives a spicy kick topped with sliced of thick fresh avocado and finished with sliced fresh and juicy tomato. It's not a regular avocado toast.

Tahini and molasses kubaneh toast is amazing too. It tastes like PB and J. You cannot find it anywhere else.

Egg and cheese on Jerusalem bagel is great. The bagel is long and soft, perfectly toasted. It has schug spread that gives spicy kick. The egg is thick. Flavor is on point.

Overall the food is amazing. Perfect flavor and very special. I took a star down because I couldn't get the Pistachio sticky buns because they were sold out by 11. I will definitely come back

I had the French toast, a side of eggs and bacon. The French toast was amazing. The eggs however were horrible. I asked for them to be scrambled but they didn't actually whip the egg before cooking it so there was a lot of white in the eggs. I sent them back and asked for them to be scrambled hard. They sent me back a very rubbery orange colored egg. I just said the hell with the eggs. But again the French toast was great the bacon was ok and the restaurant itself is cute and the waiters were friendly.

I sampled the classic and chocolate and classic is the winner. The chocolate has chocolate chips in it so you loose the banana flavor. It's not too sweet because of whipped cream element of the pudding. I prefer more solid pudding. There's basically   90 percent whipped cream. The nutter butter has pieces of nutter butter cookies. There are not many pieces of bananas in it.

I understand that Friday nights are busy. But when I make an order to pick food up and I'm told it's supposed to take fifteen minutes, I shouldn't be standing there waiting for an hour. Also customer service is awful. Stood at the counter without anyone helping me for a large amount of time. No one was any help to me in knowing when my food would actually be ready. Also, got home to see that my order was wrong. Awful, really.

On my third visit, I am getting the salad and grains which are available after 11.

Cauliflower salad: it's a little bit too salty for me. It has some dills and sliced fresh grapes. I asked the tehina on the side. It has a strong flavor kinda goat cheese. 

Tehina chicken salad is awesome. Chicken is tender great flavor and seasoning. Freekeh is perfectly cooked so that it doesn't become a hard grains. Marinated celery is a great combination for the salad as it gives crunchy texture. I'm not a big fan of celery and red onion but this is different. I didn't taste the strong celery or onion flavor. I thought there's some apple slices but it's not on the description of the salad. I highly recommend this.

This was my favorite bar on Broadway. Tonight was so different. There were two bartenders upstairs, one who I've seen several times and the other one I did not know. We asked her for two drinks and she messed up one right off the bat. Upon receiving the wrong drinks , we asked for the correct one and she went to pour it. I watched her do this and she barely poured a  shot into the glass. More like a splash. I am a bartender , so,I know what a shot looks like, When you pour it.  It was as if she was angry because she poured the wrong thing in the first place. I did ask the other bartender  to pour us the correct drink. However, the other bartender stopped her from doing that. It would not have really made me mad had those drinks not been $12 a piece. I don't mind paying that price if I get what I'm asking for....

The complimentary sourdough bread was very salty. The seaweed butter was really good and unique.

Octopus salad: I asked for dressing on the side. The octopus was chewy without being too hard. However most of the pieces were overcharred that ruined the overall flavor. The eggplant purée was very salty.

Seabass with tomato sauce was very delicious. Fish was perfectly cooked. The tomato sauce has perfect flavor with a balanced acidity. Highly recommended.
My friend had grilled swordfish and she said it was the best she ever had. The potato has lemony vinegar flavor there brings brightness to the dish.

Staff is really nice and helpful. If you are paying with cards they will bring the reader to your table. Make sure they put the right amount because our waitress put the wrong bill.
This is a very unique winery out in the middle of nowhere. Ron the wine master is great and knows all about the wines that he makes. Will definitely return!
Beautiful and delicious beignets! Fast moving queue. Definitely worth the wait and the hype! I found the servers to be a little rude though.

The sandwiches are pita based. I tried the egg sandwich as well as chicken schnitzel. Both are well seasoned with spices with fresh veggies including chopped cucumber to give a crunch. The chicken schnitzel isn't breaded, tender and not dry.

The salatim has very strong spice.

Hummus is really smooth, highly recommended

This review is for the dinner service.
No takeout. I was seated at the bar. Luke, my server is super friendly, very knowledgeable about each item on the menu and gave me thorough explanation for my questions. He's very attentive too. He noticed that the rugelach French toast for my dessert had sauce on it although I requested otherwise. He asked if I wanted it to be remade. Since it's just a drizzle, I let it go.

Yasmine, the GM is super friendly and welcoming.

Salmon: the best salmon shrimp I've ever had. Super crispy skin but not greasy at all. The salmon still maintains its moist and juiciness but not rare. It's served with mujadara which is a mix of grain and long rice, braised greens, and labneh. I like that the server explained the dish as it was served. When everything was put together, it has great flavor. The labneh really balanced the flavor because the greens and  grains are pretty salty on their own. Perfect portion too.

Rugelach French toast is amazing. Perfect richness of chocolate. The blueberry sauce is enough and not too sweet. Along with the labneh they balanced the richness of the chocolate as it adds tanginess and acidity to all it. Definitely get this.

I keep trying to give this place another shot, but always end up disappointed. Just ordered lunch and the chicken fingers and fries are burnt to a crisp and taste just awful. Didn't think it was possible to mess up something so simple. Pizza and cheesesteaks aren't very good and fountain soda is all flat. Not ordering from here again and wouldn't recommend to anyone.

I made reservations for Friday night dinner. We came in and took a while to be greeted. Finally a gentleman told us to wait. 15 to 20 minutes later we were seated.

Our waitress was great. Very friendly and gave a good suggestion.

Bread was dry. I am surprised because I was expecting a nice warm Italian bread,?it's a disappointment. 

Salad was fresh but small size.

I ordered meatballs which were awesome. Very moist and tender and the gravy was fresh. It's really a traditional Italian meatball and gravy. 

Chicken Marsala was amazing, the best I've ever had. I can smell the Marsala wine. The chicken is lightly breaded and tender. The sauce is to die for. I can really clean up the sauce. Unfortunately I think the mushrooms are from a can

My husband had tuna and it's delicious with some spicy kick.

My mother in law had baked rigatoni. It's great too. Very rich in ricotta.

Tiramisu and tortufo are delicious too. Not many Italian restaurants serve tartufo. It's a ball of chocolate and vanilla ice cream covered in chocolate with cherry inside.

The line can be very long up to the entrance door. 

Tiramisu is so delicious but as I was enjoying it I found a strand of hair. 

The wait,  the dry bread, and hair in my tiramisu made me give 3 stars. It's the quality of food that saves the review of this restaurant.

Cute store of Termini compared to the other stores. Very friendly staff. Great location because it is in a complex with other businesses such as Chickie's and Pete's , Pastificio, Celebre pizza, PNC bank. 

They have pretty much their popular goodies such as the famous ricotta canoli, cupcakes, cake, cookies, and biscotti. The ricotta canoli is not watery, perfect sweetness with mini chocolate chip filled for your order so that you can taste the crunchiness of the shell. Best eaten right away to avoid sogginess.

The chocolate covered banana is their specialty too. It's banana on an almond pastry with some cream and banana fillings. 

Their shoe horn is great too. It's basically an almond pastry with some almond paste. Its a must for almond lovers.

The fig bar is filled with fig covered in a thin pastry.

Another Italian pastry to try is sfogiatelle. The shell i a crunchy and layered pastry filled with ricotta andd a hint of citrus flavor that brings a fresh taste.

For cookies, my favorite is the amaretti and pignoli. The cookie is very moist with almond paste. 

There is a display of their old equipment. There are some couches and chairs to enjoy their dessert in the store. A must visit for awesome dessert.
Usually really busy, but cheap prices & their eggs Benedict and hash browns are so good

1st time there, sat at Bar.  If you are a friend of the bartender you will get good service otherwise forget it.  Overcharged me, was slow.

Food was great, would come back for the food, but will not sit at the bar
The donuts are very light and fluufy, melts in your mouth. There is always a long line on Saturdays. The apple and blueberry fritters are very good. You can see how they make and fill the donuts.

I heard about Ground Foods Cafe a few weeks back. I had to check the website to confirm that the rumors were true, and they were - a fully vegan restaurant opened in Seminole Heights. Don't miss out on this place, it's exactly what you want for your vegan date night needs. I heard some conversation about the counter service taking away from the finer dining atmosphere, and I do not agree. The ambiance is on point and the food was BEYOND amazing (seriously, can't stop thinking about it). 

The penne alla vodka was the best pasta I've had in a long time. The portions are HUGE, so my recommendation would be to order multiple dishes and split/share. You WANT these leftovers. It's like waking up to a surprise the next day. I had leftovers for breakfast because I woke up dreaming about it! I had the Pinot Grigio which was great, and a sip of some sparkling red wine, which I also really liked! The outside patio was really nice to dine on. There is a bar right next door, so if you want a quieter experience, sit inside!

My tips:
- I think the establishment should really serve the wine in wine glasses. That small change would make a HUGE difference.
- I wish sour dough bread appetizer had more evoo on it and it was a little crispier.

Order: salad with chicken schwarma. The chicken is on the dry side. The hummus is delicious. The baba ganoush has its signature smokiness and chunks of eggplant.

The pita is big and thick. Pretty good. 

Baklava is great too. Crispy phyllo and great fillings.

The black bean plantain burger is delicious. Although it has poblano peppers in it, it's not spicy at all. The bun is big. Overall it's a nice vegan burger. My friend had chicken wrap and she likes it
Great selections of organic, natural, healthy food. Very friendly and helpful employees. Got free bag for first time visit. Got $15 groupon for $30 worth of groceries.

Stoped in for a bite to eat because a few people said it was good. While entering the establishment, I noticed the windows and doors were really dirty. The guy at the counter was really nice and took my order. It took 15  min. To get my order which gave me plenty of time to look around the room. That place was so filthy! The amount of dirt and dust everywhere really grossed me out.

The service needs improvement. The guy who served me seemed annoyed when I asked what kind of milk they use. He said it's a milk tea. 

I ordered red bean matcha without sugar plus boba. The red bean gives sweetness to the tea. Boba gives good chewiness

On my second visit here, I was waiting in line for around 30 to 45 minutes with a mission to get the pistachio buns. Thankfully my mission was accomplished.

Pistachio buns: it's a little bit dry. I was expecting moist and gooey dough. I guess I am spoiled with warm sticky buns at Reading Terminal Market. The good side is it is not overly sweet. The pistachio gives crunchy texture.

Swiss chard boreka: filled with perfectly seasoned fresh greens .

Labneh parfait: really fresh strawberry purée with nice amount of sweet granola. It's available in the fridge near entrance door. Highly recommended.

Fig toast wit brown sugar ricotta is amazing. Toast is moist yet it has nice crunch. Ricotta is smooth, fig is fresh and sweet. Highly recommended 

Mike Solomonov was there expediting order to the kitchen. I felt I was watching a nicer version of Gordon Ramsey. I talked to him briefly. Very nice and friendly guy.

The Hostesses are all super rude African-American girls and shout and have no pride in their jobs, jUst starting there. Before we had even said a word, this girl starts yelling at us to follow her from across the restaurant. When we went up stairs in 3 separate groups and by then we had formed a chain and "bottlenecked" up the stairs where we waited as t the other hostess upstairs had us pull a table across the restaurant so we could sit down. 

Our server was nice, however, we ordered a burger, a po' boy and a dozen oysters and each got a salad to start, 3 waters and 2 Red Bull's. We were all really impressed with our server taking our order with no pen or paper until;

The burger came out undercooked with topping we previously stated had an "allergy request"

The salads came out with the wrong dressings

The po boy was the wrong pRotein

The oysters were charbroiled when we said raw 

Then our waters stayed empty and the red bulls never came. 

In short i'll never go here again and the people that work  there are the trashiest I've ever experienCed even for the French Quarter.

They always have cake of the month. For October I had pumpkin and caramel cake. Very delicious, not heavy on the pumpkin spice. The caramel is great complement to the flavor. The cake is moist.

Don't forget to check in with yelp to get free cake truffle.

Very friendly and helpful

Was excited to try this restaurant for the first time. We decided on the highest level chef's tasting for our party of 8.  Food was sub par for the price. Servers were great and attentive but the entire experience was rushed. There was absolutely no time between courses. Plates piled on top of each other and little time to enjoy or even try the course. We were done the entire tasting within 45 minutes. Feels like a mill they are just pushing people through. When spending over a grand on dinner you expect to relax a little while enjoying your meal. Would not go again.

I was very excited to try this new restaurant, but I must say, I was disappointed. During my visit, I ordered the waygu cut beef, halibut lollipops, miso black cod, fried rice, Soto saki, and toro shashimi. Nothing was bad, but it was far from delicious. I was most disappointed with the beef. For the prices they charge I expected the best of quality and it was far from that. Having recently been to Yazawa, in Los Angeles, you cannot compare the decadence of the two. The miso cod was bitter and I would not order that again. The sashimi was cut very thick, and in my opinion, it was hard to enjoy a very thick piece of raw fish in one bite. The fried rice tasted mostly of onions and ginger.  Lastly, we were seated for our reservations at 6:00pm and did not receive our first dish until almost 7:00pm. The lapse in time between getting each dish was very long. 

The ambiance was very nice, the views were beautiful, and there were many people dining in the restaurant. The service was very friendly as well. 

If you are looking for decent food, a beautiful ambiance, and don't mind paying steep prices, then this place will be fine.

I woke up from a dream. In this dream, I was walking in a post-pandemic world, where there were only a few of us left. (How did I survive, we'll never know). I ran into another survivor who said, what would you eat right now if the economy didn't collapse and take everyone with it? I started to shake, with memories from just a few weeks prior, where everything was strange but normal and I walked into Sekushi to have my life changed.

"The Lucas Chan Bowl," I cried.

I was glad to wake up and see that despite the horrors our nation was facing, Sekushi is very much still open and operating. Let me tell you this. I did not expect much in the culinary department when choosing to celebrate my birthday (officially old) on Clearwater Beach. I saw that Sekushi had some vegan options, but I didn't expect what they actually provided.

First of all - we love a clearly defined menu! If you're vegan and reading this, you know what it's like to see the "vegetarian" option listed only to find out it has eggs from chickens, quails, geese and also 7 types of cheese. This place has options clearly labeled VEGAN!! I don't even care if the servers thought vegan was the name of an exotic pasta they didn't serve, I was STOKED!

The Lucas Chan Bowl was not your average rice bowl, it was otherworldly in deliciousness. The base is sushi rice and then you're met with avocado, the best seaweed salad I've ever had in my entire life, TOFU, and so much more. Ugh I want it now. The edamame? Unlike any I've tried before. It comes out in a fricken cast iron skillet with actual seasoning and some kind of seared garlic, idk but it was worth the $8. I wasn't truly impressed with the dumplings or the bao bun, but i'd absolutely probably eat them again (wait does that make sense?).

As a formality, I'll tell you that it's a very tiny place inside but does offer some outdoor seating. There are both tables and very large/comfy booths. 
10/10. Cannot wait to come back to this place!!

I ordered for pickup through Grubhub. When I got there the food wasn't ready. I don't think it was prepared. I had to wait a while. While waiting, I grabbed some bread. They are big. However they are dry. I don't think they are fresh.

Al pastor: really stuffed with meat. I love the chunks of pineapple. You can make more tacos from the meat. The sauce makes the meat not dry. It comes with some cactus.

Cactus salad: good portion size but it's in a flimsy aluminum container so the water was leaking as I was walking home. It's mixed with jalapeño.

Tamales is not firm at all. When I opened it, it falls apart and became a mushy corn meal with not much meat in it. Most of the meat has more fat. Not recommended.

Guacamole has dominant lime flavor. Not too much avocado. More liquid content than the avocado.

The service is great. Our waiter Michael was very friendly. Nice view of the city.

Appetizer: crab dumplings: the broth was poured on the table. It has the small dumplings filled with crab meat. The broth had citrus flavor, it's ok. Unfortunately I found crab shell. I notified the waiter and a lady probably the manager apologized.

Sea bass with turmeric sauce:  the seabass  was perfectly cooked with nice crispy skin but the turmeric doesn't have much flavor. It's very mediocre. Unfortunately I found a bone in it. I couldn't get our waiter's attention so I notified another staff who didn't bring it to our waiter's attention. I had to tell him about this incident to ensure it was taken off from the bill.

My husband had tenderloin with miso mustard sauce and he loves it.

The saving grace of the dinner was the desserts.

Apple dessert was beautifully presented. It has spiralized apple with some cookie inside, not too swee.

My guest 

Overall the food wasn't spectacular.  However the dessert was outstanding and memorable had coconut dessert that some fruit inside, so pretty.

The bread basket was ok, rye was salty. I prefer the bread at JG SkyHigh

50yo short-haired platinum blonde bartender needs to mind her manners. Literally stuck her  middle finger in my boys face because he took a FLASHLESS picture of the ceiling above her. 


"Miss why are you so hostile?"


"I didn't give you permission to film me (bird in his face continued)"

Response: 
"Lol Yeah!  we came all the way from Vegas to see the dungeon just so we could take candid footage of your toothless a**, you know what f*** this place"

Came in before they close for the season to get free cone.

The waffle is made fresh. Not overly sweet, crispy on the edges. The ice cream is ok, it's dense instead of creamy. The mochi is a little bit dry. I guess it's because of the end of the season. The strawberry boba tasted very artificial. Don't get this.

The guy who helped me with my order was super nice and friendly. He put my free ice cream in a cup with a lid and put the cone on the side. Five stars on customer service.

I'm so happy that El Merkury is the new vendor at Reading Terminal Market. 

I ordered the black bean pupusas. It's fresh with delicious salsa, pickled onions, and cole slaw. The salsa was a little bit spicy.

The Mexican street corn was sweet with delicious creamy topping.

The churros were fresh and crunchy. Next time I want to try the fancy churros with I've cream.

Service was great, the container is environmentally friendly. However, my corn was bigger than the container so some of the sauce were leaking.

Horrible ... horrible hospital -. My Dad has dementia and my Mom had to rush him to the hospital yesterday . My mom is elderly too ...she has power of attorney for him . The hospital will not let my Mom up  until it's visiting hours at 1.
My Dad has been texting my Mother  all morning that he is going into surgery and is very confused . They would not let my mother or sister (she is in healthcare ) in at all .  How can they let a very  confused elderly person knowing they have dementia and someone  else has power of attorney for him make decisions about his health on his  own when he cannot make  day to day decisions ... they were made aware of this . . They have taken my fathers disability rights away from him by not letting his power of  attorney make the decisions for him .. My sister talked to the administrator , Angela who has no last name - she was very rude and  condensending  to my sister and said your father is fine - reallllllyyyy - I feel like I'm in New York  and the hospital is being ran by Cuomo - crazy.

Felt like a milkshake and went through the drive through to order it. They have soooo many different flavors to choose from. I went with the chocolate malt and it was an excellent choice. The thing that amazed my most is how cheap it was. Very generous portion and very reasonably priced.

The first time I had 3 Dot Dash was many moons ago, at the pop-up brunch hosted by the Bricks. I was underwhelmed by the food and what they titled the menu options (the philly didn't taste like a philly, it tasted like a breakfast sandwich with too much fennel - I can't really explain what I mean but I'm sure you get it).

Fast forward to a couple of weeks ago, I decided to head over to Jug & Bottle to give them a proper second chance (we know I'm good at those - third, fourth and fifth chances too). I was surprised to see the amount of menu items to choose from. The menu has a large variety of chic*en sandwiches, impossible burgers, philly sandwiches, you know the drill. *****Side note for absolutely no reason: I love when vegan restaurants don't have salad on the menu, because I'm not here for salad. If 3 Dot Dash does sell salad, I suppressed seeing it and will take back that statement.

Anyways, It took me 13 minutes to make my decision, and as much as I would've liked to give the philly another try, I opted for a freaking pub sub style sandwich. Can't really go wrong, it was pretty freaking good! It was a better version of a pub sub. I'm a big fan of the seitan they make and will absolutely come back to give the other items another try. Cheers to another legit vegan spot in Seminole Heights.

My friend ordered the classic philly and it came with (a rough estimate because I left my travel food scale in the car) 2.6 lbs of seitan!

Upon entering I was greeted by a friendly host who asked us our seating preferences. On the right is the bar area with a lot of tv to watch sports, it's a little bit loud. On the left is the main dining area, which we decided to go. It's spacious enough for social distancing, against the wall are booth seatings. There is a big tv on the wall and several are hanging. So if you are into sports you won't miss much. There's a fireplace in the middle of the room which is nicely decorated to give a homey feel. 

Our waiter was excellent. Our orders came fast and correct. He was very attentive to check out how we were.

Alligator chili was one of the specials. It was served in an angled white bowl to give a gourmet touch. The alligator was fried in batter in bite sizes. The breading was light and not greasy. The texture and taste is similar to a white fish but without any fishy smell or taste. It's topped with corn chips. Beautiful presentation to wake up your appetite.

Pretzel is huge. Super soft and warm with mustard and cheese dipping on the side. There's no granules of salt on top so that it's not salty. It has enough amount of melted cheese instead for a nice presentation and addition flavor. Highly recommended.

House salad is fresh, dressing has perfect acidity and flavor. My favorite part of the salad is the croutons. They are so fresh.  Very crunchy and light but not hard at all that will hurt your gum. I had salmon added to my salad. Salmon was perfectly cooked.

Overall everything has perfect portions, we enjoyed the food and service.

I was in town visiting with some friends, and ended up here for brunch. Saturday morning and surprisingly, no wait time. Suspicious? Yes. While Datz is still (in my humble opinion) lacking in vegan options, they do... have options. Went with our server's recommendation (thanks Logan!! Awesome dude, very helpful) of the "farmer's market scramble." Despite the misleading name, it's a Just Egg scramble with black beans, salsa and some other good stuff. It's absolutely over priced, but sometimes it really do just be like that. Not in a rush to get back to Datz, but it's great to know they're slowly adding some new vegan options.

I've been going to European Wax Center since 2018 and absolutely love it! I look forward to my appointments with Shawanda because she does such an amazing job. I've seen several wax specialists here, but I can always count on Shawanda to be there for my appointment and do a great job.

This place is in the Piazza Pod Park. Service is excellent. Staff is very friendly and helpful.

Shrimp shiumai is my favorite. Very delicious and perfect flavor.

Dan dan noodles. This is my husband 's favorite at Jane G. But here he said it's bland.

Soup dumplings are small and filled with broth. They are ok more to salty side.

Vegetable dumplings are a disappointment. The skin was soggy and the veggies lack flavor.

Custard buns are pretty good. Buns are soft and the custard is creamy.

It's the Zen of Cacti. take a little stroll the the hothouses, talk to the succulents and agave... Breathe in the calm and tranquility.. be one with the desert. Consistency. Reliability. Healthy Plants. toss in a few soil amenities =  perfect combination. I can never get out of here in less than an hour (usually a few hours) - but it's worth the trek... there's always something new!

I can't tell if your menu is actually accurate. It's so limited. How do you open up a restaurant with such a limited selection of let alone pub food in which portrays itself as a fine dining restaurant?? Please evaluate your selections

Evo has pretty good food - if you can get it. I tried to order from them on GrubHub tonight because Fiesta was closed, and nope! My order was cancelled. For the third time. At least this time they cancelled it within about five minutes; the last two times they waited to cancel until almost the time my food was supposed to arrive.

Order deliver from here only if you're not actually hungry and are just ordering pizza because you've exhausted every other entertainment possibility on the internet.
Great food for brunch and dinner! Staff is very friendly which is a huge plus! Love the beer selections and unique brunch options. Will keep coming.

I had the cake of the month: pink lady cake, vanilla cake layered with strawberry cream cheese and meringue frosting. It's very delicious and sweet, definitely gives you sugar rush. It has to be refrigerated to maintain the frosting otherwise it will be melting.

Lemon lime Whoopie pie: the cake is okay but the filling is sweet and tart. Pretty good.

I had the cake of the month: fluffernutter cake. It's super sweet. Very moist cake. It comes in a box. It looks pretty in the morning but by the end of the day the frostings melts and the cake falls apart. I recommend eating it right away.

Vegan pina colada is ok and taste artificial.

Was just remembering the horrible experience I had here 2 years ago. Staff is trash, food is trash. Made a 2 year lasting bad impression on me.

Just remembering when the manage called me and gave me the same treatment that his staff did. Undermined my intelligence and under appreciated my patronage just the same. Spend your money literally ANYWHERE else.

This review is only for Dan Dan noodles. It's dry and no too much flavor. The portion is enough for one person.

The restaurant itself is very elegant and clean. I like the painting of a lady on the wall upon entering.

This review is for the birria tacos which have gained popularity these days. 

Each taco has two soft tortilla soaked with the broth and have some crispness. The consommé is salty with some savory flavors but obscured by the saltiness. The beef has a little bit better flavor than the consommé but still on the salty side. It's tender but I found some fatty and tendon part. Good amount of the beef. They put the toppings (cilantro, onions, hot peppers, salsa Rojas and verde) in separate small containers. The hot peppers are really spicy hot.

Very nice little zoo. The public area is very nice and clean. My favorite place is the big cat area, you can see the animals clearly from the glass enclosure. At the farm area there are several goats, chickens, and miniature donkeys. At the entrance you can find majestic bald eagles.

Super unprofessional workers. I referred someone to this location, and she had a terrible experience. I called immediately to find out what was wrong and after talking to some guy named James I completely understand why her experience was bad. Miserable with life type of individual and bad atmosphere.
This place cancelled my Seamless order without a word of explanation and it's going to take me 5-10 business days to even get a refund. Their food is good, but I'm not ordering from them again.

I placed my order for pickup. The person who took the call is very friendly and my order was ready in 15 minutes. She gave me a call to notify me. 

Al pastor pizza: although it looks spicy, it's not spicy at all. It comes with a sauce that you can put yourself. The pizza is loaded with chicken and bits of pineapple. The crust is thin and crispy on the edges. It's ok, I was expecting more flavor.

Maduros with condensed milk. Definitely get this for dessert. Plantains are perfectly ripe, not too mushy. The drizzle of condensed milk and chocolate sprinkles elevate the sweetness.

I wish I can give less than one star. I ordered from Grubhub because of cheap delivery fee. I ordered steamed shrimp with vegetables and on the description it says choice of sauce on the side.My food came  with brown sauce and the shrimp is lightly battered and fried.

I agree with another reviewer saying that it is greasy. My order was supposed to be healthy but it's very greasy.

Brand new! For vegans out there get ready! Stopped by and had the garlic bread knot and the marinara pizza. You can get veggies and vegan cheese is coming. The flavor was awesome and it comes in half sheets and full sheets! Trying to hold off for a couple of days before we go back! This is the only pizza place on the beach that I have found that is eco-friendly! No styrofoam, no plastic! It's nice to see a place that cares. Pictures next time!
First time here- they did a great job with my hair cut and the prices are great! Finally found my new hair salon!
The coconut cream pie is delicious. The meringue is perfectly brûléed. The filling is creamy and I can taste the coconut extract. Highly recommend.

We drove an hour to get here and what we had was an okay food and subpar service.

The place is huge with an area for takeout beer, T-shirt, and glasses. There's a big bar area at the back with plenty of tvs to watch sports.

Service: our waiter wasn't friendly at all. He was sniffling and looking at the ceiling while taking the orders. When we asked for plates and utensils he grabbed from different table and throw them to ours. I asked for big salad but gave me small.

Pretzel: it's the only one that I end. It came out warm and soft. Delicious.

Fried pickles: not overly battered and my husband and our guests enjoyed it.

Trout with pea pure and fingerling potato: overly peppered. Black pepper is all over the fish. Purée is very salty. The position is decent.

Blackened salmon salad: pretty good with some spiciness.

Dessert: strawberry love ice creams and chocolate ice cream made from beer. I didn't taste the beer at all. The strawberry is okay. The chocolate one has small chocolate chip in it. It's pretty good but not mind blowing. They are like regular ice cream. Nothing special. You can skip it.

I will not go back here again.

Did someone say... vegan pastries on Clearwater Beach? Heck yes they did. It's 2020 baby and we are truly living our best lives anywhere we go! (Except for maybe Ocala or Kentucky).

This is a very cute place and I'll absolutely be back! Indoor seating (not really now due to COVID) and outdoor seating available - however limited.

I had a blueberry lemon scone and let me tell you, it was the best vegan pastry I've ever had! I also tried the banana bread, which unfortunately wasn't impressive. The coffee was alright. I'm officially requesting this establishment to add oat milk to the menu, as that would've elevated my experience. I was told most of the flavors are vegan, so during one of my 3 visits I tried a PEANUT BUTTER almond milk iced latte and it was very impressive.

Keep up the good work! I will literally try any vegan pastry you come up with and that's a promise.

Was just thinking about the terrible experience I had here 2 years ago. I've told at least 1,000 people the story at this time. 

Felt like leaving another review to reiterate how TRASH this establishment and the people that work there are. 
Spend your money elsewhere.
I like to try their cake of the month. For September, it's campfire cake. Chocolate cake with marshmallow frosting. I was lucky to get freshly cut cake. Very delicious.

We arrived here on Wednesday evening around 6:30 and were told to order food ASAP because the kitchen closed at 7.  I hope it was only for that particular night, otherwise I recommend coming here early to ensure you get some food.

The seatings available are at the bar.

Brisket fries was awesome, the pieces of brisket gave smoky flavor. Fried pickles were crispy, pretzel rods were warm and served with pimiento cream cheese dipping.

Salad had a good portion. That night they had Reese's pieces shot: yuengling Hershey lager with peanut butter whiskey. Very good.

The bartender is very friendly and attentive.

Very nice and clean restaurant. The waitress is very friendly and helpful. Drunken noodle is very good and spicy. It is sauteed broad rice noodle, basil, onion, bell pepper, and chilli. Choice of chicken, beef, or shrimp. Definitely going back to try more.

It is what it is - a sushi restaurant in the heart of YEE haw New Port Richey. The seaweed salad is allegedly vegan. It wasn't the best I've had, but that one dumped me years ago. Other options include: avocado roll, cucumber roll, spring rolls, etc.

Outdoor seating available! Cold domestics on tap! Kind wait staff! *located next to a very loud bar (The Social), which I didn't mind, but you might. Street parking available.

Very nice museum dedicated to Johnny Nash. The museum is small and it takes about 45 minute to get through if you watch all the videos. The tickets are quite expensive for how small the museum is and how quickly you get through it

Be very careful and leary of trusting your dental care to these dentists. I had a gut instinct which indicated to find  a new dentist and boy am I glad I did. Apparently, I had "4" cavities  needing filling and went back to my previous dentist, who told me I had no cavities. I also got 5 fillings done at the practice, which I doubt even needed filling.

Our waitress "Theresa" spent the majority of her time sitting with the dirty old man that brought her gifts and a Victoria Secret catalog for her to pick out underwear for him to order rather than waiting on us. During my stay I saw another waitress doing a similar thing. Perhaps if you fill the sugar daddy role you get good service here. No such luck for me, since I have seen breasts in real life my wallet doesn't empty at the sight of them.

The food was average.

These guys are the best in the game! If you're having a hard time finding good barbers look no more! My son and I have had the pleasure of getting cuts by barbers Rob & Carlos and couldn't be more happy. These guys are true masters of their craft and you won't leave disappointed! Not to mention the shop layout is super dope and they always have good music playing. If you haven't checked them out go do so!

I'm not usually in Philly so this was my first time here. My sister lives around here so parents and I came here while visiting her, this was her first time coming to the restaurant too. It's a visually nice place with upstairs and downstairs bars/sitting areas in like an old townhome but not disability friendly at all. The food was okay, a little bit better than the average bar food but not by much. My favorite was the sweet potato fries with the cinnamon maple sauce - perfect salty sweet dish. The food came out at such odd times one dish at a time and it was very awkward and not ideal especially considering there was only 4 of us. It was an alright time but I don't know if we will return on future visits to the area.

Perfect place for tourists and locals. Affordable produce, specialty bakeries such as Terminini's, Cheesesteak, chocolate, meat, fish, diner, and  the amazing donuts. This review is for the Riehl's deli. Very friendly staff you can try it first. They have cheese too. You have to take a number. Accept card payment.

Very friendly staff. I had the steamed chicken and shrimp with veggies. Really fresh and chicken was tender. 

They need to update the menu because the tofu with black mushrooms is no longer available

Brutal.  

We walked in this morning to watch soccer.  No harp - all out.   People with me ordered coffee.  What a farce.   They brought it in beer glasses.  Then they informed us they had no cream or milk or mugs.   Not sure why not, but that could have been conveyed when ordering.  

Our server was a nice young redhead lady who worked her tail off.   The frat boy bartender with the Ninja Turtle cap on backwards was indifferent and inept.
